instructions: From here, begin squatting down in a smooth controlled motion as keeping the other leg straight out in front of you for balance
Slowly sit down on the box, pause for a 1 count and push back up with the working leg, as never letting the other leg touch the ground

exercises.name: 2 Handed Kettlebell Swing
instructions: Stand with the feet slightly wider than shoulder-width, the kettlebell on the floor about 20-30 cm in front of the toes

Position the hands behind or to the side of the head
You will begin with the back on the ground

You may brace the leg with the hands if necessary

exercises.name: Ab Crunch Machine

Breathe out as you carry out this movement

exercises.name: Ab Roller
instructions: Position the ab roller on the floor in front of you so that you are on all the hands and knees
Slowly roll the ab roller straight forward, stretching the body into a straight position
After a pause at the stretched position, start pulling yourself back to the start as you breathe out
Go slowly and keep the abs tight at all times

exercises.name: Ab wheel
instructions: Slowly roll the wheel forward, extending the body as keeping the core tight
Pull the wheel back towards the knees, maintaining tension in the core

exercises.name: Abdominal Crunch
instructions: Unlike a full sit-up, it involves a smaller range of motion where you only lift the shoulders and upper back off the ground, keeping the lower back pressed firmly against the floor

As trying to relax the muscles if the inner thigh, roll over the foam between the hip and knee, holding points of tension

exercises.name: Adductor/Groin
instructions: Lie on the back with the feet raised towards the ceiling
Have the partner hold the feet or ankles
Abduct the legs as far as you can
Attempt to squeeze the legs together for 10 or more seconds, as the partner prevents you from doing so
Now, relax the muscles in the legs as the partner pushes the feet apart, stretching as far as is comfortable for you

exercises.name: Advanced Kettlebell Windmill
instructions: Keeping the kettlebell locked out at all times, push the butt out in the direction of the locked out kettlebell
Keep the non-working arm behind the back and turn the feet out at a forty-five degree angle from the arm with the kettlebell

exercises.name: Air Bike
instructions: Lie flat on the floor with the lower back pressed to the ground
Lift the shoulders into the crunch position
Bring knees up to where they are perpendicular to the floor, with the lower legs parallel to the floor
Bring the right elbow close to the left knee by crunching to the side, as you breathe out

exercises.name: All Fours Quad Stretch
instructions: Start off on the hands and knees, then lift the leg off the floor and hold the foot with the hand
Use the hand to hold the foot or ankle, keeping the knee fully flexed, stretching the quadriceps and hip flexors
Focus on extending the hips, thrusting them towards the floor

exercises.name: Alternate Hammer Curl
instructions: Stand up with the torso upright and a dumbbell in each hand being held at arms length
Slowly begin to bring the dumbbells back to start as the breathe in

exercises.name: Alternate Heel Touchers

Exhale as performing this movement

exercises.name: Alternating dumbbell hammer curl
instructions: Stand with the knees slightly bent and the back straight
Hold a dumbbell in each hand, using a neutral grip at the sides

exercises.name: Alternating Floor Press
instructions: Lie on the floor with two kettlebells next to the shoulders
Position one in position on the chest and then the other, gripping the kettlebells on the handle with the palms facing forward
Extend both arms, so that the kettlebells are being held above the chest
Lower one kettlebell, bringing it to the chest and turn the wrist in the direction of the locked out kettlebell

exercises.name: Alternating Hang Clean
instructions: Position two kettlebells between the feet
To get in the start, push the butt back and look straight ahead
Clean one kettlebell to the shoulder and hold on to the other kettlebell in a hanging position
Clean the kettlebell to the shoulder by extending through the legs and hips as you pull the kettlebell towards the shoulders
Turn the wrist as you do so

exercises.name: Alternating High Cable Row
instructions: Step back with the left foot
To the start with cable pulley and left foot and take hold of the cable pulley handle in the right

exercises.name: Alternating Kettlebell Press
instructions: Clean two kettlebells to the shoulders
Clean the kettlebells to the shoulders by extending through the legs and hips as you pull the kettlebells towards the shoulders
Turn the wrists as you do so
Press one directly overhead by extending through the elbow, turning it so the palm faces forward as holding the other kettlebell stationary
Lower the pressed kettlebell to the start and immediately press with the other arm

exercises.name: Alternating Kettlebell Row
instructions: Position two kettlebells in front of the feet
Bend the knees slightly and push the butt out as much as possible
As you bend over to get into the start take hold of both kettlebells by the handles
Pull one kettlebell off of the floor as holding on to the other kettlebell
Retract the shoulder blade of the working side, as you flex the elbow, drawing the kettlebell towards the stomach or rib cage

exercises.name: Alternating Renegade Row
instructions: Position two kettlebells on the floor about shoulder width apart
Position yourself on the toes and the hands as though you were doing a pushup, with the body straight and extended
You may need to position the feet wide for support
Push one kettlebell into the floor and row the other kettlebell, retracting the shoulder blade of the working side as you flex the elbow, pulling it to the side

exercises.name: Ankle Circles
instructions: Lift the right leg in the air and carry out a circular motion with the big toe
Breathe normally as you carry out the movement

exercises.name: ankle dorsiflexion rocks
instructions: Move the knee forward, keeping the heel on the ground

exercises.name: Ankle On The Knee
instructions: From a lying position, bend the knees and keep the feet on the floor
Position the ankle of one foot on the opposite knee
Relax the neck and shoulders

exercises.name: Ankle Roll
instructions: Slowly draw circles with the foot, moving only at the ankle

exercises.name: Anterior Tibialis-SMR
instructions: Begin seated on the ground with the legs bent and the feet on the floor

exercises.name: Anti-Gravity Press
instructions: Position a bar on the ground behind the head of an incline bench
Flex the elbows, performing a reverse curl to bring the bar near the chest
To begin, press the barbell out in front of the head by extending the elbows
Keep the arms parallel to the ground throughout the movement

exercises.name: Archer Pull Up
instructions: Hang with arms fully extended, engaging the core and keeping the shoulder blades pulled down
Pull the body up towards one hand, similar to a regular pull-up
Slowly lower yourself back to the start with control

exercises.name: Arm Circles
instructions: Stand up and extend the arms straight out by the sides
Breathe normally as you carry out the movement

exercises.name: Arm Raises (T/Y/I)
instructions: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, core engaged, and arms relaxed at the sides
From this position, carry out three different arm raises to target the shoulders and upper back
Lift the arms straight out to the sides until they are parallel to the floor, forming a “T” shape
Lift the arms upward at about a 45° angle from the body to form a “Y” shape
Raise the arms straight overhead, close together, forming an “I” shape
Focus on squeezing the shoulder blades together and keeping the shoulders down away from the ears

exercises.name: Arnold Dumbbell Press
instructions: Sit on an exercise bench with back support and hold two dumbbells in front of you at about upper chest level with the palms facing the body and the elbows bent
The start should look like the contracted portion of a dumbbell curl
To carry out the movement, raise the dumbbells as you turn the palms of the hands until they are facing forward
Continue lifting the dumbbells until the arms are extended above you in straight arm position
Breathe out as you carry out this portion of the movement
Breathe in as you carry out this portion of the movement

exercises.name: Arnold Shoulder Press
instructions: Sit on a bench with the back supported
Hold a pair of dumbbells in front of the shoulders, palms facing you and elbows in front of the body
Press the dumbbells overhead as rotating the hands, so that the palms face forward at the top

exercises.name: Around The Worlds
instructions: Breathe in as you carry out this portion of the movement

exercises.name: Atlas Stones
instructions: Begin with the atlas stone between the feet
Bend at the hips to wrap the arms vertically around the Atlas Stone, attempting to get the fingers underneath the stone
Pulling the stone into the torso, drive through the back half of the feet to pull the stone from the ground
Sit low, getting the stone high onto the chest as you change the grip to reach over the stone
Stand, driving through with the hips

exercises.name: Australian pull-ups
instructions: Position yourself on the back under the bar, gripping the bar with a supinated grip
Adjust the position so that the body is aligned straight from head to toe
Bend the elbows and pull the chest towards the bar, contracting the back muscles
Slowly return to the start, extending the elbows

exercises.name: Axe Hold
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and raise the straight arms out to the sides to shoulder height

exercises.name: Axle Deadlift
instructions: Bend at the hip to grip the bar at shoulder width, allowing the shoulder blades to protract

exercises.name: Back bridge
instructions: Lie on the floor with the back resting on the floor and the legs bent, feet flat on the floor, leaving about 20 cm between the feet and the buttocks
Push the hips as high as you can, raising the body off the floor, and continue pushing through the hands, extending the elbows and knees, until the back is fully arched
After lifting off the floor, the hips should be very high, even above the level of the head
Never hold the breath during the exercise

exercises.name: Back Flyes - With Bands
instructions: Take hold of the band by the handles and stand back so that the tension in the band rises
As you exhale, move the arms to the sides and back
Keep the arms extended and parallel to the floor

exercises.name: Back Lever
instructions: Hanging from a pull-up bar facing downwards with the arms extended

exercises.name: Backward Medicine Ball Throw
instructions: Begin standing a few meters in front of the partner, both facing the same direction
Begin holding the ball between the legs
Squat down and then forcefully reverse direction, coming to full extension and you toss the ball over the head to the partner
The partner can then roll the ball back to you

exercises.name: Balance Board
instructions: Position a balance board in front of you

exercises.name: Ball Leg Curl
instructions: Begin on the floor laying on the back with the feet on top of the ball
Position the ball so that when the legs are extended the ankles are on top of the ball

exercises.name: Ball Slams
instructions: Stand with the feet about shoulder-width apart, the knees and hips slightly bent, holding the ball in both hands at chest height
Engage the core, and keep a good posture
Extend the knees and drive the hips forward as simultaneously lifting the ball
Aim for being as tall as possible, the ball overhead, arms up, hips slightly forward, and on the toes from the force of the drive
Press the hips back and bend the knees to further power the slam

exercises.name: Band Assisted Pull-Up
instructions: Pull the end of the band down, and position one bent knee into the loop, ensuring it won't slip out
Pull to the front, attempting to get the chin over the bar

exercises.name: Band Good Morning
instructions: Using a 41 inch band, stand on one end, spreading the feet a small amount
Bend at the hips to loop the end of the band behind the neck
Keeping the legs straight, extend through the hips to come to a near vertical position

exercises.name: Band Good Morning (Pull Through)
instructions: The hands can help hold the band in position
Begin by bending at the hips, getting the butt back as far as possible
Keep the back flat and bend forward to about 90 degrees
Return to the start be driving through with the hips to come back to a standing position

exercises.name: Band Hip Adductions
instructions: Stand with the left side to the post, and set the right foot through the band, getting it around the ankle
Keeping the knee straight, raise the right legs out to the side as far as you can

exercises.name: Band Pull Apart
instructions: Begin with the arms extended straight out in front of you, holding the band with both hands
Initiate the movement by performing a reverse fly motion, moving the hands out laterally to the sides
Keep the elbows extended as you carry out the movement, bringing the band to the chest
Confirm that you keep the shoulders back during the exercise
Pause as you complete the movement, returning to the start under control

exercises.name: Band pull-apart with external rotation
instructions: Stand tall with the feet shoulder-width apart, chest out, and shoulders back
Bend the elbows at a 90-degree angle and glue the upper arms to the sides
As keeping the elbows tucked into the sides, slowly move the hands away from each other, stretching the band
Squeeze the shoulder blades together and down as you turn the hands outward
Slowly and with control, bring the hands back to the start

exercises.name: Band Skull Crusher
instructions: Take hold of the band, raising the elbows so that the upper arm is perpendicular to the floor
With the elbow flexed, the band should be above the head
Extend through the elbow to straighten the arm, keeping the upper arm in position

exercises.name: Band Terminal Knee extension
instructions: Straighten the knee to pull against the bands resistance and maintain a contraction in the quadriceps for up to 5 seconds before releasing

exercises.name: Banded Ankle Mobility
instructions: Get into a half-kneeling position with the banded foot in front, so that the band pulls the ankle backwards
Keeping the heel on the floor, drive the knee forward over the toes, then return under control

exercises.name: Banded Clamshell
instructions: The upper knee as keeping the feet close together, like a “shell
Stable and the hips aligned

exercises.name: Banded Front Raise
instructions: Stand on the middle of a resistance band with feet about hip-width apart, holding one end in each hand in front of the thighs
Keeping the arms straight with a slight bend in the elbows, raise the hands forward to shoulder height, then lower slowly under control

exercises.name: Banded Monster Walk
instructions: Position a mini band around both thighs just above the knees, or around the ankles for a harder version

exercises.name: Banded Shoulder Drills
instructions: Stand away from it, holding it in the hand so it is taut

exercises.name: Barbell Ab Rollout
instructions: As keeping a slight arch on the back, lift the hips and roll the barbell towards the feet as you exhale
As you carry out the movement, the glutes should be coming up, you should be keeping the abs tight and should maintain the back posture at all times

exercises.name: Barbell Ab Rollout - On Knees
instructions: Position the barbell on the floor in front of you so that you are on all the hands and knees
Slowly roll the barbell straight forward, stretching the body into a straight position
After a second pause at the stretched position, start pulling yourself back to the start as you breathe out
Go slowly and keep the abs tight at all times

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press - Medium Grip
instructions: Using a medium width grip , lift the bar from the rack and hold it straight over you with the arms locked
From the start, breathe in and begin coming down slowly until the bar touches the middle chest
After a brief pause, push the bar back to the start as you breathe out
Focus on pushing the bar using the chest muscles
When you are done, position the bar back in the rack

exercises.name: Barbell Curl
instructions: Stand upright and take a barbell with a shoulder-width grip.
Move only the forearms to curl the bar up.
At the top, squeeze the biceps and hold briefly.
Breathe in and bring the bar back down under control.

exercises.name: Barbell Curls Lying Against An Incline
instructions: Lie against an incline bench, with the arms holding a barbell and hanging down in a horizontal line
Breathe out as you carry out this portion of the movement

exercises.name: Barbell Deadlift
instructions: Stand with a loaded barbell in front of the shins.
Bend the knees and hinge forward with a straight back, then take a medium overhand grip.
Drive with the legs and bring the torso upright while breathing out.
At the top, lift the chest and draw the shoulder blades back.
Reverse by bending the knees and leaning the torso forward, keeping the back straight.

exercises.name: Barbell Full Squat
instructions: Set the bar in a rack and take it across the upper back with both hands.
Lift it clear of the rack, step back, and set the feet about shoulder width with the toes turned slightly out.
Keep the head up and the back straight, then sit the hips back as the knees bend.
Descend under control while maintaining an upright posture.
Push through the heel or mid-foot, straighten the legs, and extend the hips to return to the start.

exercises.name: Barbell Glute Bridge
instructions: Begin seated on the ground with a loaded barbell over the legs
Roll the bar so that it is directly above the hips, and lay down flat on the floor
Begin the movement by driving through with the heels, extending the hips vertically through the bar

exercises.name: Barbell Guillotine Bench Press
instructions: Using a medium width grip , lift the bar from the rack and hold it straight over the neck with the arms locked
As you breathe in, bring the bar down slowly until it is about 1 inch from the neck
After a second pause, bring the bar back to the start as you breathe out and push the bar using the chest muscles
Lock the arms and squeeze the chest in the contracted position, hold for a second and then start coming down slowly again
When you are done, position the bar back in the rack

exercises.name: Barbell Hack Squat
instructions: Stand up straight as holding a barbell behind you at arms length and the feet at shoulder width
A shoulder width grip is best with the palms of the hands facing back
As keeping the head and eyes up and back straight, squat until the upper thighs are parallel to the floor

exercises.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
instructions: Sit on the ground with a bench directly behind the upper back.
Roll the bar over the hips and lean back so the shoulder blades rest near the top of the bench.
Drive through the feet and extend the hips vertically against the bar.
Reach full extension, then reverse the motion to the start.

exercises.name: Barbell Incline Bench Press - Medium Grip
instructions: Using a medium-width grip , lift the bar from the rack and hold it straight over you with the arms locked
After a second pause, bring the bar back to the start as you breathe out and push the bar using the chest muscles
Lock the arms in the contracted position, squeeze the chest, hold for a second and then start coming down slowly again
When you are done, position the bar back in the rack

exercises.name: Barbell Incline Shoulder Raise
instructions: Using a medium width grip , lift the bar from the rack and hold it straight over you with the arms straight
As keeping the arms straight, lift the bar by protracting the shoulder blades, raising the shoulders from the bench as you breathe out
Bring back the bar to the start as you breathe in

exercises.name: Barbell Lunge
instructions: Set the bar in a rack, take it across the back with both hands, and lift it clear.
Step back from the rack, then step forward with the right leg and lower through the hips.
Keep the torso upright and stay balanced.
Breathe in as you descend.

exercises.name: Barbell Lunges Standing
instructions: Set barbell on the back of the shoulders
Step should bring you forward so that the supporting legs knee can touch the floor

exercises.name: Barbell Rear Delt Row
instructions: Stand up straight as holding a barbell using a wide and overhand grip
Bend knees slightly and bend over as you keep the natural arch of the back
As keeping the upper arms perpendicular to the torso, pull the barbell up towards the upper chest as you squeeze the rear delts and you breathe out

exercises.name: Barbell Reverse Wrist Curl
instructions: Sitting on a bench, take hold of a barbell with the palms facing down and the hands shoulder-width apart
Curl the knuckles towards the face, lifting the barbell

exercises.name: Barbell Rollout from Bench
instructions: Position a loaded barbell on the ground, near the end of a bench
As you roll out, flex the shoulder to roll the bar above the head

exercises.name: Barbell Romanian Deadlift (RDL)
instructions: Push the hips back while keeping a slight bend in the knees.
Lower the barbell along the front of the thighs and shins with a neutral spine.
Keep the bar close to the body throughout.

exercises.name: Barbell Row (Overhand)
instructions: Maintain tension in the lats and back muscles

exercises.name: Barbell Row (Underhand)
instructions: Maintain tension in the lats and back muscles

exercises.name: Barbell Seated Calf Raise
instructions: Position a block about 12 inches in front of a flat bench
Sit on the bench and position the ball of the feet on the block
Have someone position a barbell over the upper thighs about 3 inches above the knees and hold it there
Raise up on the toes as high as possible as you squeeze the calves and as you breathe out

exercises.name: Barbell Shoulder Press
instructions: Set a barbell in a rack just above head height and sit on a bench with back support.
Take a pronated grip and hold the bar at shoulder level, slightly in front of the head.
Breathe in and lower the bar under control to the shoulders.
Breathe out and press the bar back to the start.

exercises.name: Barbell Shrug
instructions: Stand up straight with the feet at shoulder width as you hold a barbell with both hands in front of you using a pronated grip
Raise the shoulders up as far as you can go as you breathe out and hold the contraction for a second
Refrain from trying to lift the barbell by using the biceps
Slowly return to the start as you breathe in

exercises.name: Barbell Shrug Behind The Back
instructions: Stand up straight with the feet at shoulder width as you hold a barbell with both hands behind the back using a pronated grip
Raise the shoulders up as far as you can go as you breathe out and hold the contraction for a second
Refrain from trying to lift the barbell by using the biceps
Slowly return to the start as you breathe in

exercises.name: Barbell Side Bend
instructions: Stand up straight as holding a barbell placed on the back of the shoulders
As keeping the back straight and the head up, bend only at the waist to the right as far as possible
Hold for a second and come back up to the start as you exhale

exercises.name: Barbell Side Split Squat
instructions: Stand up straight as holding a barbell placed on the back of the shoulders
The feet should be placed wide apart with the foot of the lead leg angled out to the side
Lower the body towards the side of the angled foot by bending the knee and hip of the lead leg and as keeping the opposite leg only slightly bent
Breathe in as you lower the body
Return to the start by extending the hip and knee of the lead leg
Breathe out as you carry out this movement

exercises.name: Barbell Squat
instructions: Hold on to the bar using both arms at each side and lift it off the rack by first pushing with the legs and at the same time straightening the torso
Step away from the rack and position the legs using a shoulder width medium stance with the toes slightly pointed out
Keep the head up at all times and also maintain a straight back
Begin to raise the bar as you exhale by pushing the floor with the heel of the foot as you straighten the legs again and go back to the start

exercises.name: Barbell Squat To A Bench
instructions: To begin, first position a flat bench or a box behind you
Hold on to the bar using both arms at each side and lift it off the rack by first pushing with the legs and at the same time straightening the torso
Step away from the rack and position the legs using a shoulder width medium stance with the toes slightly pointed out
Keep the head up at all times as looking down will get you off balance and also maintain a straight back

exercises.name: Barbell Step Ups
instructions: Stand up straight as holding a barbell placed on the back of the shoulders and stand upright behind an elevated platform
Position the right foot on the elevated platform
Step on the platform by extending the hip and the knee of the right leg
Breathe out as you carry out the force required to come up

exercises.name: Barbell Walking Lunge
instructions: Begin standing with the feet shoulder width apart and a barbell across the upper back
Step forward with one leg, flexing the knees to drop the hips
Descend until the rear knee nearly touches the ground
Drive through the heel of the lead foot and extend both knees to raise yourself back up
Step forward with the rear foot, repeating the lunge on the opposite leg

exercises.name: Barbell Wrist Curl
instructions: Sitting on a bench, take hold of a barbell with the palms facing up and the hands shoulder-width apart
Carry out the movement by curling the palms and wrists towards the face

exercises.name: Battle Ropes
instructions: Hold the ends of the rope at arm's length in front of the hips with the hands shoulder-width apart
Brace the core and begin alternately raising and lowering each arm explosively

exercises.name: Battling Ropes
instructions: Standing in front of the rope, take an end in each hand with the arms extended at the side
Continue alternating the left and right arms, whipping the ropes up and down as fast as you can

exercises.name: Bear crawl pull through
instructions: Position a dumbbell at around hip level and assume a bear crawl position
Position the hand back on the floor

exercises.name: Bear Crawl Sled Drags
instructions: Bend down so that the hands are on the ground
Use the hands to maintain balance and to help pull
Try to keep the back flat as you move over a given distance

exercises.name: Bear Walk 2
instructions: Move by stepping with the R palm and L foot, then the L palm and R foot

exercises.name: Behind Head Chest Stretch
instructions: Sit upright on the floor with the partner behind you
Position the hands behind the hand, and push the elbows back as far as you can
The partner should hold the elbows
Gently attempt to pull the elbows forward with the hands still behind the head for 10 or more seconds
Now, relax the muscles and have the partner gently pull the elbows back as far as it comfortable for you

exercises.name: Behind the Back Cable Lateral Raise
Bench Dips
instructions: The legs will be extended forward, bent at the waist and perpendicular to the torso
Slowly lower the body as you inhale by bending at the elbows until you lower yourself far enough to where there is an angle slightly smaller than 90 degrees between the upper arm and the forearm
Using the triceps to bring the torso up again, lift yourself back to the start

exercises.name: Bench Dips On Floor HD
instructions: Triceps dips on floor are one of the most effective exercises to increase arm strength and also build lean muscle in the upper arms

exercises.name: Bench Jump
instructions: Stand with the feet shoulder width apart
Carry out a short squat in preparation for the jump
Swing the arms behind you

exercises.name: Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench and take a grip slightly wider than the shoulders.
Breathe in and bring the bar down under control until it lightly meets the chest.
Press the bar back up to the start and breathe out.

exercises.name: Bench Press Narrow Grip
instructions: Lower the bar with control to the lower chest
Keep the elbows tucked in tight against the torso—do not let them flare out
Press the bar straight back up, squeezing the triceps at the top

exercises.name: Bench Press - Powerlifting
instructions: Begin by lying on the bench, getting the head beyond the bar if possible
Use the feet to drive the traps into the bench
Pull the bar out of the rack without protracting the shoulders
Pause when the barbell touches the torso, and then drive the bar up with as much force as possible

exercises.name: Bench Press - With Bands
instructions: Extend the arms so that you are holding the band handles in front of you at shoulder width
Once at shoulder width, turn the wrists forward so that the palms of the hands are facing away from you
Bring down the handles slowly until the elbow forms a 90 degree angle
As you breathe out, bring the handles up using the pectoral muscles

exercises.name: Bench Press with Chains
instructions: Adjust the leader chain, shortening it to the desired length.position the chains on the sleeves of the bar
Use the feet to drive the traps into the bench
Pull the bar out of the rack without protracting the shoulders
Pause when the barbell touches the torso, and then drive the bar up with as much force as possible

exercises.name: Bench Sprint
instructions: Stand on the ground with one foot resting on a bench or box with the heel close to the edge
Push off with the foot on top of the bench, extending through the hip and knee
Land with the opposite foot on top of the box, returning the other foot back to the start position

exercises.name: Benchpress Dumbbells
instructions: Carefully lean back as driving the dumbbells toward the chest with the knees
The “Leg Drive” and Posture: Plant the feet firmly on the floor
Retract the shoulder blades and maintain a slight natural lumbar curve
Eccentric Phase : Lower the dumbbells in a controlled manner toward the sides of the chest

exercises.name: Bent-Arm Barbell Pullover
instructions: Hold the bar straight over the chest with a bend in the arms

exercises.name: Bent-Arm Dumbbell Pullover
instructions: Position a dumbbell standing up on a flat bench

exercises.name: Bent High Pulls
instructions: Bend over slightly as holding two dumbbells
Pull the dumbbells up to the chest, keeping the elbows as high as you can

exercises.name: Bent-Knee Hip Raise
instructions: Bend the knees at around a 75 degree angle and lift the feet off the floor by around 2 inches
Using the lower abs, bring the knees in towards you as you maintain the 75 degree angle bend in the legs
Breathe out as you carry out this portion of the movement
Squeeze the abs at the top for a second and then return to the start slowly as you breathe in

exercises.name: Bent-Leg Hamstring Stretch
instructions: Lie on the back with one leg straight on the floor
Hold the other leg behind the knee or the back of the thigh and pull it towards the chest, keeping the knee bent, until you feel a stretch in the hamstrings
Hold the position as breathing calmly

exercises.name: Bent Over Barbell Row
instructions: Take a barbell with a pronated grip and soften the knees.
Hinge at the waist with a straight back until the torso is almost parallel to the floor.
Keep the head up and let the bar hang in front of the shins with the arms perpendicular to the floor.
Brace the torso, breathe out, and draw the bar up.
Squeeze the back at the top and pause briefly.
Breathe in and lower the bar under control.

exercises.name: Bent over Cable Flye
instructions: Holding the upper body at an approximate 105° angle

exercises.name: Bent Over Dumbbell Rear Delt Raise With Head On Bench
instructions: Stand up straight as holding a dumbbell in each hand and with an incline bench in front of you
As keeping the back straight and maintaining the natural arch of the back, lean forward until the forehead touches the bench in front of you
Keeping the torso forward and stationary, and the arms straight with a slight bend at the elbows, lift the dumbbells straight to the side until both arms are parallel to the floor

exercises.name: Bent Over Dumbbell Rows (Single Arm)
instructions: Keep upper body angle constant as contracting the lats to pull you ellbows back pinching the shoulder blades at the top

exercises.name: Bent Over Dumbbell Rows (Two Arms)
instructions: How to carry out It
Hinge at the hips, pushing the glutes back, until the torso is roughly 45–75 degrees to the floor
Keep a slight bend in the knees
Let the dumbbells hang directly below the shoulders with arms fully extended

exercises.name: Bent-over Lateral Raises
instructions: Carry out a lateral raise as maintaining the bend in the elbow

exercises.name: Bent Over Low-Pulley Side Lateral
instructions: Bend at the waist until the torso is nearly parallel to the floor
Raise the right arm, elbow slightly bent, to the side until the arm is parallel to the floor and in line with the right ear
Breathe out as you carry out this step

exercises.name: Bent Over One-Arm Long Bar Row
instructions: Confirm that you either position the other end of the barbell in the corner of two walls
Or set a heavy object on the ground so the barbell cannot slide backward
Bend forward until the torso is as close to parallel with the floor as you can and keep the knees slightly bent
Pull the bar straight up with the elbow in until the plates touch the lower chest
Slowly lower the bar to the start getting a nice stretch on the lats

exercises.name: Bent over row to external rotation
instructions: Bend at the waist to set the forehead on the chair's headrest or table, keeping the back straight
The arms should be hanging straight down, pointed at the floor
Bring the elbows up to shoulder height
The forearms should be pointing down, perpendicular to the biceps
Turn at the elbows back to the previous position

exercises.name: Bent Over Rowing
instructions: Holding a barbell with a pronated grip , bend the knees slightly and bring the torso forward, by bending at the waist, as keeping the back straight until it is almost parallel to the floor
Confirm that you keep the head up
The barbell should hang directly in front of you as the arms hang perpendicular to the floor and the torso
Now, as keeping the torso stationary, breathe out and lift the barbell to you

exercises.name: Bent Over Rowing Reverse
instructions: Take hold of the barbell with a wide grIp and lean forward
Pull now the barbell with a fast movement towards the belly button, not further up
Don't swing with the body and keep the arms next to the body

exercises.name: Bent Over Two-Arm Long Bar Row
instructions: Confirm that you either position the other end of the barbell in the corner of two walls
Or set a heavy object on the ground so the barbell cannot slide backward
Bend forward until the torso is as close to parallel with the floor as you can and keep the knees slightly bent
Pull the bar straight up with the elbows in until the plates touch the lower chest
Slowly lower the bar to the start getting a nice stretch on the lats

exercises.name: Bent Over Two-Dumbbell Row
instructions: As you bend confirm to keep the back straight until it is almost parallel to the floor
Confirm that you keep the head up
As keeping the torso stationary, lift the dumbbells to the side , keeping the elbows close to the body

exercises.name: Bent Over Two-Dumbbell Row With Palms In
instructions: Confirm that you keep the head up
As keeping the torso stationary, lift the dumbbells to the side as you breathe out, squeezing the shoulder blades together

exercises.name: Bent Press
instructions: Clean a kettlebell to the shoulder
Clean the kettlebell to the shoulders by extending through the legs and hips as you raise the kettlebell towards the shoulder
The wrist should turn as you do so
Begin my leaning to the side opposite the kettlebell, continuing until you are able to touch the ground with the free hand, keeping the eyes on the kettlebell
Return to an upright position, with the kettlebell above the head

exercises.name: Biceps Close Grip Pull Down
instructions: On a lat pull down machine, hold the bar keeping the hands relatively close

exercises.name: Biceps Curl Machine
instructions: Sit on the machine with the back against the pad and adjust the seat so the arms are aligned with the machine's handles or pads
Grip the handles firmly, keeping the elbows fixed in position, and curl the handles upward by contracting the biceps
Slowly lower the handles to the start, maintaining control throughout the movement

exercises.name: Biceps Curls With Dumbbell
instructions: Hold two dumbbells, the arms are streched, the hands are on the side, the palms face inwards
At the same time, turn the arms by 90 degrees at the very beginning of the movement

exercises.name: Biceps with TRX
instructions: Take hold of the handles of the TRX straps, lean the body back, arms and legs extended, with the body positioned in a single straight line

exercises.name: bicycle crunches
instructions: Lie on the back with the hands behind the head and legs extended
Lift the shoulders off the ground, bring one knee toward the chest, and twist the torso so the opposite elbow meets the knee
Alternate sides in a pedaling motion, ensuring controlled movements and engaging the core throughout the exercise

exercises.name: Bicycling
instructions: To begin, seat yourself on the bike and adjust the seat to the height

exercises.name: Bicycling, Stationary
instructions: To begin, seat yourself on the bike and adjust the seat to the height

exercises.name: Bird Dog
instructions: Begin on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips, keeping the spine neutral
Extend the right arm forward and left leg backward simultaneously, keeping hips square
Pause briefly at full extension as engaging the core and glutes

exercises.name: Bizeps Curls Trifecta
instructions: Curl the dumbbell as you outwardly turn the shoulder

exercises.name: Black Widow Knee Slides
instructions: Position) with hands directly beneath the shoulders
Bringing the right knee toward the left hand

exercises.name: Board Press
instructions: Begin by lying on the bench, getting the head beyond the bar if possible
Use the feet to drive the traps into the bench
Pull the bar out of the rack without protracting the shoulders

exercises.name: Body-Up
instructions: You should be supporting the bodyweight on the toes and forearms, keeping the torso straight
Pressing the palms firmly into the ground, extend through the elbows to raise the body from the ground
Keep the torso rigid as you carry out the movement
Slowly lower the forearms back to the ground by allowing the elbows to flex

exercises.name: Body-Ups
instructions: You should be supporting the bodyweight on the toes and forearms, keeping the torso straight
Pressing the palms firmly into the ground, extend through the elbows to raise the body from the ground
Keep the torso rigid as you carry out the movement
Slowly lower the forearms back to the ground by allowing the elbows to flex

exercises.name: Bodyweight Biceps Curl
instructions: Grip the bar with the palms facing you , hands about shoulder-width apart
Lean back with straight arms so that the body is at an angle to the ground
Keeping the elbows high and close to the bar, pull the upper body toward the bar by flexing the elbows, similar to a biceps curl
Keep the core tight and movement slow to maximize tension on the biceps

exercises.name: Bodyweight Flyes
instructions: Position the hands on the bars
After moving the bars as far apart as you can, return to the start by pulling them back together
Exhale as you carry out this movement

exercises.name: Bodyweight Mid Row
instructions: Begin by taking a medium to wide grip on a pull-up apparatus with the palms facing away from you
From a hanging position, tuck the knees to the chest, leaning back and getting the legs over the side of the pull-up apparatus

exercises.name: Bodyweight Squat
instructions: Stand with the feet shoulder width apart
You can position the hands behind the head
Begin the movement by flexing the knees and hips, sitting back with the hips
As you squat, keep the head and chest up and push the knees out

exercises.name: Bodyweight Squat HD
instructions: Squats are very effective for firming and strengthening the legs by acting on the gluteus,hip flexors, quadriceps, hamstrings and inner thigh muscles
Also, bodyweight squats can help shape the glutes and butt

exercises.name: Bodyweight Walking Lunge
instructions: Begin standing with the feet shoulder width apart and the hands on the hips
Step forward with one leg, flexing the knees to drop the hips
Descend until the rear knee nearly touches the ground
Drive through the heel of the lead foot and extend both knees to raise yourself back up
Step forward with the rear foot, repeating the lunge on the opposite leg

exercises.name: Bosu Ball Cable Crunch With Side Bends
instructions: Take hold of a Bosu Ball and position it in front and center of the cable machine
Lie down on the Bosu Ball with the small of the back arched around the ball
With both hands, reach back and take hold of the handle of each cable
With the feet positioned in a wide stance, extend the arms straight out in front of you and in between the knees
Keep the arms straight and in-line with the upward angle of the cable
Slowly descend back to the start with the back arched around the Bosu Ball and the abdominals elongated

exercises.name: Bottoms Up
instructions: Begin by lying on the back on the ground
To carry out the movement, tuck the knees toward the chest by flexing the hips and knees
Following this, extend the legs directly above you so that they are perpendicular to the ground
Turn and elevate the pelvis to raise the glutes from the floor

exercises.name: Bottoms-Up Clean From The Hang Position
Box Jump (Multiple Response)
instructions: Assume a relaxed stance facing the box or platform about an arm's length away
Immediately drop or jump back down to the original starting position

exercises.name: box jumps
instructions: Jump from a standing position onto the box, stretch the body, then step down again

exercises.name: Box Squat
instructions: Squeeze the shoulder blades together and turn the elbows forward, attempting to bend the bar across the shoulders

exercises.name: Box squat
instructions: Stand with the feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointed slightly outward
Engage the core and keep the back neutral
Sit back as if going to sit on a chair, bending the knees and lowering the hips towards the box
Keep the core tight and back straight throughout the movement
Then, press through the heels to drive yourself back up to the start

exercises.name: Box Squat with Bands
instructions: Squeeze the shoulder blades together and turn the elbows forward, attempting to bend the bar across the shoulders
Keep the head facing forward

exercises.name: Box Squat with Chains
instructions: Squeeze the shoulder blades together and turn the elbows forward, attempting to bend the bar across the shoulders

exercises.name: Braced Squat
instructions: Stand with feet slightly wider than shoulder-width apart, as standing as tall as you can
Keep the core tight and stand with a natural arch in the back

exercises.name: Brachialis-SMR
instructions: Lie on the side, with the upper arm against the foam roller

exercises.name: Bradford/Rocky Presses
instructions: The grip should be wider than shoulder width and it should create a 90-degree angle between the forearm and the upper arm as the barbell goes down
Lift the bar back up to the start as you exhale
Lower the bar down to the start slowly as you inhale

exercises.name: Bretzel stretch
instructions: How to carry out the Bretzel Stretch
Lie on the back on a flat surface, such as a mat
Bend the knees and position the feet flat on the ground
Lift the right leg and cross it over the left leg, placing the right foot on the outside of the left knee
Extend the left arm out to the side at shoulder height, keeping it straight
Maintain this position , breathing deeply and relaxing into the stretch

exercises.name: Bulgarian Squat with Dumbbells
instructions: Elevating the back leg on a bench creates instability and increases the range of motion of the exercise

exercises.name: Burpees
instructions: Jump, lay down on the chest, do a pushup then jump

exercises.name: Butt Lift (Bridge)
instructions: Lie flat on the floor on the back with the hands by the side and the knees bent
The feet should be placed around shoulder width
Pushing mainly with the heels, lift the hips off the floor as keeping the back straight

exercises.name: Butt-Ups
instructions: Begin a pushup position but with the elbows on the ground and resting on the forearms
Raise the glutes toward the ceiling, squeezing the abs tightly to close the distance between the ribcage and hips
Exhale as you carry out this portion of the movement
Lower back down slowly to the start as you breathe in

exercises.name: Butterfly
instructions: Sit on the machine with the back flat on the pad
Push the handles together slowly as you squeeze the chest in the middle
Return back to the start slowly as you inhale until the chest muscles are fully stretched

exercises.name: Butterfly Narrow Grip
instructions: Press the arms together till the handles are practically together

exercises.name: Butterfly
instructions: Press the arms together till the handles are practically together

exercises.name: Butterfly Sit Up
instructions: The ab muscles, bring the upper body off the ground as you open the arms

exercises.name: Butterfly Stretch
instructions: Sit in a prayer position with the soles of the feet gently pressed together

exercises.name: Butterfly Superman
instructions: Lie on stomach, intertwine fingers behind the head and start raising the head and raise elbows as far as they go

exercises.name: Cable Chest Press
instructions: Keep the shoulder blades retracted as you carry out the movement
After pausing at full extension, return to th start, keeping tension on the cables
You can also carry out this movement with the back off the pad, at an incline or decline, or alternate hands

exercises.name: Cable Chest Press - Decline
instructions: Start with the hand as close to the chest as possible, and then press against the cable at a slight decline and aiming towards the center of the chest

exercises.name: Cable Chest Press - Incline
instructions: Start with the hand as close to the chest as possible, and then press against the cable at a slight incline and aiming towards the center of the chest

exercises.name: Cable Crossover
instructions: Step forward in front of an imaginary straight line between both pulleys as pulling the arms together in front of you
With a slight bend on the elbows in order to prevent stress at the biceps tendon, extend the arms to the side in a wide arc until you feel a stretch on the chest
Breathe in as you carry out this portion of the movement
Return the arms back to the start as you breathe out

exercises.name: Cable Crunch
instructions: Exhale as you carry out this portion of the movement and hold the contraction for a second
Slowly return to the start as you inhale
Confirm that you keep constant tension on the abs throughout the movement

exercises.name: Cable Deadlifts
instructions: To begin, squat down be flexing the hips and knees until you can reach the handles
After grasping them, begin the ascent
Driving through the heels extend the hips and knees keeping the hands hanging at the side
Keep the head and chest up throughout the movement

exercises.name: Cable External Rotation
instructions: Position yourself to the side of the band and with the hand that is opposite of the band, reach out and take hold of the handle
Bring the band to the chest keeping the elbow bent in a 90 degree angle then slowly turn the arm in a backhand motion so that the band externally rotates out

exercises.name: Cable Fly Lower Chest
instructions: Arms extended out to the sides in a “Y” shape
Bring the hands downward and together in front of the lower chest or upper abs, in a smooth arc motion
Squeeze the chest hard at the bottom
Slowly raise the arms back up along the same path until you feel a good stretch in the chest

exercises.name: Cable Fly Middle Chest
instructions: Arms extended out to the sides , feeling a stretch in the chest
Bring the hands together in front of the chest in a wide hugging motion
Focus on squeezing the chest at the center
Do not lock the elbows or turn it into a press
Slowly open the arms back to the start, maintaining tension on the chest

exercises.name: Cable Fly Upper Chest
instructions: Bring the hands upward and together in front of the upper chest — roughly at chin to collarbone level
Slowly let the arms move back down and out to the sides, keeping control and tension

exercises.name: Cable Front Raise with a small bar
instructions: The Cable Front Raise with a small bar isolates the anterior deltoids by providing constant tension, requiring you to stand facing away from a low pulley
How to carry out the Cable Front Raise
Stand with the back to the machine, holding the bar with an overhand grip at hip level, arms extended but not locked
Exhale and slowly raise the bar straight up in front of you, keeping a slight bend in the elbows, until the hands reach shoulder height
Inhale as you slowly and controllably lower the bar back to the start, maintaining tension

exercises.name: Cable Hammer Curls - Rope Attachment
instructions: Set the elbows in by the side and keep them there stationary during the entire movement
Using the biceps, pull the arms up as you exhale until the biceps touch the forearms
Remember to keep the elbows in and the upper arms stationary

exercises.name: Cable Hip Adduction
instructions: Stand on the foot that does not have the ankle cuff and allow the leg with the cuff to be pulled towards the low pulley
Carry out the movement by moving the leg with the ankle cuff in front of the far leg by using the inner thighs to abduct the hip
Slowly return to the start as you breathe in

exercises.name: Cable Incline Pushdown
instructions: Palms down) shoulder width grip and extend the arms in front of you
Keeping the upper arms stationary, lift the arms back in a semi circle until the bar is straight over the head

exercises.name: Cable Incline Triceps Extension
instructions: Palms down) narrow grip and keep the elbows tucked in to the sides

exercises.name: Cable Internal Rotation
instructions: Sit next to a low pulley sideways and grasp the single hand cable attachment with the arm nearest to the cable
Position the elbow against the side with the elbow bent at 90° and the arm pointing towards the pulley
Pull the single hand cable attachment toward the body by internally rotating the shoulder until the forearm is across the abs

exercises.name: Cable Iron Cross
instructions: Stand directly between both pulleys with the arms extended out to the sides
Keeping the elbows extended, pull the arms straight to the sides
Return the arms back to the start after a pause at the peak contraction

exercises.name: Cable Judo Flip
instructions: Stand with the side to the cable with a wide stance, and take hold of the rope with both hands
Twist the body away from the pulley as you bring the rope over the shoulder like you're performing a judo flip

exercises.name: Cable Lateral Raises (Single Arm)
instructions: Reach across the body and take hold of the handle with a neutral grip
Keep the elbow slightly bent and pull the handle across the body and raise laterally
Slowly lower the handle back to the start under control

exercises.name: Cable Lying Triceps Extension
instructions: With the arms extended, position the bar over the torso
Lower the bar by bending at the elbow as keeping the upper arms stationary and elbows in
Breathe in as you carry out this portion of the movement
Exhale as you carry out this portion of the movement

exercises.name: Cable One Arm Tricep Extension
instructions: Pull the handle down so that the upper arm and elbow are locked in to the side of the body
As you contract the triceps, move the single handle attachment down to the side until the arm is straight
Breathe out as you carry out this movement

exercises.name: Cable Preacher Curl
instructions: Position a preacher bench about 2 feet in front of a pulley machine
Sit at the preacher bench with the elbow and upper arms firmly on top of the bench pad and have someone hand you the bar from the low pulley
Take hold of the bar and fully extend the arms on top of the preacher bench pad
Exhale as you carry out this motion

exercises.name: Cable Press Around
instructions: Elbow fully flexed and tight to the side
Hold the other side of the functional trainer with the corresponding hand
As keeping the chest proud, extend the elbow at 45 degrees
Shy of lockout and contract the chest at the top of the range of motion

exercises.name: Cable pull through
instructions: To carry out it, attach a rope to the lowest pulley setting, face away from the machine with the rope between the legs, and step forward to create tension
Keeping the back flat and knees slightly soft, push the hips backward as if trying to close a door behind you until you feel a deep stretch in the hamstrings
The knees should not bend deeply, and the arms should remain straight and relaxed, acting only as hooks for the rope

exercises.name: Cable Rear Delt Fly
instructions: Take hold of the left pulley with the right hand and the right pulley with the left hand, crossing them in front of you
Initiate the movement by moving the arms back and outward, keeping the arms straight as you carry out the movement

exercises.name: Cable Rear-Delt Fly (single arm)
instructions: Keep the torso still and focus on the rear delt doing the work

exercises.name: Cable Reverse Crunch
instructions: Sit down with the feet toward the pulley and attach the cable to the ankles
Lie down, elevate the legs and bend the knees at a 90-degree angle
Pause for a moment and in a slow and controlled manner drop the hips and bring the legs back to the starting 90-degree angle

exercises.name: Cable Rope Overhead Triceps Extension
instructions: Slowly lower the rope behind the head as you hold the upper arms stationary
Inhale as you carry out this movement and pause when the triceps are fully stretched
Return to the start by flexing the triceps as you breathe out

exercises.name: Cable Rope Rear-Delt Rows
instructions: The arms should be extended and parallel to the floor with the elbows flared out
Keep the lower back upright and slide the hips back so that the knees are slightly bent
Pull the cable attachment towards the upper chest, just below the neck, as you keep the elbows up and out to the sides
Inhale as you carry out this portion of the movement

exercises.name: Cable Russian Twists
instructions: Lie on a stability ball perpendicular to the cable and take hold of the handle with one hand
Take hold of the handle with both hands and fully extend the arms above the chest
Keep the hips elevated and abs engaged
Turn the torso away from the pulley for a full-quarter rotation

exercises.name: Cable Seated Crunch
instructions: Breathe out as you carry out this step

exercises.name: Cable Seated Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand in the middle of two low pulleys that are opposite to each other and position a flat bench right behind you (in perpendicular fashion to you
Sit at the edge of the flat bench behind you with the feet placed in front of the knees
Bend forward as keeping the back flat and rest the torso on the thighs
The pulleys should run under the knees and the arms will be extended with palms facing each other and a slight bend at the elbows
As keeping the arms stationary, raise the upper arms to the sides until they are parallel to the floor and at shoulder height
Maintain upper arms perpendicular to torso and a fixed elbow position throughout exercise

exercises.name: Cable Shoulder Press
instructions: Keeping the head and chest up, extend through the elbow to press the handles directly over head

exercises.name: Cable Shrug-In
instructions: Attach a D-handle to each of two low pulleys, stand between them and shrug the shoulders up and inwards, using the upper traps

exercises.name: Cable Shrugs
instructions: Stand erect close to the pulley with the arms extended in front of you holding the bar

exercises.name: Cable Tricep Kickback
instructions: Take hold of onto the handle, and pull the elbow up and back slightly above
Keep the upper arm to be parallel to the ground for the

exercises.name: Cable Woodchoppers
instructions: Take hold of the pulley handle, fully extend the arms and bring the arms forward and across the body
Hold at the end of the movement and slowly return to start

exercises.name: Cable Wrist Curl
instructions: Use the arms to take hold of the cable bar with a narrow to shoulder width supinated grip and bring them up so that the forearms are resting against the top of the thighs
The wrists should be hanging just beyond the knees
Start out by curling the wrist upwards and exhaling
Slowly lower the wrists back down to the start as inhaling

exercises.name: Calf-Machine Shoulder Shrug
instructions: Position yourself on the calf machine so that the shoulder pads are above the shoulders
Raise the shoulders up towards the ears as you exhale and hold the contraction for a full second
Slowly return to the start as you inhale

exercises.name: Calf Press
instructions: Adjust the seat so that the legs are only slightly bent in the start position
Carry out the movement by pressing downward through the balls of the feet as far as possible

exercises.name: Calf Press On The Leg Press Machine
instructions: Using a leg press machine, sit down on the machine and position the legs on the platform directly in front of you at a medium foot stance
Lower the safety bars holding the weighted platform in position and press the platform all the way up until the legs are fully extended in front of you without locking the knees
If the leg press unit allows for this, then this is the preferred method of performing the exercise.) the torso and the legs should make perfect 90-degree angle
Carefully position the toes and balls of the feet on the lower portion of the platform with the heels extending off

exercises.name: Calf Press Using Leg Press Machine
instructions: Set the balls of the feet on an extended leg press pad

exercises.name: Calf Raise On A Dumbbell
instructions: Roll the foot slightly forward so that you can get a nice stretch of the calf
Lift the calf as you roll the foot over the top of the handle so that you get a full extension

exercises.name: Calf Raise using Hack Squat Machine
Calf raises, left leg
instructions: Lift the heel until you're standing on the toes
Slowly lower the foot until you almost touch the ground with the heel - don't slam the foot!

exercises.name: Calf Raises on Hackenschmitt Machine
instructions: Position yourself on the machine with the back firmly against the backrest, the feet are on the platform for calf raises

exercises.name: Calf Raises - With Bands
instructions: Take hold of an exercise band and stand on it with the toes making sure that the length of the band between the foot and the arms is the same for both sides
As holding the handles of the band, raise the arms to the side of the head as if you were getting ready to carry out a shoulder press
Keeping the hands by the shoulder, stand up on the toes as you exhale and contract the calves hard at the top

exercises.name: Calf Stretch Elbows Against Wall
instructions: Attempt to keep the heels on the ground

exercises.name: Calf Stretch Hands Against Wall
instructions: Stagger the stance, placing one foot forward
Lean forward and rest the hands on the wall, keeping the heel, hip and head in a straight line
Attempt to keep the heel on the ground

exercises.name: Calves foam roller
instructions: Move the calves slowly over the foam roller

exercises.name: Calves-SMR
instructions: Position a foam roller underneath the lower leg

exercises.name: Car Drivers
instructions: As standing upright, hold a barbell plate in both hands at the 3 and 9 o'clock positions

exercises.name: Carioca Quick Step
instructions: Begin with the feet a few inches apart and the left arm up in a relaxed, athletic position
Avoid turning the feet as you move and continue to look forward as you move to the side

exercises.name: Cat Plank
instructions: On all fours and raise the knees of the floor ever so slightly
Curl the back out and push back from the shoulders as to resemble a cat making itself look large

exercises.name: Cat Stretch
instructions: Position yourself on the floor on the hands and knees
Pull the belly in and round the spine, lower back, shoulders, and neck, letting the head drop

exercises.name: Catch and Overhead Throw
instructions: Begin standing as facing a wall or a partner
Using both hands, position the ball behind the head, stretching as much as possible, and forcefully throw the ball forward

exercises.name: Chain Handle Extension
instructions: The elbows should be pointing straight up
Begin by extending through the elbow, keeping the upper arm still, with the wrists pronated

exercises.name: Chair dips
instructions: Still holding the edge of the chair, arms extended, lift the butt and walk forward slightly so that it is a few inches from the chair
Slowly lower the body, keeping the back straight, until the arms are at a right angle
Raise the body again to the initial position, arms extended

exercises.name: Chair Lower Back Stretch
instructions: Bend to one side with the arm over the head
You can hold onto the chair with the free hand

exercises.name: Chair Squat
instructions: Take the bar with the hands facing forward, unlock it and lift it off the rack by extending the legs
Move the feet forward about 18 inches in front of the bar
Position the legs using a shoulder width stance with the toes slightly pointed out
Begin to raise the bar as you exhale by pushing the floor with the heels of the feet, extending the knees and returning to the start

exercises.name: Chair Upper Body Stretch
instructions: Straighten the arms, keeping the back straight, and pull the upper body forward so you feel a stretch

exercises.name: Chest And Front Of Shoulder Stretch
instructions: Start off by standing with the legs together, holding a bodybar or a broomstick
Take a slightly wider than shoulder width grip on the pole and hold it in front of you with the palms facing down
Carefully lift the pole up and behind the head

exercises.name: Chest Press
instructions: Adjust the seat height so that the grips are parallel to the chest
Use the legs to push the foot forward pedal
Keep the back in contact with the back pad, press outwards
Press the handles away from the chest and exhale
Allow the handles to return to the chest as you inhale

exercises.name: Chest Push from 3 point stance
instructions: Begin in a three point stance, squatted down with the back flat and one hand on the ground
Position the medicine ball directly in front of you
To begin, take the first step as you pull the ball to the chest, positioning both hands to prepare for the throw
As you carry out the second step, explosively release the ball forward as hard as possible

exercises.name: Chest Push (multiple response)
instructions: Carry out the pass by exploding forward and outward with the hips as pushing the ball as hard as possible

exercises.name: Chest Push (single response)
instructions: Carry out the pass by exploding forward and outward with the hips as pushing the ball as far as possible

exercises.name: Chest Push with Run Release
instructions: Hold the medicine ball near the legs
As taking the first step draw the medicine ball into the chest

exercises.name: Chest Stretch on Stability Ball
instructions: Position the elbows on top of the ball, keeping the arm out to the side
Lower the torso towards the floor, keeping the elbow on top of the ball

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Rear Delt Raise
instructions: Lie face-down with the chest supported, keeping the head neutral or looking slightly down to avoid neck strain

exercises.name: Child's Pose
instructions: Lower the buttocks down to sit on the heels
"breathe" into the back

exercises.name: Chin To Chest Stretch
instructions: Position both hands at the rear of the head, fingers interlocked, thumbs pointing down and elbows pointing straight ahead
Slowly pull the head down to the chest

exercises.name: Chin-Up
instructions: Take the pull-up bar with the palms facing the torso and the hands closer than shoulder width.
Keep the torso straight to emphasize the biceps.
Breathe out and draw the torso up until the head is near bar height.
Squeeze the biceps at the top, then lower under control.
Breathe in during the lowering phase.

exercises.name: Chin-up Isometric Hold
instructions: Grip the bar with an underhand grip and pull yourself up until the chin is at or above the bar

exercises.name: Circus Bell
instructions: Begin with the dumbbell between the feet, and grip the handle with both hands
Clean the dumbbell by extending through the hips and knees to deliver the implement to the desired shoulder, letting go with the extra hand
It is best to carry out this event on a thick rubber mat to prevent damage to the floor

exercises.name: Clamshell
instructions: Lift the upper knee as keeping the feet close together, like a “shell opening,” then slowly return to the start
Keep the core stable and the hips aligned

exercises.name: Clamshell to Reverse Clamshell
instructions: Lie on the side with the hips and knees bent, keeping the legs stacked
Lift the top knee into a clamshell position and keep the leg elevated throughout the movement

exercises.name: Clap Push-UP
instructions: Start in a strong push-up position with the hands slightly wider than shoulder-width and core engaged
Lower the body explosively and push off the ground with enough force to lift the hands

exercises.name: Claps over the head
instructions: Stand with the feet shoulder width apart
Raise the arms and clap over the head

exercises.name: Clean
instructions: Begin the first pull by driving through the heels, extending the knees
At peak extension, aggressively pull yourself down, rotating the elbows under the bar as you do so

exercises.name: Clean and Jerk
instructions: Begin the first pull by driving through the heels, extending the knees
At peak extension, aggressively pull yourself down, rotating the elbows under the bar as you do so

exercises.name: Clean and Press
instructions: As keeping the back flat, bend at the knees and hips so that you can take hold of the bar with the arms fully extended and a pronated grip that is slightly wider than shoulder width
The bar should travel close to the body, and you should keep the elbows out

exercises.name: Clean Deadlift
instructions: Begin standing with a barbell close to the shins
Begin by driving through the floor through the front of the heels

exercises.name: Clean from Blocks
instructions: Begin the first pull by driving through the heels, extending the knees
Aggressively pull yourself down, rotating the elbows under the bar as you do so

exercises.name: Clean Pull
instructions: Begin the first pull by driving through the heels, extending the knees

exercises.name: Clean Shrug
instructions: Shrug the shoulders towards the ears

exercises.name: ClimbMill
instructions: Adjust the speed and intensity to match the fitness level

exercises.name: Clock Push-Up
instructions: Keep the body straight throughout the movement
Descend by flexing at the elbow, lowering the chest toward the ground
As you accelerate up, move the outside foot away from the direction of travel

exercises.name: Close-Grip Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Using a close grip , lift the bar from the rack and hold it straight over you with the arms locked
As you breathe in, come down slowly until you feel the bar on the middle chest
After a second pause, bring the bar back to the start as you breathe out and push the bar using the triceps muscles
Lock the arms in the contracted position, hold for a second and then start coming down slowly again
When you are done, position the bar back in the rack

exercises.name: Close-Grip Dumbbell Press
instructions: Position a dumbbell standing up on a flat bench
Initiate the movement by lowering the dumbbell to the chest
Return to the start by extending the elbows

exercises.name: Close-Grip EZ Bar Curl
instructions: Stand up with the torso upright as holding an E-Z Curl Bar at the closer inner handle
Slowly begin to bring the bar back to start as the breathe in

exercises.name: Close-Grip EZ-Bar Curl with Band
instructions: As keeping the upper arms in position, flex the elbows to carry out the curl
Slowly begin to bring the bar back to start as the breathe in

exercises.name: Close-Grip EZ-Bar Press
instructions: Using a narrow grip lift the bar and hold it straight over the torso with the elbows in
Lower the bar down to the lower chest as you breathe in
Keep the elbows in as you carry out this movement
Using the triceps to push the bar back up, press it back to the start by extending the elbows as you exhale

exercises.name: Close-Grip Front Lat Pulldown
instructions: Confirm that you adjust the knee pad of the machine to fit the height
Take hold of the bar with the palms facing forward using the prescribed grip
For a wide grip, the hands need to be spaced out at a distance wider than the shoulder width
For a medium grip, the hands need to be spaced out at a distance equal to the shoulder width and for a close grip at a distance smaller than the shoulder width

exercises.name: Close-grip Lat Pull Down
instructions: Grip the pull-down bar with the hands closer than shoulder width apart, with the palms facing away from you
Pull the bar down towards the chest, keeping the elbows close to the sides as you come down
Pull the shoulders back at the end of the motion

exercises.name: Close-grip Press-ups
instructions: Bend the elbows to slowly bring the chest to the floor
Keep the elbows close to the body as you push back up explosively

exercises.name: Close-Grip Push-Up off of a Dumbbell
instructions: Lie on the floor and position the hands on an upright dumbbell
Lower the body, allowing the elbows to flex as you inhale
Keep the body straight, not allowing the hips to rise or sag
Press yourself back up to the start by extending the elbows
Breathe out as you carry out this step

exercises.name: Close-Grip Standing Barbell Curl
instructions: Stand with the torso straight and the head up
You will keep the upper arms and elbows stationary throughout the movement
Curl the bar up in a semicircular motion until the forearms touch the biceps
Exhale as you carry out this portion of the movement and contract the biceps hard for a second at the top

exercises.name: Close-grip supinated lat pulldown
instructions: Keep the rest of the body still

exercises.name: Cobra Stretch
instructions: To carry out, lie face down on the floor with the hands placed under the shoulders
Press the palms into the floor and lift the chest as keeping the hips on the ground
Keep the elbows slightly bent and the shoulders relaxed

exercises.name: Cocoons
instructions: Begin by lying on the back on the ground
To carry out the movement, tuck the knees toward the chest, rotating the pelvis to lift the glutes from the floor
As you do so, flex the spine, bringing the arms back over the head to carry out a simultaneous crunch motion

exercises.name: Conan's Wheel
instructions: Position the bar in the crook of the elbow and hold onto the wrist
Do not hold the breath during the event

exercises.name: Concentration Curls
instructions: Sit down on a flat bench with one dumbbell in front of you between the legs
The legs should be spread with the knees bent and feet on the floor
Position the back of the right upper arm on the top of the inner right thigh
Turn the palm of the hand until it is facing forward away from the thigh
The arm should be extended and the dumbbell should be above the floor
Slowly begin to bring the dumbbells back to start as the breathe in

exercises.name: Copenhagen Adduction Exercise
instructions: Lie on the side with the elbow placed directly under the shoulder, similar to a side plank position
Position the upper leg on a bench with the inside of the foot or ankle resting on it
Lift the hips and hold the body in a straight line as keeping the lower leg off the floor
The exercise strongly activates the adductors of the upper leg as also challenging the core and hip stabilizers

exercises.name: Couch Stretch
instructions: Extend one leg backwards, resting the foot "laces-down" on the edge of the bench
Lower yourself until the rear knee is on the floor and you are in a lunge position, with the torso hanging forwards slightly
Brace the core, tense the rear glute, and straighten up the torso to vertical, under control

exercises.name: Cross-Bench Dumbbell Pullovers
instructions: Lie on the back across a flat bench so only the upper back and shoulders are in contact with the bench
With the dumbbell supported at arm's length directly about the chest, bend the arms about 15 degrees and keep them bent throughout the movement

exercises.name: Cross-Body Cable Y-Raise
instructions: Carry out a motion akin to drawing a sword from across the body

exercises.name: Cross-Body Crunch
instructions: Lie flat on the back and bend the knees about 60 degrees
Keep the feet flat on the floor and position the hands loosely behind the head
Curl up and bring the right elbow and shoulder across the body as bring the left knee in toward the left shoulder at the same time
Reach with the elbow and try to touch the knee
Exhale as you carry out this movement

exercises.name: Cross Body Hammer Curl
instructions: As keeping the palms facing in and without twisting the arm, curl the dumbbell of the right arm up towards the left shoulder as you exhale

exercises.name: Cross-Body Stretch
instructions: Extend the right arm straight across the chest toward the left
Keep the shoulder down as you do this

exercises.name: Cross Over - With Bands
instructions: Raise the arms to the sides, parallel to the floor, perpendicular to the torso and with the palms facing forward
As keeping the arms straight, bring them across the chest in a semicircular motion to the front as you exhale and flex the pecs
Slowly return to the start as you inhale

exercises.name: Crossbody Hamstring Stretch
instructions: As standing, cross one leg behind the other

exercises.name: Crossbody Leg Swings
instructions: Swing one leg across the front of the body, then back and out to the side

exercises.name: Crossover Reverse Lunge
instructions: Stand with the feet shoulder width apart
Carry out a rear lunge by stepping back with one foot and flexing the hips and front knee
As you do so, turn the torso across the front leg

exercises.name: Crucifix
instructions: Begin standing, and raise the arms out to the side holding the implements

exercises.name: Crunch - Hands Overhead
instructions: Lie on the floor with the back flat and knees bent with around a 60-degree angle between the hamstrings and the calves
Keep the feet flat on the floor and stretch the arms overhead with the palms crossed
Curl the upper body forward and bring the shoulder blades just off the floor
At all times, keep the arms aligned with the head, neck and shoulder
Slowly lower down to the start as you inhale

exercises.name: Crunch - Legs On Exercise Ball
instructions: Lie flat on the back with the feet resting on an exercise ball and the knees bent at a 90 degree angle
Position the feet three to four inches apart and point the toes inward so they touch
Position the hands lightly on either side of the head keeping the elbows in
Don't lock the fingers behind the head
Push the small of the back down in the floor in order to better isolate the abdominal muscles
Squeeze the abdominals hard at the top and hold for a second

exercises.name: Crunches
instructions: Lie flat on the back with the feet flat on the ground, or resting on a bench with the knees bent at a 90 degree angle
Position the hands lightly on either side of the head keeping the elbows in
Don't lock the fingers behind the head
As pushing the small of the back down in the floor to better isolate the abdominal muscles, begin to roll the shoulders off the floor
Continue to push down as hard as you can with the lower back as you contract the abdominals and exhale

exercises.name: Crunches on Machine
instructions: Sit on the machine, set both feet firmly on the ground

exercises.name: Crunches
instructions: From this position move the upper body up till the head or elbows touch the knees
Do this movement by rolling up the back

exercises.name: Crunches With Cable
instructions: Take the cable on the hands and hold it next to the temples
Knee down and hold the upper body straight and bend forward

exercises.name: Crunches With Legs Up
instructions: On the back, legs extended straight up, reach toward the toes with the hands and lift the shoulder blades off the ground and back

exercises.name: Cuban Press
instructions: Raise the upper arms so that they are parallel to the floor, allowing the lower arms to hang in the "scarecrow" position
Keep the upper arms in position, rotating the upper arms until the wrists are directly above the elbows, the forearms perpendicular to the floor
Press the dumbbells by extending at the elbows, straightening the arms overhead
Return to the start as you breathe in by reversing the steps

exercises.name: Curl De Muñeca Con Barra
instructions: Grip a bar with an overhand grip at a width similar to the shoulders
Kneel in front of a flat bench and rest the backs of the forearms on it
Eccentric Phase : Lower the bar in a controlled manner by extending the wrists toward the floor
Concentric Phase : First, close the fingers to secure the bar, then flex the wrists upward explosively but in a controlled manner, bringing the bar as high as possible
Strongly contract the forearms at the top position for one second
Keep the forearms firmly pressed against the bench throughout the exercise

exercises.name: Curl  - With Shoulder Elevated
instructions: Position elbow so that it is about level with the shoulder
Curl the wieght to the shoulder

exercises.name: Dancer's Stretch
instructions: Cross the right leg over the left, keeping the knee bent
Position the left arm on the right leg and the right hand on the floor
Turn the upper body to the right, and hold

exercises.name: DB Cross Body Hammer Curls
instructions: Hammer curl with a neutral grip, curling the dumbbell across the body towards the opposite shoulder

exercises.name: DB Underhand bench press
instructions: Underhand grip DB, carry out a normal bench press movement, keeping the elbows close to the chest

exercises.name: DB Wrist Extension
instructions: Take hold of two dumbbells with an overhand grip and lay the forearms across the knees
Let the wrists flex fully, then extend the wrists

exercises.name: Dead Bug
instructions: Begin lying on the back with the hands extended above you toward the ceiling
Bring the feet, knees, and hips up to 90 degrees
Exhale hard to bring the ribcage down and flatten the back onto the floor, rotating the pelvis up and squeezing the glutes

exercises.name: Deadbug
