instructions: Lie on the back, with the hips and knees bent to 90°
Pull the lower back to the floor to eliminate the gap
"As you extend one leg, exhale as much as you can, keeping the lower back glued to the floor," Dunham says
When you can’t exhale any more, pull the knee back to the start

exercises.name: Deadlift with Chains
instructions: Bend at the hip to grip the bar at shoulder width, allowing the shoulder blades to protract

exercises.name: Deadlifts
instructions: Stand with the feet slightly wider than shoulder width and the bar close to the shins.
Point the toes slightly out, bend down with a straight back, and let the knees track outward.
Take a shoulder-width grip with one overhand and one underhand hand.
At the top, hold a slight hollow in the back and draw the bar back.
Pause there for a moment before reversing.

exercises.name: Decline Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Using a medium width grip , lift the bar from the rack and hold it straight over you with the arms locked
As you breathe in, come down slowly until you feel the bar on the lower chest
After a second pause, bring the bar back to the start as you breathe out and push the bar using the chest muscles
Lock the arms and squeeze the chest in the contracted position, hold for a second and then start coming down slowly again
When you are done, position the bar back in the rack

exercises.name: Decline Bench Leg Raise
instructions: Lie on a decline bench with the head at the top and grip the handles
Extend legs fully, keeping them slightly elevated to engage the core
Raise the legs toward the ceiling using the abs, not momentum
Pause and contract the lower abdominals at the top
Lower the legs slowly to the start with control

exercises.name: Decline Bench Press Barbell
instructions: Concentrate, breath deeply and take hold of the bar more than shoulder wide
Bring it slowly down till it briefly touches the chest at the height of the nipples

exercises.name: Decline Close-Grip Bench To Skull Crusher
instructions: Using a close grip , lift the bar from the rack and hold it straight over you with the arms locked and elbows in
Lower the bar down to the lower chest as you breathe in
Keep the elbows in as you carry out this movement
Using the triceps to push the bar back up, press it back to the start as you exhale
As you breathe in and you keep the upper arms stationary, bring the bar down slowly by moving the forearms in a semicircular motion towards you until you feel the bar slightly touch the forehead
Lift the bar back to the start by contracting the triceps and exhaling

exercises.name: Decline Crunch
instructions: Position the hands lightly on either side of the head keeping the elbows in
Don't lock the fingers behind the head
As pushing the small of the back down in the bench to better isolate the abdominal muscles, begin to roll the shoulders off it
Continue to push down as hard as you can with the lower back as you contract the abdominals and exhale
At the top, contract the abdominals hard and keep the contraction for a second

exercises.name: Decline Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: Once at shoulder width, turn the wrists forward so that the palms of the hands are facing away from you
As you breathe out, push the dumbbells up using the pectoral muscles
Lock the arms in the contracted position, squeeze the chest, hold for a second and then start coming down slowly

exercises.name: Decline Dumbbell Flyes
instructions: With a slight bend on the elbows in order to prevent stress at the biceps tendon, lower the arms out at both sides in a wide arc until you feel a stretch on the chest
Breathe in as you carry out this portion of the movement
Return the arms back to the start as you squeeze the chest muscles and breathe out

exercises.name: Decline Dumbbell Triceps Extension
instructions: As you breathe in and you keep the upper arms stationary , bring the dumbbells down slowly by moving the forearms in a semicircular motion towards you until the thumbs are next to the ears
Breathe in as you carry out this portion of the movement
Lift the dumbbells back to the start by contracting the triceps and exhaling

exercises.name: Decline EZ Bar Triceps Extension
instructions: Using a close grip , lift the EZ bar from the rack and hold it straight over you with the arms locked and elbows in
As you breathe in and you keep the upper arms stationary, bring the bar down slowly by moving the forearms in a semicircular motion towards you until you feel the bar slightly touch the forehead
Breathe in as you carry out this portion of the movement
Lift the bar back to the start by contracting the triceps and exhaling

exercises.name: Decline Oblique Crunch
instructions: Raise the upper body off the bench until the torso is about 35-45 degrees if measured from the floor
Set one hand beside the head and the other on the thigh
Raise the upper body slowly from the start as turning the torso to the left
Focus on keeping the abs tight and keeping the movement slow and controlled
Focus on really twisting the torso and feeling the contraction when you are in the up position

exercises.name: Decline Push-Up
instructions: Lie on the floor face down and position the hands about 36 inches apart as holding the torso up at arms length
Move the feet up to a box or bench
Next, lower yourself downward until the chest almost touches the floor as you inhale
Breathe out and press the upper body back up to the start as squeezing the chest

exercises.name: Decline Reverse Crunch
instructions: Lie on the back on a decline bench and hold on to the top of the bench with both hands
Hold the legs parallel to the floor using the abs to hold them there as keeping the knees and feet together
As exhaling, move the legs towards the torso as you roll the pelvis backwards and you raise the hips off the bench
Hold the contraction for a second and move the legs back to the start as inhaling

exercises.name: Decline Smith Press
instructions: Position a decline bench underneath the Smith machine
Position the barbell at a height that you can reach when lying down and the arms are almost fully extended
Using a pronated grip that is wider than shoulder width, unlock the bar from the rack and hold it straight over you with the arms extended
After a brief pause, bring the bar back to the start by extending the elbows, exhaling as you do so

exercises.name: Deficit Deadlift
instructions: Bend at the hip to grip the bar at shoulder width, allowing the shoulder blades to protract

exercises.name: Deficit Push ups
instructions: Push-ups with the hands on blocks or push-up handles, so that you can lower the chest below the level of the hands

exercises.name: Depth Jump Leap
instructions: Position the other box about two or three feet in front of and facing the performer

exercises.name: Devil’s Press
instructions: Start with a dumbbell in each hand and carry out a burpee, letting the chest touch the ground as holding the dumbbells
Explosively jump the feet forward and swing the dumbbells between the legs
Drive the dumbbells overhead in one continuous motion, locking out the arms

exercises.name: Diagonal Shoulder Press
instructions: In this position you strain the chest muscles a lot less, which is nice if you want to train, but the chest hasn't recovered yet

exercises.name: Diamond push ups
instructions: Position hands close together under the chest so thumbs and index fingers form a diamond shape
Bend the elbows to lower the chest toward the hands
Keep the body straight
New note Keep elbows close to the body and core tight

exercises.name: Dip Machine
instructions: Keep the elbows in at the sides in order to position emphasis on the triceps
As you contract the triceps, extend the arms downwards as you exhale

exercises.name: Dips Between Two Benches
instructions: Set two benches so far appart, that you can hold onto one with the hands and are just able to reach the other with the feet

exercises.name: Dips - Chest Version
instructions: As breathing in, lower yourself slowly with the torso leaning forward around 30 degrees or so and the elbows flared out slightly until you feel a slight stretch in the chest
Remember to squeeze the chest at the top for a second

exercises.name: Dips - Triceps Version
instructions: To get into the start, hold the body at arm's length with the arms nearly locked above the bars
Then, exhale and push the torso back up using the triceps to bring the body back to the start

exercises.name: Donkey Calf Raises
instructions: Start by positioning the lower back and hips under the padded lever provided
Position both of the arms on the side handles and position the balls of the feet on the calf block with the heels extending off
Raise the heels as you breathe out by extending the ankles as high as possible and flexing the calf

exercises.name: Doorway Pectoral Stretch
instructions: Position the forearm vertically on a door frame or stationary object at head height

exercises.name: Double Kettlebell Alternating Hang Clean
instructions: Position two kettlebells between the feet
To get in the start, push the butt back and look straight ahead
Clean one kettlebell to the shoulder and hold on to the other kettlebell
With a fluid motion, lower the top kettlebell as driving the bottom kettlebell up

exercises.name: Double Kettlebell Jerk
instructions: Clean the kettlebells to the shoulders by extending through the legs and hips as you pull the kettlebells towards the shoulders
Turn the wrists as you do so, so that the palms face forward
Dip the body by bending the knees, keeping the torso upright
Return the feet to the ground in a split fashion, with one foot forward and one foot back

exercises.name: Double Kettlebell Push Press
instructions: Clean two kettlebells to the shoulders
Once the kettlebells are locked out, lower the kettlebells to the shoulders

exercises.name: Double Kettlebell Snatch
instructions: Position two kettlebells behind the feet
Bend the knees and sit back to pick up the kettlebells
Swing the kettlebells between the legs forcefully and reverse the direction
Drive through with the hips and lock the ketttlebells overhead in one uninterrupted motion

exercises.name: Double Kettlebell Windmill
instructions: Position a kettlebell in front of the front foot and clean and press a kettlebell overhead with the opposite arm
Clean the kettlebell to the shoulder by extending through the legs and hips as you pull the kettlebell towards the shoulders
Turn the wrist as you do so, so that the palm faces forward
Keeping the kettlebell locked out at all times, push the butt out in the direction of the locked out kettlebell
Turn the feet out at a forty-five degree angle from the arm with the locked out kettlebell

exercises.name: Double-Leg Abdominal Press
instructions: Lie on the back with knees and hips bent at 90 degrees
Position the hands on the thighs just above the knees
Push the hands against the knees as hard as possible as using the abs to pull the knees toward the hands
Hold of maximum effort

exercises.name: Double Leg Butt Kick
instructions: Begin standing with the knees slightly bent
Finish the motion by landing with the knees only partially bent, using the legs to absorb the impact

exercises.name: Drag Curl
instructions: Take hold of a barbell with a supinated grip and get the elbows close to the torso and back
As you exhale, curl the bar up as keeping the elbows to the back as you "Drag" the bar up by keeping it in contact with the torso
Also, do not lift the shoulders

exercises.name: Drag Pushdown
instructions: Straighten the elbows until lockout

exercises.name: Dragon-flag
instructions: Keep the body completely rigid throughout the movement, avoiding sagging in the lower back
Use a firm grip to stabilize the upper body
Start with simpler versions to build strength and control

exercises.name: Dragon squat
instructions: Start standing with the feet hip-width apart
Cross the right foot behind you to the left corner and back of the room as bending both knees
Keep the hips and shoulders forward as you cross the feet and bend the knees

exercises.name: Drop Curl
instructions: Start is with both arms in a slight angle towards each other at chest height with a dumbbell in each hand
Lower one dumbbell close to full extended arm position slowly and in a controlled manner during the first half of the curl, then curl it back up to start, as the other dumbbell stays at its start

exercises.name: Drop Push
instructions: Move to a pushup position between them, supporting yourself by placing the hands on the boxes

exercises.name: Dumbbell Alternate Bicep Curl
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand held at arms length
The elbows should be close to the torso and the palms of the hand should be facing the thighs
At this point continue contracting the biceps as you breathe out until the biceps is fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level
Remember to twist the palms back to the start as you come down

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie down on a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand resting on top of the thighs
Once at shoulder width, turn the wrists forward so that the palms of the hands are facing away from you
Then, as you breathe out, use the chest to push the dumbbells up
Lock the arms at the top of the lift and squeeze the chest, hold for a second and then begin coming down slowly

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bench Press with Neutral Grip
instructions: Maintaining a neutral grip, palms facing each other, begin with the arms extended directly above you, perpendicular to the floor
Descend until the dumbbells are to the torso

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bicep Curl
instructions: Keep the elbows close to the torso and turn the palms of the hands until they are facing forward
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze the biceps

exercises.name: Dumbbell bicep curl to press
instructions: Bend the elbows and lift the dumbbells to the shoulders
Push the dumbbells over the head as rotating the arms to make the palms face forward

exercises.name: Dumbbell Cheat Curl
instructions: Start is standing
Keeping elbows tucked into the
Squeezing the biceps at the top

exercises.name: Dumbbell Clean
instructions: Begin standing with a dumbbell in each hand with the feet shoulder width apart
Allow the arms to bend, guiding the dumbbells to the shoulders

exercises.name: Dumbbell close grip bench press
instructions: Lie down with the back on a flat bench
Raise the arms towards the ceiling with the palms facing each other and dumbbells pressed together
Slowly lower the dumbbells to the chest, then slowly push them back

exercises.name: Dumbbell Concentration Curl
instructions: Position back of upper arm to inner thigh

exercises.name: Dumbbell Crunches
instructions: Lie flat on the back with the knees bent and feet flat on the floor
Hold a dumbbell with both hands close to the chest or above the head
Lift the shoulders and upper back off the ground in a crunching motion, engaging the core

exercises.name: Dumbbell donkey kick
instructions: Take a dumbbell and position it behind the knee of the leg you are going to lift

exercises.name: Dumbbell drag curls
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand with the palms facing forward
Pull the elbows back and lift the dumbbells to the chest height

exercises.name: Dumbbell Floor Press
instructions: Lay on the floor holding dumbbells in the hands

exercises.name: Dumbbell Flyes
instructions: Lie down on a flat bench with a dumbbell on each hand resting on top of the thighs
With a slight bend on the elbows in order to prevent stress at the biceps tendon, lower the arms out at both sides in a wide arc until you feel a stretch on the chest
Breathe in as you carry out this portion of the movement
Return the arms back to the start as you squeeze the chest muscles and breathe out

exercises.name: Dumbbell Goblet Squat
instructions: Position feet about shoulderwide apart, keep knees slightly bent

exercises.name: Dumbbell Hang Power Cleans
instructions: On the feet, stand tall with the dumbbells, holding them at the sides
Hinge at the hips to lower them to the knees
Stand back up with a slight jump, using the momentum to pull the dumbbells up on to the shoulders
Stand up straight, then lower under control to the sides

exercises.name: Dumbbell Hex Press
instructions: Position the feet wide

exercises.name: Dumbbell Incline Curl
instructions: Let the arms hang straight down toward the floor with the palms facing forward
Squeeze the biceps hard at the top, ensuring the elbows do not swing forward
Inhale and slowly lower the dumbbells back to the start, maintaining full control and feeling the stretch in the biceps

exercises.name: Dumbbell Incline Row
instructions: Retract the shoulder blades and flex the elbows to row the dumbbells to the side

exercises.name: Dumbbell Incline Shoulder Raise
instructions: Sit on an Incline Bench as holding a dumbbell on each hand on top of the thighs
Position the dumbbells above the shoulders with the arms extended
As keeping the arms straight and locked, lift the dumbbells by raising the shoulders from the bench as you breathe out
Bring back the dumbbells to the start as you breathe in

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lunges
instructions: Stand with the torso upright holding two dumbbells in the hands by the sides
Step forward with the right leg around 2 feet or so from the foot being left stationary behind and lower the upper body down, as keeping the torso upright and maintaining balance
Confirm that you keep the front shin perpendicular to the ground

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lunges Walking
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart and hands either on the hips or holding dumbbells at the sides
Take a wide step forward with the right leg
Lower the hips until both knees are bent at about 90-degree angles
Drive through the front heel to stand up, bringing the back foot forward to step directly into the next lunge

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lying One-Arm Rear Lateral Raise
instructions: As holding a dumbbell in one hand, lay with the chest down on a slightly inclined adjustable bench
Position the palm of the hand that is holding the dumbbell in a neutral manner as you keep the arm extended with the elbow slightly bent
Raise the arm with the dumbbell to the side until the elbow is at shoulder height and the arm is roughly parallel to the floor as you exhale
Maintain the arm perpendicular to the torso as keeping the arm extended throughout the movement
Slowly lower the dumbbell to the start as you inhale

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lying Pronation
instructions: Lie on a flat bench face down with one arm holding a dumbbell and the other hand on top of the bench folded so that you can rest the head on it
Raise the upper arm so that the forearm is perpendicular to the floor and the upper arm is perpendicular to the torso
As you breathe out, externally turn the forearm so that the dumbbell is lifted forward as you maintain the 90 degree angle bend between the upper arms and the forearm

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lying Rear Lateral Raise
instructions: As holding a dumbbell in each hand, lay with the chest down on a slightly inclined adjustable bench
Position the palms of the hands in a neutral manner as you keep the arms extended with the elbows slightly bent
Raise the arms to the side until the elbows are at shoulder height and the arms are roughly parallel to the floor as you exhale
Maintain the arms perpendicular to the torso as keeping them extended throughout the movement
Slowly lower the dumbbells to the start as you inhale

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lying Supination
instructions: Lie sideways on a flat bench with one arm holding a dumbbell and the other hand on top of the bench folded so that you can rest the head on it
Raise the upper arm so that the forearm is parallel to the floor and perpendicular to the torso
As you breathe out, externally turn the forearm so that the dumbbell is lifted up in a semicircle motion as you maintain the 90 degree angle bend between the upper arms and the forearm

exercises.name: Dumbbell One-Arm Shoulder Press
instructions: Take hold of a dumbbell and either sit on a military press bench or a utility bench that has a back support on it as you position the dumbbells upright on top of the thighs
Turn the wrist so that the palm of the hand is facing forward
As you exhale, push the dumbbell up until the arm is fully extended
After a second pause, slowly come down back to the start as you inhale

exercises.name: Dumbbell One-Arm Triceps Extension
instructions: Take hold of a dumbbell and either sit on a military press bench or a utility bench that has a back support on it as you position the dumbbells upright on top of the thighs
Clean the dumbbell up to bring it to shoulder height and then extend the arm over the head so that the whole arm is perpendicular to the floor and next to the head
Turn the wrist so that the palm of the hand is facing forward and the pinkie is facing the ceiling
Slowly lower the dumbbell behind the head as you hold the upper arm stationary
Inhale as you carry out this movement and pause when the triceps are fully stretched
Return to the start by flexing the triceps as you breathe out

exercises.name: Dumbbell One-Arm Upright Row
instructions: Take hold of a dumbbell and stand up straight with the arm extended in front of you with a slight bend at the elbows and the back straight
Continue to lift it until the dumbbell is nearly in line with the chin

exercises.name: Dumbbell Prone Incline Curl
instructions: Take hold of a dumbbell on each hand and lie face down on an incline bench with the shoulders near top of the incline
Let the arms extend and hang naturally in front of you so that they are perpendicular to the floor
Keep the elbows in by the side and face the palms forward
Raise the dumbbells by contracting the biceps until the arms are fully flexed
Exhale as you carry out this portion of the movement and confirm that only the forearms move
Lower the dumbbells until the arms are fully extended

exercises.name: Dumbbell Raise
instructions: Take hold of a dumbbell in each arm and stand up straight with the arms extended by the sides with a slight bend at the elbows and the back straight
Continue to lift it until the dumbbells are nearly in line with the chin
As you lift the dumbbell, the elbow should always be higher than the forearm
Also, keep the torso stationary and pause for a second at the top
Inhale as you carry out this portion of the movement

exercises.name: Dumbbell rear delt row
instructions: Bend at the hips to make the back almost parallel to the floor
Let the arms hang down
Keep the arms in line with the shoulders
Bend and lift the elbows out to the sides until the upper arms are parallel to the floor

exercises.name: Dumbbell Rear Lunge
instructions: Stand with the torso upright holding two dumbbells in the hands by the sides
Step backward with the right leg around two feet or so from the left foot and lower the upper body down, as keeping the torso upright and maintaining balance
Confirm that you keep the front shin perpendicular to the ground
To focus on the glutes, press with the heels

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
instructions: This exercise involves holding a dumbbell in each hand and bending forward at the hips as keeping the back straight, then returning to a standing position

exercises.name: Dumbbell Scaption
instructions: The thumbs should pointing up
Begin the movement raising the arms out in front of you, about 30 degrees off center

exercises.name: Dumbbell Seated Box Jump
instructions: Hold a dumbbell to the chest with both hands and seat yourself on the bench facing the box

exercises.name: Dumbbell Seated One-Leg Calf Raise
instructions: Position a block on the floor about 12 inches from a flat bench
Sit on a flat bench and position a dumbbell on the upper left thigh about 3 inches above the knee
Position the ball of the left foot on the block
Raise the toes up as high as possible as you exhale and you contract the calf muscle
Slowly return to the start, stretching as far down as possible

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
instructions: Sit on a bench with back support and hold a dumbbell in each hand.
Set the dumbbells upright on the thighs, then raise them to shoulder height one at a time with help from the thighs.
Turn the wrists so the palms face forward.
Breathe out and press the dumbbells upward until they meet at the top.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Rotations
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in one hand, keeping the elbow bent at 90 degrees and close to the body
Turn the forearm outward, away from the body, keeping the elbow stationary
Turn the forearm inward, toward the body, and slowly return to the start
Carry out the exercise with controlled movements to avoid strain

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shrug
instructions: Stand erect with a dumbbell on each hand , arms extended on the sides
Lift the dumbbells by elevating the shoulders as high as possible as you exhale

exercises.name: Dumbbell Side Bend
instructions: Stand up straight as holding a dumbbell on the left hand as you have the right hand holding the waist
The feet should be placed at shoulder width
As keeping the back straight and the head up, bend only at the waist to the right as far as possible
Hold for a second and come back up to the start as you exhale

exercises.name: Dumbbell Side Squat
instructions: This exercise involves holding a dumbbell in one hand and performing a squat as stepping to the side

exercises.name: Dumbbell single arm row
instructions: Position a dumbbell next to a flat bench
Position the right foot on the floor in line with the left knee
Take hold of the dumbbell with the right hand, neutral grip
Start, shoulders should be in line and back paraller to the floor
Slowly pull the dumbbell up, by pushing the elbow upwards, keeping it close to the body

exercises.name: dumbbell snatch
instructions: Position the dumbbell between the feet, with the shoulders above the hips, chest up, and back flat
Explosively extend the hips, knees, and ankles to drive the dumbbell upward, keeping the elbow high and the dumbbell close to the body
Quickly flex the hips and knees to drop under the dumbbell and receive it overhead with the arm locked in position, landing in a half-squat stance

exercises.name: Dumbbell Split Squat
instructions: Carry out slowly

exercises.name: Dumbbell Squat
instructions: Stand up straight as holding a dumbbell on each hand
Position the legs using a shoulder width medium stance with the toes slightly pointed out
Keep the head up at all times as looking down will get you off balance and also maintain a straight back
Begin to slowly lower the torso by bending the knees as you maintain a straight posture with the head up
Begin to raise the torso as you exhale by pushing the floor with the heel of the foot mainly as you straighten the legs again and go back to the start

exercises.name: Dumbbell Squat To A Bench
instructions: Stand up straight with a flat bench behind you as holding a dumbbell on each hand
Position the legs using a shoulder width medium stance with the toes slightly pointed out
Keep the head up at all times as looking down will get you off balance and also maintain a straight back
Begin to slowly lower the torso by bending the knees as you maintain a straight posture with the head up
Inhale as you carry out this portion of the movement
Begin to raise the bar as you exhale by pushing the floor with the heel of the foot mainly as you straighten the legs again and go back to the start

exercises.name: Dumbbell Step Ups
instructions: Stand up straight as holding a dumbbell on each hand
Position the right foot on the elevated platform
Step on the platform by extending the hip and the knee of the right leg
Breathe out as you carry out the force required to come up

exercises.name: Dumbbell sumo deadlift
instructions: Lower the dumbbell to the ground between the legs
With the dumbbell standing upright, grip it by the top of the ‘head’ .Keeping the chest up and core braced, push the floor away, driving back upwards to a standing position

exercises.name: Dumbbell Thruster
instructions: Start with the dumbbells resting on the shoulders and squat down

exercises.name: Dumbbell Tricep Extension -Pronated Grip
instructions: Lie down on a flat bench holding two dumbbells directly above the shoulders
Now, inhale and slowly lower the dumbbells until they are near the ears
Be sure to keep the upper arms stationary and the elbows tucked in

exercises.name: Dumbbell Triceps Extension
instructions: Raise dumbbell over head by extending elbows as hyperextending wrists

exercises.name: Dumbbell Underhand Dead Row
instructions: Start by holding a pair of dumbbells with the feet shoulder-wide apart and the knees slightly bent
Hinge at the hips to lower the torse forward until it's almost parallel to the floor, keeping the back flat and maintaining a slight bend in the knees
Exhale as you row the dumbbells to the sides up to chest height, leading with the elbows until the upper arms are just past parallel to the floor and the dumbbells are at ribcage level
Keep the back flat all the time

exercises.name: Dumbbell wide bicep curls
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand with the hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and palms facing forward
Bend the elbows and lift the dumbbells to the shoulders

exercises.name: Dumbell Tate Press
instructions: Extend the arms straight up over the chest as if you were at the top of a dumbbell bench press
Without moving the upper arms or shoulders, bend the elbows and flare them outward to the sides
Lower the inner ends of the dumbbells toward the center of the chest
Focus on "pushing the pinkies toward the sky" to maximize triceps engagement

exercises.name: Dynamic Back Stretch
instructions: Stand with the feet shoulder width apart
Keeping the arms straight, swing them straight up in front of you 5-10 times, increasing the range of motion each time until the arms are above the head

exercises.name: Dynamic Chest Stretch
instructions: Stand with the hands together, arms extended directly in front of you
Keeping the arms straight, quickly move the arms back as far as possible and back in again, similar to an exaggerated clapping motion

exercises.name: Dynamic Planche
instructions: Start in a plank position, with the hands directly under the shoulders and the feet hip-width apart
Engage the core to keep the body in a straight line from head to toe
From this position, bend the knees slightly and jump with both feet inward, bringing them as close to the core as possible
Confirm to keep the breathing steady as jumping, breathing deeply and controlling the breathing
To finish the exercise, rest by releasing the plank position, then stretch if necessary to loosen the muscles

exercises.name: Dynamic side hold
instructions: Let it hang by the side and stand on one leg

exercises.name: Elbow Circles
instructions: Sit or stand with the feet slightly apart
Position the hands on the shoulders with the elbows at shoulder level and pointing out

exercises.name: Elbow to Knee
instructions: Lie on the floor, crossing the right leg across the bent left knee
Carry out the motion by flexing the spine and rotating the torso to bring the left elbow to the right knee

exercises.name: Elbows Back
instructions: Position both hands on the lower back, fingers pointing downward and elbows out
Gently pull the elbows back aiming to touch them together

exercises.name: Elephant Walks
instructions: Hinge at the hips until you feel a stretch behind the knees
Bend one leg as the other is straight then fluidly bend the other knee as straightening the first knee

exercises.name: Elevated Back Lunge
instructions: Position a short, raised platform behind you
Step onto the raised platform with both feet
Descend by flexing the hips and knees until the knee touches the floor
Pause, and extend through the hips and knees to rise up, returning all the way to the start before alternating

exercises.name: Elevated Cable Rows
instructions: Position it on the seat of the cable row machine
Sit down on the machine and position the feet on the front platform or crossbar provided making sure that the knees are slightly bent and not locked
Lean over as you keep the natural alignment of the back and take hold of the V-bar handles
With the arms extended pull back until the torso is at a 90-degree angle from the legs
Keeping the torso stationary, pull the handles back towards the torso as keeping the arms close to it until you touch the abdominals
Hold that contraction for a second and slowly go back to the original position as breathing in

exercises.name: Elevated prayer stretch
instructions: Kneel in front of a bench, far enough so that the torso can fit between the knees and the bench
With the back straight, position the elbows on the bench, with palms together, hands pointing up
On exhale, stretch the chest down toward the floor without moving the lower back
At the same time, bring the hands toward the shoulders, keeping palms together and elbows on the bench
On inhale, relax the back to return to the start

exercises.name: Exercise Ball Crunch
instructions: Lie on an exercise ball with the lower back curvature pressed against the spherical surface of the ball
Lower the torso into a stretch position keeping the neck stationary at all times
With the hips stationary, flex the waist by contracting the abdominals and curl the shoulders and trunk upward until you feel a nice contraction on the abdominals
The arms should simply slide up the side of the legs if you have them at the side or just stay on top of the chest if you have them crossed

exercises.name: Exercise Ball Pull-In
instructions: Position an exercise ball nearby and lay on the floor in front of it with the hands on the floor shoulder width apart in a push-up position
Position the lower shins on top of an exercise ball
At this point the legs should be fully extended with the shins on top of the ball and the upper body should be in a push-up type of position being supported by the two extended
As keeping the back completely straight and the upper body stationary, pull the knees in towards the chest as you exhale, allowing the ball to roll forward under the ankles
Squeeze the abs and hold that position for a second
Slowly straighten the legs, rolling the ball back to the start as you inhale

exercises.name: explosive push ups
instructions: Start in a standard push-up position, lower the chest, then explosively push off the ground so the hands leave the floor

exercises.name: Extended Range One-Arm Kettlebell Floor Press
instructions: Press the kettlebell by extending the elbow and adducting the arm, pressing it above the body

exercises.name: External Rotation
instructions: Lie sideways on a flat bench with one arm holding a dumbbell and the other hand on top of the bench folded so that you can rest the head on it
Keep the arm parallel to the torso
Bend the elbow as keeping the upper arm stationary
As you breathe out, externally turn the forearm so that the dumbbell is lifted up in a semicircle motion as you maintain the 90 degree angle bend between the upper arms and the forearm

exercises.name: External Rotation Stretch
instructions: Sit with the feet pressed against each other, and one knee raised all the way out to the side of the body
Position the elbow on the raised knee, bend it at 90 degrees, and point the hand directly forward, holding the barbell/dumbbell
Keep the shoulder depressed and retracted, raise the hand until the forearm is vertical, as if you were about to wave at someone like a robot
Lower the hand to the original position

exercises.name: External Rotation with Band
instructions: Stand with the left side to the band a couple of feet away
We recommend you hold a pad or foam roll in position with the elbow to keep it firmly in position
Carry out the movement by rotating the arm in a backhand motion, keeping the elbow in position

exercises.name: External Rotation with Cable
instructions: Adjust the cable to the same height as the elbow
Stand with the left side to the band a couple of feet away
We recommend you hold a pad or foam roll in position with the elbow to keep it firmly in position
Carry out the movement by rotating the arm in a backhand motion, keeping the elbow in position

exercises.name: EZ-Bar Curl
instructions: Stand up straight as holding an EZ curl bar at the wide outer handle
Focus on only moving the forearms

exercises.name: EZ-Bar Skullcrusher
instructions: Using a close grip, lift the EZ bar and hold it with the elbows in as you lie on the bench
Inhale as you carry out this portion of the movement
Lift the bar back to the start by extending the elbow and exhaling

exercises.name: Face Pull
instructions: Keep the upper arms parallel to the ground

exercises.name: Face pulls with yellow/green band
instructions: Take hold of the band at face height, pull elbows high and wide towards the face as squeezing shoulder blades together

exercises.name: Facepull
instructions: Retract the scapulae and pull the center of the rope slightly up towards the face

exercises.name: Farmer's Walk
instructions: After gripping the handles, lift them up by driving through the heels, keeping the back straight and the head up

exercises.name: Fast Skipping
instructions: Carry out fast skips by maintaining close contact with the ground and reduce air time, moving as quickly as possible

exercises.name: Finger Curls
instructions: Hold a barbell with both hands and the palms facing up
Position the feet flat on the floor, at a distance that is slightly wider than shoulder width apart
Curl bar up as high as possible by closing the hands as exhaling

exercises.name: Fingerboard 20 mm edge
instructions: Hang on a fingerboard with a 20 mm edge

exercises.name: Flat Bench Cable Flyes
instructions: Position a flat bench between two low pulleys so that when you are laying on it, the chest will be lined up with the cable pulleys
You will take hold of each single handle attachment with a palms up grip
Extend the arms by the side with a slight bend on the elbows
When performed correctly, at the top position of this movement, the arms should be perpendicular to the torso and the floor touching above the chest

exercises.name: Flat Bench Leg Pull-In
instructions: Lie on an exercise mat or a flat bench with the legs off the end
Position the hands either under the glutes with the palms down or by the sides holding on to the bench
Extend the legs straight out
Bend the knees and pull the upper thighs into the midsection as you breathe out

exercises.name: Flat Bench Lying Leg Raise
instructions: Lie with the back flat on a bench and the legs extended in front of you off the end
Position the hands either under the glutes with the palms down or by the sides holding on to the bench
As you keep the legs extended, straight as possible with the knees slightly bent but locked raise the legs until they make a 90-degree angle with the floor
Exhale as you carry out this portion of the movement and hold the contraction at the top for a second
Now, as you inhale, slowly lower the legs back down to the start

exercises.name: Flat Machine Press
instructions: Keep wrists straight and aligned with the forearms
Push the handles forward until the arms are almost fully extended — don’t lock out
Focus on squeezing the chest at the end of the movement
Slowly bring the handles back toward the chest, feeling the stretch in the pecs

exercises.name: FlexBar Tyler Twist
instructions: Bring both arms out in front of you with the bar horizontal, then slowly let the affected wrist untwist the bar over about four seconds as the other hand holds steady

exercises.name: FlexBar Wrist Flexion
instructions: Hold the bar in that hand, let the wrist extend back, then curl the wrist up to raise the bar as the forearm stays still

exercises.name: Flexor Incline Dumbbell Curls
instructions: Sit on an incline bench that is angled at 45-degrees as holding a dumbbell on each hand
Let the arms hang down on the sides, with the elbows in, and turn the palms of the hands forward with the thumbs pointing away from the body
Curl up the two dumbbells at the same time until the biceps are fully contracted and exhale

exercises.name: Floor Glute-Ham Raise
instructions: Begin on the knees with the upper legs and torso upright
Position the hands in front of you as you reach the floor

exercises.name: Floor Press
instructions: Begin lying on the floor with the head near the end of a power rack
Keeping the shoulder blades pulled together
Lower the bar towards the bottom of the chest or upper stomach, squeezing the bar and attempting to pull it apart as you do so
Press the bar back up as fast as you can, keeping the bar, the wrists, and elbows in line as you do so

exercises.name: Floor Press with Chains
instructions: Begin lying on the floor with the head near the end of a power rack
Keeping the shoulder blades pulled together, pull the bar off of the hooks
Lower the bar towards the bottom of the chest or upper stomach, squeezing the bar and attempting to pull it apart as you do so
Press the bar back up as fast as you can, keeping the bar, the wrists, and elbows in line as you do so

exercises.name: Flutter Kicks
instructions: Squeeze the glutes and hamstrings and straighten the legs until they are level with the hips
Confirm that you keep a controlled movement at all times
You will breathe normally as you carry out this movement

exercises.name: Flutter Kicks
instructions: Laying on the back, lift the straightened legs from the ground at a 45 degree angle
Bring the R foot down until it nearly touches the floor, and bring the L foot upwards

exercises.name: Fly With Dumbbells
instructions: Take two dumbbells and lay on a bench, confirm the feet are firmly on the ground and the back is not arched, but has good contact with the bench

exercises.name: Fly With Dumbbells, Decline Bench
instructions: Take two dumbbells and lay on a bench, confirm the feet are firmly on the ground and the back is not arched, but has good contact with the bench

exercises.name: Foam Roller Adductors
instructions: Slowly roll back and forth over the adductors with moderate pressure

exercises.name: Foam Roller Anterior tibialis
instructions: Slowly roll the front of the shin over the foam roller with moderate pressure, moving back and forth

exercises.name: Foam Roller Gluteus
instructions: Sit on the foam roller and slowly roll back and forth over the glutes with moderate pressure

exercises.name: Foam Roller Iliotibial band
instructions: Lie on the side with the foam roller under the outside of the thigh and slowly roll back and forth along the iliotibial band with moderate pressure

exercises.name: Foam Roller quadriceps
instructions: Lie face down with the foam roller under the thighs and slowly roll back and forth over the quadriceps with moderate pressure

exercises.name: Foot-SMR
instructions: Start off seated with the shoes removed
Press down firmly, rolling across the arch of the foot
Hold , and then switch feet

exercises.name: Forward Drag with Press
instructions: Leaning forward, extend through the legs and hips to move, pausing with each step to extend through the elbows, pressing the hands forward

exercises.name: Frankenstein Squat
instructions: Position the barbell on the front of the shoulders, releasing the grip and extending the arms out in front of you
Confirm that you only move the shoulder blades forward
Squat by flexing the knees and hips, sitting in between the legs
Keep the torso upright, the arms up, and the shoulders forward, and the bar should stay in position

exercises.name: Freehand Jump Squat
instructions: Cross the arms over the chest
Keeping the back straight and chest up, squat down as you inhale until the upper thighs are parallel, or lower, to the floor
Pressing mainly with the ball of the feet, jump straight up in the air as high as possible, using the thighs like springs

exercises.name: Frog Hops
instructions: Stand with the hands behind the head, and squat down keeping the torso upright and the head up

exercises.name: Frog Sit-Ups
instructions: Lie with the back flat on the floor and the legs extended in front of you
Bend at the knees and position the outer thighs by the floor as you make the soles of the feet touch each other
Try pushing both soles and bringing them up as near you as possible as you keep the outer thighs on the floor
In this position the legs should create a diamond shape
Now, cross the arms in front of you by touching the opposite shoulders

exercises.name: Frog stand
instructions: Stand with the feet shoulder-width apart and the toes pointing forward, facing a wall or bench for support if needed
Bend the knees into a squat position
Position the hands on the ground in front of you, shoulder-width apart, with the fingers spread wide
Push with the feet and hands to lift the body off the ground
Straighten the legs and arms, keeping the body aligned
Engage the core and glutes to maintain the position

exercises.name: Frog Stretch
instructions: Widen the knees outwards, and drop to the elbows
Without moving the elbows or knees, start to rock forwards and backwards, trying to get the bum closer to the feet

exercises.name: Front Barbell Squat
instructions: Lift the bar off the rack by first pushing with the legs and at the same time straightening the torso
Step away from the rack and position the legs using a shoulder width medium stance with the toes slightly pointed out
Keep the head up at all times as looking down will get you off balance and also maintain a straight back
Begin to raise the bar as you exhale by pushing the floor mainly with the middle of the foot as you straighten the legs again and go back to the start

exercises.name: Front Barbell Squat To A Bench
instructions: Lift the bar off the rack by first pushing with the legs and at the same time straightening the torso
Step away from the rack and position the legs using a shoulder width medium stance with the toes slightly pointed out
Keep the head up at all times as looking down will get you off balance and also maintain a straight back
Begin to raise the bar as you exhale by pushing the floor mainly with the heel of the foot as you straighten the legs again and go back to the start

exercises.name: Front Box Jump
instructions: Stand with the feet should width apart
Carry out a short squat in preparation for jumping, swinging the arms behind you
Swing the arms forward and up

exercises.name: Front Cable Raise
instructions: As maintaining the torso stationary , lift the left arm to the front with a slight bend on the elbow and the palms of the hand always faces down
Exhale as you carry out this portion of the movement and pause for a second at the top

exercises.name: Front Cone Hops (or hurdle hops)
instructions: Stand in front of the first cone with the feet shoulder width apart

exercises.name: Front Dumbbell Raise
instructions: As maintaining the torso stationary , lift the left dumbbell to the front with a slight bend on the elbow and the palms of the hands always facing down
Exhale as you carry out this portion of the movement and pause for a second at the top
Lower the dumbbell back down slowly to the start as you simultaneously lift the right dumbbell

exercises.name: Front Incline Dumbbell Raise
instructions: Extend the arms straight in front of you and have the palms facing down with the dumbbells raised about 1 inch above the thighs
Slowly raise the dumbbells straight up until they are slightly above the shoulders, as keeping the elbows locked
Squeeze at the top for a second and confirm you breathe out during this portion of the movement
Keep the head resting down against the bench and the legs on the floor at all times
Lower the arms back to the start as you inhale

exercises.name: Front Leg Raises
instructions: Swing the leg forward, keeping the leg straight
Continue with a downward swing, bringing the leg as far back as the flexibility allows

exercises.name: Front Plate Raise
instructions: As standing straight, hold a barbell plate in both hands at the 3 and 9 o'clock positions

exercises.name: Front Raise And Pullover
instructions: Lie on a flat bench as holding a barbell using a palms down grip that is about 15 inches apart
Position the bar on the upper thighs, extend the arms and lock them as keeping a slight bend on the elbows
At this point the arms should be parallel to the floor with the palms of the hands facing the ceiling
Return the barbell to the start by reversing the motion as you exhale

exercises.name: Front Raises with Plates
instructions: As standing straight, hold a barbell plate in both hands at the 3 and 9 o'clock positions

exercises.name: Front Squat (Clean Grip)
instructions: Lift the bar off the rack by first pushing with the legs and at the same time straightening the torso
Step away from the rack and position the legs using a shoulder width medium stance with the toes slightly pointed out
Keep the head and elbows up at all times
Bend at the knees, sitting down between the legs

exercises.name: Kettlebell Figure 8
instructions: Position one kettlebell between the legs and take a wider than shoulder width stance
Bend over by pushing the butt out and keeping the back flat

exercises.name: Kettlebell Halo
instructions: Stand tall with the feet hip-width apart
Hold a kettlebell upside down by the horns, with the bell above the hands and close to the chest
Brace the abdominals and squeeze the glutes so the ribcage stays down
Keeping the elbows close to the head, move the kettlebell up past one ear and around behind the head
Move slowly and keep the head, hips and lower back still

exercises.name: Kettlebell Halo with Overhead Extension
instructions: Stand tall with the feet hip-width apart
Hold a kettlebell upside down by the horns, with the bell above the hands and close to the chest
Brace the abdominals and squeeze the glutes so the ribcage stays down
Keeping the elbows close to the head, move the kettlebell up past one ear and around until it sits behind the head
From this position, extend the elbows to press the kettlebell up and overhead until the arms are straight, keeping the upper arms alongside the head
Keep the head, hips and lower back still throughout

exercises.name: Kettlebell Hang Clean
instructions: Position kettlebell between the feet
To get in the start, push the butt back and look straight ahead
Clean kettlebell to the shoulder
Clean the kettlebell to the shoulders by extending through the legs and hips as you raise the kettlebell towards the shoulder
The wrist should turn as you do so
Keep the head up at all times

exercises.name: Kettlebell One-Legged Deadlift
instructions: Keeping that knee slightly bent, carry out a stiff legged deadlift by bending at the hip, extending the free leg behind you for balance

exercises.name: Kettlebell One Legged Deadlift
instructions: This exercise involves holding a kettlebell in one hand and standing on one leg as bending forward to touch the kettlebell to the ground

exercises.name: Kettlebell Overhead Triceps Extension
instructions: Stand with the feet hip-width apart, holding a kettlebell by the horns with both hands
Press it overhead until the arms are extended, with the bell hanging behind the hands
Brace the abdominals and keep the upper arms vertical and close to the head
Bend at the elbows to lower the kettlebell behind the head, going as far as the shoulder mobility allows without the elbows flaring outward
Extend the elbows to press the kettlebell back to the start, keeping the upper arms still throughout
Keep the ribcage down and avoid arching the lower back as you extend

exercises.name: Kettlebell Pass Between The Legs
instructions: Position one kettlebell between the legs and take a comfortable stance
Bend over by pushing the butt out and keeping the back flat

exercises.name: Kettlebell Pirate Ships
instructions: Allow it to hang at waist level with the arms extended

exercises.name: Kettlebell Pistol Squat
instructions: Hold the bottom position for a second and then reverse the motion, driving through the heel and keeping the head and chest up

exercises.name: Kettlebell Seated Press
instructions: Sit on the floor and spread the legs out comfortably
Clean one kettlebell to the shoulder

exercises.name: Kettlebell Seesaw Press
instructions: Clean two kettlebells two the shoulders

exercises.name: kettlebell sumo deadlift
instructions: Position the feet wider than shoulder-width apart, pointing the toes outward
Keep the back straight, shoulders back, and chest up

exercises.name: Kettlebell Sumo High Pull
instructions: Position a kettlebell on the ground between the feet
Position the feet in a wide stance, and grasp the kettlebell with two hands
Keep the chest and head up
Begin by extending the hips and knees, simultaneously pulling the kettlebell to the shoulders, raising the elbows as you do so

exercises.name: Kettlebell Swings
instructions: Keep the back flat throughout the move, avoiding any rounding of the spine.Keeping the knees "soft", hinge the hips backwards, letting the kettlebell swing between the knees
You want to bend from the hips as far as you can without letting the back round forwards
Don't try to lift the kettlebell with the arms

exercises.name: Kettlebell Thruster
instructions: Clean two kettlebells to the shoulders
Clean the kettlebells to the shoulders by extending through the legs and hips as you pull the kettlebells towards the shoulders
Turn the wrists as you do so
Begin to squat by flexing the hips and knees, lowering the hips between the legs

exercises.name: Kettlebell Turkish Get-Up (Lunge style)
instructions: Lie on the back on the floor and press a kettlebell to the top position by extending the elbow
Keeping the kettlebell locked out at all times, pivot to the opposite side and use the non- working arm to assist you in driving forward to the lunge position
Using the free hand, push yourself to a seated position, then progressing to one knee
As looking up at the kettlebell, slowly stand up

exercises.name: Kettlebell Turkish Get-Up (Squat style)
instructions: Lie on the back on the floor and press a kettlebell to the top position by extending the elbow
Keeping the kettlebell locked out at all times, pivot to the opposite side and use the non- working arm to assist you in driving forward to the lunge position
Using the free hand, push yourself to a seated position, then progressing to the feet
As looking up at the kettlebell, slowly stand up

exercises.name: Kettlebell Windmill
instructions: Position a kettlebell in front of the lead foot and clean and press it overhead with the opposite arm
Clean the kettlebell to the shoulder by extending through the legs and hips as you pull the kettlebell towards the shoulders
Turn the wrist as you do so, so that the palm faces forward
Keeping the kettlebell locked out at all times, push the butt out in the direction of the locked out kettlebell
Keep the eyes on the kettlebell that you hold over the head at all times

exercises.name: Kipping Muscle Up
instructions: Grip the rings using a false grip, with the base of the palms on top of the rings
Begin with a movement swinging the legs backward slightly
Counter that movement by swinging the legs forward and up, jerking the chin and chest back, pulling yourself up with both arms as you do so
As you reach the top position of the pull-up, pull the rings to the armpits as you roll the shoulders forward, allowing the elbows to move straight back behind you

exercises.name: Knee Across The Body
instructions: Lie down on the floor with the right leg straight
Bend the left leg and lower it across the body, holding the knee down toward the floor with the right hand
Position the left arm comfortably beside you and turn the head to the left

exercises.name: Knee Circles
instructions: Stand with the legs together and hands by the waist
Move the knees in a circular motion as you breathe normally

exercises.name: Knee/Hip Raise On Parallel Bars
instructions: Position the body on the vertical leg raise bench so that the forearms are resting on the pads next to the torso and holding on to the handles
As you breathe out, lift the legs up as you keep them extended

exercises.name: knee push-ups
instructions: Start by kneeling on the floor, keeping the knees together
Position the hands on the floor in front of you, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart
Lower the torso towards the ground, bending the elbows as keeping the trunk stable
Keep the knees in contact with the floor

exercises.name: Knee to Chest Stretch
instructions: To carry out, lie flat on the back with the legs extended
Bring one knee toward the chest, wrapping the hands around the shin or behind the thigh
Gently pull the knee closer to the chest as keeping the other leg straight on the floor

exercises.name: Knee Tuck Jump
instructions: Begin in a comfortable standing position with the knees slightly bent
Hold the hands in front of you, palms down with the fingertips together at chest height
Jump as high as you can, raising the knees up, and then confirm a good land be re-extending the legs, absorbing impact through be allowing the knees to rebend

exercises.name: Kneeling Cable Crunch With Alternating Oblique Twists
instructions: Take hold of the rope with both hands and kneel about two feet back from the tower
Position the rope behind the head with the hands by the ears
Keep the hands in the same position, contract the abs and pull downward on the rope in a crunching movement until the elbows reach the knees

exercises.name: Kneeling Cable Triceps Extension
instructions: Position a bench sideways in front of a high pulley machine
Hold a straight bar attachment above the head with the hands about 6 inches apart with the palms facing down
Position the head and the back of the upper arms on the bench
As keeping the upper arms close to the head at all times with the elbows in, press the bar out in a semicircular motion until the elbows are locked and the arms are parallel to the floor
Slowly return to the start as you breathe in

exercises.name: Kneeling Forearm Stretch
instructions: Start by kneeling on a mat with the palms flat and the fingers pointing back toward the knees
Slowly lean back keeping the palms flat on the floor until you feel a stretch in the wrists and forearms

exercises.name: Kneeling High Pulley Row
instructions: Initiate the movement by flexing the elbows and fully retracting the shoulders, pulling the rope toward the upper chest with the elbows out

exercises.name: Kneeling Hip Flexor
instructions: Kneel on a mat and bring the right knee up so the bottom of the foot is on the floor and extend the left leg out behind you so the top of the foot is on the floor

exercises.name: Kneeling Jump Squat
instructions: Sit back with the hips until the glutes touch the feet, keeping the head and chest up
Continue with the squat by driving through the heels and extending the knees to come to a standing position

exercises.name: Kneeling Single-Arm High Pulley Row
instructions: Kneel in front of the cable tower, taking the cable with one hand with the arm extended

exercises.name: Kneeling Squat
instructions: Slide under the bar, racking it across the back of the shoulders
With the head looking forward, sit back with the butt until you touch the calves

exercises.name: Kong Curl

exercises.name: Kreis Press DB

exercises.name: L-sit

Push the body off the ground using the hands, maintaining the same sitting position so that the legs are straight and the feet do not touch the floor

exercises.name: L-Sit Pull-ups
instructions: Pull-ups performed with the legs held straight out in front of you, so that the body forms an L

exercises.name: Landmine 180's
instructions: Raise the bar from the floor, taking it to shoulder height with both hands with the arms extended in front of you
Keep the arms extended throughout the exercise

exercises.name: Landmine Linear Jammer
instructions: Raise the bar from the floor, taking the handles to the shoulders
In an athletic stance, squat by flexing the hips and setting the hips back, keeping the arms flexed

exercises.name: Landmine Rotation
instructions: Start with landmine barbell straight up by using the shoulders to push it up above you
Then, from that position, bring it the side to target the abdominals and return to start

exercises.name: Landmine Squat to Press
instructions: Turn the toes out 10–35 degrees to allow for better pelvic movement and depth
Lower until the thighs are at least parallel to the floor
Powerfully drive through the heels to stand up
In one fluid motion, press the bar overhead until the arms are fully extended

exercises.name: Larsen Press
instructions: Set the legs up on a separate Bench and press with no leg drive

exercises.name: Lat Pull DB
instructions: Move dumbbells near the body with slightly bent arms towards the back

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown - Cross Body Single Arm
Lateral Bound
instructions: Assume a half squat position facing 90 degrees from the direction of travel
Upon landing, immediately push off in the opposite direction, returning to the original start position

exercises.name: Lateral Box Jump
instructions: Bring the knees high enough to confirm the feet have good clearance over the box
Land on the center of the box, using the legs to absorb the impact

exercises.name: Lateral Raise - With Bands
instructions: The arms should be extended with a slight bend at the elbows and the back should be straight
As you lift the handles, slightly tilt the hand as if you were pouring water and keep the arms extended
Also, keep the torso stationary and pause for a second at the top
Inhale as you carry out this portion of the movement

exercises.name: Lateral Rows on Cable, One Armed
Lateral-to-Front Raises
instructions: Carry out a lateral raise, pausing at the top of the lift

exercises.name: Lean-Away Cable Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand side-on to the machine, hold the frame with the near hand and lean the body away so you hang at an angle

exercises.name: Leg curl with elastic
instructions: Position the band under the feet in the middle of the foot and grasp it with a hammer grip

exercises.name: Leg Curls (laying)

exercises.name: Leg Extensions

instructions: Lie on the floor with one kettlebell in position on the chest, holding it by the handle
Extend leg on working side over leg on non-working side.the free arm can be extended out to the side for support

exercises.name: Leg Press
instructions: Sit in a leg press machine and set the feet on the platform at a medium stance.
Release the safety bars and press the platform up until the legs are extended.
Breathe in and lower the platform under control until the knees are bent to about ninety degrees.
Drive mainly through the heels and press back to the start while breathing out.

exercises.name: Leg Press Toe Press
instructions: Move the leg press using the calves by placing the feet at the bottom of the platform

exercises.name: Leg Presses (wide)

exercises.name: Leg Pull-In
instructions: Lie on an exercise mat with the legs extended and the hands either palms facing down next to you or under the glutes
Bend the knees and pull the upper thighs into the midsection as you breathe out
Contract the abs as you carry out this movement and hold for a second at the top
As you carry out the motion, the lower legs should always remain parallel to the floor
Return to the start as you inhale

exercises.name: Leg Raises, Lying

exercises.name: Leg raises pull up bar
instructions: With a firm grip with both hands on the bar, raise the outstretched legs, until you reach a 90° angle with the torso

exercises.name: Leg Raises, Standing
instructions: Set the forearms on the pads on the leg raise machine, the body is hanging freely
Lift now the legs with a fast movement as high as you can, make a short pause of 1sec at the top, and bring them down again

exercises.name: Leg-Up Hamstring Stretch
instructions: Lie flat on the back, bend one knee, and set that foot flat on the floor to stabilize the spine
Slowly straighten the legs as much as possible and then pull the leg toward the nose

exercises.name: Leverage Deadlift
instructions: Look forward with the head and keep the chest up

exercises.name: Leverage High Row
instructions: Pull the handles towards the torso, retracting the shoulder blades as you flex the elbow

exercises.name: Leverage Iso Row

exercises.name: Leverage Machine Chest Press

exercises.name: Leverage Machine Iso Row
instructions: Adjust seat height so that the handles are at the bottom of the pectorals or just below

exercises.name: Leverage Shrug
instructions: Look forward with the head and keep the chest up
Drive through the floor with the heels, extending the hips and knees as you rise to a standing position
Keep the arms straight throughout the movement, finishing with the shoulders back

exercises.name: Levitation Crunch
instructions: Lift upper body up and clear the

exercises.name: Linear 3-Part Start Technique
instructions: Position the left foot with the toe next to the right ankle
Position the right foot 4-6 inches behind the left
Position the right hand onto the line, and thing bring the nose close to the left knee
Take the left hand up so that it is parallel to the ground, pointing behind you, and explode out when ready

exercises.name: Linear Acceleration Wall Drill
instructions: Begin by lifting the right knee quickly, pausing, and then driving it straight down into the ground

exercises.name: Log Lift
instructions: Push the head back and look up, creating a shelf on the chest to rest the log
Continue by extending through the elbows to press the log above the head

exercises.name: London Bridges
instructions: Keeping the body straight, lean back and lower the body by slowly going hand over hand with the rope
Keeping the body straight, reverse the motion, going hand over hand back to the start

exercises.name: Long Lunge Pulse Stretch
instructions: Hold the resistance band above the head, between the hands, with the arms straight
Pull it taught to engage the lats
Step forwards into a lunge, dropping until the knee is almost touching the floor

exercises.name: Long-Pulley (low Row)
instructions: Sit down, set the feet on the supporting points and take hold of the bar with a wide grip
Keep the arms and elbows during the movement close to the body
The shoulders are pulled together

exercises.name: Long-Pulley, Narrow
instructions: Sit down, set the feet on the supporting points and take hold of the bar with a wide grip
Keep the arms and elbows during the movement close to the body
The shoulders are pulled together

exercises.name: Looking At Ceiling
instructions: Kneel on the floor, holding the heels with both hands
Lift the buttocks up and forward as bringing the head back to look up at the ceiling, to give an arch in the back

exercises.name: Low Box Squat - Wide Stance
instructions: Push the hips back and sit down to a box that takes you below parallel

exercises.name: Low Cable Crossover
instructions: To move into the start, position the pulleys at the low position, select the resistance to be used and grasp a handle in each hand
With a slight bend in the arms, draw the hands upward and toward the midline of the body
Return the arms back to the start after a brief pause

exercises.name: Low Cable Triceps Extension
instructions: The head should be pointing towards the attachment
Take hold of the outside of the rope ends with the palms facing each other
Position the elbows so that they are bent at a 90 degree angle and the upper arms are perpendicular to the torso
Keep the elbows in and confirm that the upper arms point to the ceiling as the forearms point towards the pulley above the head
As you breathe out, extend the lower arms until they are straight and vertical

exercises.name: Low Pulley Cable Fly
instructions: You can use neutral grip handles or straight handles depending on the preference
Neutral grip might be easier on the wrists
Stand with the feet shoulder-width apart, knees slightly bent, and core engaged
Maintain a slight arch in the lower back throughout the exercise
Take hold of the handles with the chosen grip and step back a small step or two until there's slight tension on the cables
Focus on squeezing the chest muscles rather than using the arms to pull the handles

exercises.name: Low Pulley Row To Neck
instructions: Take hold of the ends of the rope using a palms-down grip and sit with the back straight and the knees slightly bent
Keep the back almost completely vertical and the arms fully extended in front of you
As keeping the torso stationary, lift the elbows and start bending them as you pull the rope towards the neck as exhaling
After holding for a second or so at the contracted position, come back slowly to the start as you inhale

exercises.name: Lower Back Curl
instructions: Lie on the stomach with the arms out to the sides
Using the lower back muscles, extend the spine lifting the chest off of the ground
Keep the head up during the movement

exercises.name: Lower Back Extensions
instructions: Lift the bottom slightly
Keep the upper body straight

exercises.name: Lower Back-SMR
instructions: In a seated position, position a foam roll under the lower back
Cross the arms in front of you and protract the shoulders
Roll over the lower back, holding points of tension

exercises.name: Lunge Pass Through
instructions: Stand with the torso upright holding a kettlebell in the right hand
Step forward with the left foot and lower the upper body down by flexing the hip and the knee, keeping the torso upright
Lower the back knee until it nearly touches the ground
Pressing through the heel of the foot, return to the start

exercises.name: Lunge Sprint
instructions: Position yourself under the bar, racking it across the back of the shoulders
Lower the back knee nearly to the ground, flexing the knees and lowering the hips as you do so
Explosively drive through the heel of the front foot with light pressure from the back foot
Jump up and reverse the position of the legs

exercises.name: Lying Bent Leg Groin
instructions: Lie on the back with the knees bent and the soles of the feet pressed together
Have the partner hold the knees
Attempt to squeeze the knees together, as the partner prevents any movement from occurring
After 10-20 seconds, relax the muscles as the partner gently pushes the knees towards the floor

exercises.name: Lying Cable Curl
instructions: Take hold of a straight bar or E-Z bar attachment that is attached to the low pulley with both hands, using an underhand shoulder-width grip
With the arms extended and the elbows close to the body slightly bend the arms
As keeping the upper arms stationary and the elbows close to the body, curl the bar up slowly toward the chest as you breathe out and you squeeze the biceps
After a second squeeze at the top, slowly return to the start

exercises.name: Lying Cambered Barbell Row
instructions: Position a cambered bar underneath an exercise bench
Lie face down on the exercise bench and take hold of the bar using a palms down that is wider than shoulder width
As you exhale row the bar up as you keep the elbows close to the body to either the chest, in order to target the upper mid back
After a second hold at the top, lower back down to the start slowly as you inhale

exercises.name: Lying Close-Grip Bar Curl On High Pulley
instructions: Position a flat bench in front of a high pulley or lat pulldown machine
Hold the straight bar attachment using an underhand grip that is about shoulder width
Lie on the back with the head over the end of the bench
Extend the arms straight above the shoulders
As you breathe out, curl the bar down in a semicircular motion until it touches the chin
Return to start slowly

exercises.name: Lying Close-Grip Barbell Triceps Extension Behind The Head
instructions: As holding a barbell or EZ Curl bar with a pronated grip , lie on the back on a flat bench with the head close to the end of the bench
If you are holding a barbell take hold of it using a shoulder-width grip and if you are using an E-Z Bar take hold of it on the inner handles
Extend the arms in front of you and slowly bring the bar back in a semi circular motion to a position over the head
Keep the elbows in at all times
As you inhale, lower the bar by bending at the elbows and as keeping the upper arm stationary
Contract the triceps hard at the top for a second

exercises.name: Lying Close-Grip Barbell Triceps Press To Chin
instructions: As holding a barbell or EZ Curl bar with a pronated grip , lie on the back on a flat bench with the head off the end of the bench
If you are holding a barbell take hold of it using a shoulder-width grip and if you are using an E-Z Bar take hold of it on the inner handles
Extend the arms in front of you as you hold the barbell over the chest
As you inhale, lower the bar in a semi-circular motion by bending at the elbows and as keeping the upper arm stationary and elbows in
Keep lowering the bar until it lightly touches the chin
Contract the triceps hard at the top for a second

exercises.name: Lying Crossover
instructions: Lie on the back with the legs extended
Cross one leg over the body with the knee bent, attempting to touch the knee to the ground
The partner should kneel beside you, holding the shoulder down with one hand and controlling the crossed leg with the other
Attempt to raise the bent knee off of the ground as the partner prevents any actual movement
After 10-20 seconds, relax the leg as the partner gently presses the knee towards the floor

exercises.name: Lying Face Down Plate Neck Resistance

As keeping the plate secure on the back of the head slowly lower the head as you breathe in
Raise the head back up to the start in a semi-circular motion as you breathe out

exercises.name: Lying Face Up Plate Neck Resistance
instructions: You will need to position yourself so that the shoulders are slightly above the end of a flat bench in order for the traps, neck and head to be off the bench
As keeping the plate secure on the forehead slowly lower the head back in a semi-circular motion as you breathe in
Raise the head back up to the start in a semi-circular motion as you breathe out

exercises.name: Lying Glute
instructions: Lie on the back with the partner kneeling beside you
Turn the leg so the foot is over the opposite hip, the lower leg perpendicular to the body
The partner should hold the knee and ankle in position
Attempt to push the leg towards the partner, who should be preventing any actual movement of the leg
After 10-20 seconds, completely relax as the partner gently pushes the ankle and knee towards the chest

exercises.name: Lying Hamstring
instructions: Lie on the back with the legs extended
The partner should be kneeling beside you
Raise one leg up towards the ceiling and have the partner hold the ankle
With the partner holding the leg in position, attempt to flex the knee, contracting the hamstrings
Relax the leg, allowing the partner to gently push the leg towards the head

exercises.name: Lying High Bench Barbell Curl
instructions: Lie face forward on a tall flat bench as holding a barbell with a supinated grip
If you are holding a barbell take hold of it using a shoulder-width grip and if you are using an E-Z Bar take hold of it on the inner handles

exercises.name: Lying Leg Curls
instructions: Adjust the machine lever to fit the height and lie face down on the leg curl machine with the pad of the lever on the back of the legs
Keeping the torso flat on the bench, confirm the legs are fully stretched and take hold of the side handles of the machine
Position the toes straight
As you exhale, curl the legs up as far as possible without lifting the upper legs from the pad

exercises.name: Lying Machine Squat
instructions: Adjust the leg machine to a height that will allow you to get inside it with the knees bent and the thighs slightly below parallel
Position the hands by the handles and position the feet slightly pointing out at a shoulder width position
As pressing with the balls of the feet as you breathe out, make the whole body erect as you squeeze the quads
Slowly squat down as you inhale but instead of going all the way down to the start, just stop once the thighs are parallel to the platform

exercises.name: Lying One-Arm Lateral Raise
instructions: As holding a dumbbell in one hand, lay with the chest down on a flat bench
Position the palm of the hand that is holding the dumbbell in a neutral manner as you keep the arm extended with the elbow slightly bent
Raise the arm with the dumbbell to the side until the elbow is at shoulder height and the arm is roughly parallel to the floor as you exhale
Maintain the arm perpendicular to the torso as keeping the arm extended throughout the movement
Slowly lower the dumbbell to the start as you inhale

exercises.name: Lying Prone Quadriceps
instructions: Flex one knee and raise that leg off the ground, attempting to touch the glutes with the foot
The partner should hold the knee and ankle
Attempt to extend the knee as the partner prevents any actual movement
After 10-20 seconds, relax the muscles as the partner gently pushes the foot towards the glutes, further stretching the quadriceps and hip flexors

exercises.name: Lying Rear Delt Raise
instructions: As holding a dumbbell in each hand, lay with the chest down on a flat bench
Position the palms of the hands in a neutral manner as you keep the arms extended with the elbows slightly bent
Raise the arms to the side until the elbows are at shoulder height and the arms are roughly parallel to the floor as you exhale
Maintain the arms perpendicular to the torso as keeping them extended throughout the movement
Slowly lower the dumbbells to the start as you inhale

exercises.name: Lying Supine Dumbbell Curl
instructions: Lie down on a flat bench face up as holding a dumbbell in each arm on top of the thighs
Bring the dumbbells to the sides with the arms extended and the palms of the hands facing the thighs
As keeping the arms close to the torso and elbows in, slowly lower the arms as far down towards the floor as you can go
Return back to the start very slowly
