Squeeze the shoulder blades together, so that the elbows are located behind the torso with the upper arms nearly parallel to the floor
Lift the dumbbells until the arms form a straight line

exercises.name: Lying Triceps Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with either an e-z bar or a straight bar placed on the floor behind the head and the feet on the floor
Take hold of the bar behind you, using a medium overhand grip, and raise the bar in front of you at arms length

exercises.name: Machine Bench Press
instructions: Step on the lever provided by the machine since it will help you to bring the handles forward so that you can take hold of the handles and fully extend the arms
Take hold of the handles with a palms-down grip and lift the elbows so that the upper arms are parallel to the floor to the sides of the torso
The forearms will be pointing forward since you are grabbing the handles
When finished step on the lever again and slowly get the handles back to their original position

exercises.name: Machine Bicep Curl
instructions: Position the upper arms against the pads and grasp the handles
Carry out the movement by flexing the elbow, pulling the lower arm towards the upper arm

exercises.name: Machine Preacher Curls
instructions: Position the back of the upper arms on the preacher pad provided and take hold of the handles using an underhand grip
Confirm that when you position the arms on the pad you keep the elbows in
Lower the handles slowly back to the start as you inhale

exercises.name: Machine Shoulder (Military) Press
instructions: Take hold of the handles to the sides as you keep the elbows bent and in line with the torso
Lower the handles slowly back to the start as you inhale

exercises.name: Machine Side Lateral Raises
instructions: How to carry out Machine Lateral Raises
Adjust the seat so the shoulders align with the machine's pivot point, the chest is against the pad , and the arms are at a 90-degree angle with the pads/handles
Grip the handles with a relaxed grip, elbows slightly bent, and shoulders down away from the ears
Exhale and lift the arms out to the sides, moving the upper arms laterally, until they are parallel to the floor
Pause briefly at the top, squeezing the side delts, but don't shrug the shoulders up

exercises.name: Machine Triceps Extension
instructions: Position the upper arms against the pads and grasp the handles
Carry out the movement by extending the elbow, pulling the lower arm away from the upper arm

exercises.name: Marching High Knees
instructions: ​Movement: Stand tall and lift one knee toward the chest as high as comfortable
​Arms: Swing the opposite arm forward as you lift the knee, similar to a walking motion
​Core: Keep the abs engaged to maintain an upright posture
​Pace: carry out the movement with control, alternating legs rhythmically

exercises.name: Meadows Row
instructions: Lean the torso forward and grip the barbell
Start this movement by driving the elbow behind you as retracting the shoulder-blade
Pull toward the back hip until the elbow is level with the torso

exercises.name: Medicine Ball Chest Pass
instructions: Begin facing the partner holding the medicine ball at the torso with both hands
Pull the ball to the chest, and reverse the motion by extending through the elbows
The partner should catch the ball, and throw it back to you

exercises.name: Medicine Ball Full Twist
instructions: Stand back to back with the partner, spaced 2-3 feet apart
Open the hips and turn the shoulders at the same time as the partner

exercises.name: Medicine Ball Scoop Throw
instructions: The arms should hang so the ball is near the feet
As you do, swing the arms up and over the head, keeping them extended, releasing the ball at the peak of the movement

exercises.name: Middle Back Shrug
instructions: Lie facedown on an incline bench as holding a dumbbell in each hand
As you exhale, squeeze the shoulder blades together and hold the contraction for a full second

exercises.name: Middle Back Stretch
instructions: Stand so the feet are shoulder width apart and the hands are on the hips
Twist at the waist until you feel a stretch

exercises.name: Military Press mit SZ-Bar
instructions: On an SZ-bar grip the hands on the outside of each bend and stand with the arms straight down, palms facing the legs
Pull the bar to the chest, and the push the bar above the head
Return the bar to the chest by dropping the arms at the elbows

exercises.name: Monster Walk
instructions: Position a band around both ankles and another around both knees
To begin, take short steps forward alternating the left and right foot

exercises.name: Mountain Climbers
instructions: Flexing the knee and hip, bring one leg until the knee is about under the hip
Explosively reverse the positions of the legs, extending the bent leg until the leg is straight and supported by the toe, and bringing the other foot up with the hip and knee flexed

exercises.name: Moving Claw Series
instructions: As you run, be sure to flex the knee, aiming to kick the glutes as the hip extends
Confirm that as you run, you block with the arms, punching through in a rapid 1-2 motion

exercises.name: Muscle Up
instructions: Grip the rings using a false grip, with the base of the palms on top of the rings
Initiate a pull up by pulling the elbows down to the side, flexing the elbows
As you reach the top position of the pull-up, pull the rings to the armpits as you roll the shoulders forward, allowing the elbows to move straight back behind you

exercises.name: Muscle up
instructions: The legs swing up and provide momentum to assist in the explosive upward force needed to ascend above the bar
More advanced athletes can carry out a strict variation of the muscle-up which is done slowly, without any kip

exercises.name: Narrow Stance Hack Squats
instructions: Position the back of the torso against the back pad of the machine and hook the shoulders under the shoulder pads provided
Position the legs in the platform using a less than shoulder width narrow stance with the toes slightly pointed out
Keep the head up at all times and also maintain the back on the pad at all times
Position the arms on the side handles of the machine and disengage the safety bars
Straighten the legs without locking the knees
Begin to raise the unit as you exhale by pushing the floor with mainly with the heels of the feet as you straighten the legs again and go back to the start

exercises.name: Narrow Stance Leg Press
instructions: Using a leg press machine, sit down on the machine and position the legs on the platform directly in front of you at a less-than-shoulder-width narrow stance with the toes slightly pointed out
Keep the head up at all times and also maintain the back on the pad at all times
Lower the safety bars holding the weighted platform in position and press the platform all the way up until the legs are fully extended in front of you
As you inhale, slowly lower the platform until the upper and lower legs make a 90-degree angle
Pushing mainly with the heels of the feet and using the quadriceps go back to the start as you exhale

exercises.name: Narrow Stance Squats
instructions: Hold on to the bar using both arms at each side and lift it off the rack by first pushing with the legs and at the same time straightening the torso
Step away from the rack and position the legs using a less-than-shoulder-width narrow stance with the toes slightly pointed out
Keep the head up at all times and maintain a straight back
Begin to raise the bar as you exhale by pushing the floor with the heel of the foot mainly as you straighten the legs again and go back to the start

exercises.name: Natural Glute Ham Raise
instructions: Lower yourself under control until the knees are almost completely straight

exercises.name: Neck Press
instructions: Using a medium-width grip , lift the bar from the rack and hold it straight over the neck with the arms locked
As you breathe in, come down slowly until you feel the bar on the neck
After a second pause, bring the bar back to the start as you breathe out and push the bar using the chest muscles
Lock the arms and squeeze the chest in the contracted position, hold for a second and then start coming down slowly again
When you are done, position the bar back in the rack

exercises.name: Neck-SMR
instructions: Starting at the top of the neck, slowly roll down the muscles of the neck, pausing at points of tension

exercises.name: Negative Crunches
instructions: Sit yourself on the decline bench and fix the legs
Cross the arms over the chest and bring with a rolling movement the upper body up, go now without a pause and with a slow movement down again

exercises.name: Neutral-grip chest pulldown
instructions: Position yourself in front of the cable machine with the knees slightly bent and the feet on the floor
Grip the cable handle with the palms facing each other and the hands shoulder-width apart
Pull the handle down until it touches or comes close to the chest, holding the position for one or two seconds
Slowly raise the handle back to the start, making sure to keep the arms and hands straight and the back straight throughout the movement

exercises.name: No Leg Drive Dumbbell Chest Press
Oblique Crunches
instructions: Lie flat on the floor with the lower back pressed to the ground
Confirm the feet are elevated and resting on a flat surface
Lift the shoulder in which the hand is touching the head
Simply elevate the shoulder and body upward until you touch the knee

exercises.name: Oblique Crunches - On The Floor
instructions: Start out by lying on the right side with the legs lying on top of each other
Position the left hand behind the head

exercises.name: Olympic Squat
instructions: Confirm that they stay aligned with the feet

exercises.name: On-Your-Back Quad Stretch
instructions: Press the foot down and into the hand

exercises.name: On Your Side Quad Stretch
instructions: Start off by lying on the right side, with the right knee bent at a 90-degree angle resting on the floor in front of you
Bend the left knee behind you and hold the left foot with the left hand

exercises.name: One Arm Against Wall
instructions: From a standing position, position a bent arm against a wall or doorway
Slowly lean toward the arm until you feel a stretch in the lats

exercises.name: One Arm Chin-Up
instructions: Take hold of the chin-up bar with the palm facing you
Bring the torso back around 30 degrees or so as creating a curvature on the lower back and sticking the chest out
Pull the torso up until the bar touches the upper chest by drawing the shoulders and the upper arms down and back
Exhale as you carry out this portion of the movement

exercises.name: One Arm Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie down on a flat bench with a dumbbell in one hand on top of the thigh
Once at shoulder width, turn the wrist forward so that the palm of the hand is facing away from you
Only use the non-lifting hand if it is needed

exercises.name: One Arm Dumbbell Preacher Curl
instructions: Take hold of a dumbbell with the right arm and position the upper arm on top of the preacher bench or the incline bench
As you breathe in, slowly lower the dumbbell until the upper arm is extended and the biceps is fully stretched

exercises.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
instructions: Position the right leg on top of the end of the bench, bend the torso forward from the waist until the upper body is parallel to the floor
Pull the resistance straight up to the side of the chest, keeping the upper arm close to the side and keeping the torso stationary
Breathe out as you carry out this step
Breathe in as you carry out this step

exercises.name: One-Arm Flat Bench Dumbbell Flye
instructions: Lie down on a flat bench with a dumbbell in one hand resting on top of the thigh
The non lifting hand should be to the side holding the flat bench for better support
Breathe in as you carry out this portion of the movement
Keep in mind that throughout the movement, the lifting arm should remain stationary
Return the lifting arm back to the start as you squeeze the chest muscles and breathe out

exercises.name: One Arm Floor Press
instructions: Lie down on a flat surface with the back pressing against the floor or an exercise mat
When starting, the arm should be just about fully extended, similar to the start of a barbell bench press
Begin the exercise by lowering the barbell until the elbow touches the ground
Confirm to breathe in as this is the eccentric

exercises.name: One-Arm Heavy Row
instructions: Pull the dumbbell toward the lower chest or waist, leading with the elbow
Keep the torso stable — avoid twisting or rotating the shoulders
Pause at the top and squeeze the lats

exercises.name: One-Arm High-Pulley Cable Side Bends
instructions: With one hand, reach up and take hold of handle with underhand grip
Pull down cable until elbow touches the side and the handle is by the shoulder

exercises.name: One-Arm Incline Lateral Raise
instructions: Confirm the shoulder is pressing against the incline bench and the arm is lying across the body with the palm around the navel
Hold a dumbbell in the uppermost arm as keeping it extended in front of you parallel to the floor
As keeping the dumbbell parallel to the floor at all times, carry out a lateral raise
Exhale as you carry out this movement

exercises.name: One-Arm Kettlebell Clean
instructions: Position a kettlebell between the feet
As you bend down to take hold of the kettlebell, push the butt back and keep the eyes looking forward
Clean the kettlebell to the shoulders by extending through the legs and hips as you raise the kettlebell towards the shoulder
The wrist should turn as you do so

exercises.name: One-Arm Kettlebell Clean and Jerk
instructions: Clean the kettlebell to the shoulder by extending through the legs and hips as you pull the kettlebell towards the shoulder
Turn the wrist as you do so, so that the palm faces forward
Dip the body by bending the knees, keeping the torso upright

exercises.name: One-Arm Kettlebell Floor Press
instructions: Lie on the floor holding a kettlebell with one hand, with the upper arm supported by the floor
Press the kettlebell straight up toward the ceiling, rotating the wrist

exercises.name: One-Arm Kettlebell Jerk
instructions: Clean the kettlebell to the shoulder by extending through the legs and hips as you pull the kettlebell towards the shoulder
Turn the wrist as you do so, so that the palm faces forward
Dip the body by bending the knees, keeping the torso upright

exercises.name: One-Arm Kettlebell Military Press To The Side
instructions: Clean a kettlebell to the shoulder
Clean the kettlebell to the shoulder by extending through the legs and hips as you pull the kettlebell towards the shoulder
Turn the wrist as you do so, so that the palm faces inward
Lower the kettlebell back to the shoulder under control
Confirm to contract the lat, butt, and stomach forcefully for added stability and strength

exercises.name: One-Arm Kettlebell Para Press
instructions: Clean a kettlebell to the shoulder
Clean the kettlebell to the shoulder by extending through the legs and hips as you pull the kettlebell towards the shoulder
Turn the wrist as you do so, so that the palm faces forward
Lower the kettlebell back to the shoulder under control
Confirm to contract the lat, butt, and stomach forcefully for added stability and strength

exercises.name: One-Arm Kettlebell Push Press
instructions: Clean the kettlebell to the shoulder by extending through the legs and hips as you pull the kettlebell towards the shoulder
Turn the wrist as you do so, so that the palm faces forward
Dip the body by bending the knees, keeping the torso upright

exercises.name: One-Arm Kettlebell Row
instructions: Position a kettlebell in front of the feet
Bend the knees slightly and then push the butt out as much as possible as you bend over to get in the start
Take hold of the kettlebell and pull it to the stomach, retracting the shoulder blade and flexing the elbow

exercises.name: One-Arm Kettlebell Snatch
instructions: Position a kettlebell between the feet
Bend the knees and push the butt back to get in the proper start
Look straight ahead and swing the kettlebell back between the legs

exercises.name: One-Arm Kettlebell Split Jerk
instructions: Clean the kettlebell to the shoulder by extending through the legs and hips as you pull the kettlebell towards the shoulder
Turn the wrist as you do so, so that the palm faces forward
Dip the body by bending the knees, keeping the torso upright

exercises.name: One-Arm Kettlebell Split Snatch
instructions: Confirm you drive through with the hips and lock the ketttlebells overhead in one uninterrupted motion

exercises.name: One Arm Lat Pulldown
instructions: Pull the handle down, squeezing the elbow to the side as you flex the elbow

exercises.name: One-Arm Long Bar Row
instructions: The arm should be extended

exercises.name: One-Arm Medicine Ball Slam
instructions: Hold a medicine ball in one hand, on the same side as the back leg
Begin by winding the arm, raising the medicine ball above the head

exercises.name: One-Arm Open Palm Kettlebell Clean
instructions: Position one kettlebell between the feet
Take hold of the handle with one hand and raise the kettlebell rapidly, let it flip so that the ball of the kettlebell lands in the palm of the hand

exercises.name: One Arm Overhead Cable Tricep Extension
instructions: As keeping the back straight and upper arm stationary, lower the cable behind the head until you feel a good stretch in the triceps, and then extend it back upward until the elbow is locked out

exercises.name: One-Arm Overhead Kettlebell Squats
instructions: Clean the kettlebell to the shoulder by extending through the legs and hips as you pull the kettlebell towards the shoulder
Turn the wrist as you do so
Looking straight ahead and keeping a kettlebell locked out above you, flex the knees and hips and lower the torso between the legs, keeping the head and chest up
Pause at the bottom position for a second before rising back to the top, driving through the heels of the feet

exercises.name: One Arm Pronated Dumbbell Triceps Extension
instructions: Lie flat on a bench as holding a dumbbell at arms length
Position the non lifting hand on the bicep for support

exercises.name: One-Arm Side Deadlift
instructions: Bend the knees and lower the body until you are able to reach the barbell
The arms should extend fully as bring the barbell up until you are in a standing position
Slowly bring the barbell back down as inhaling

exercises.name: One-Arm Side Laterals
instructions: Pick a dumbbell and position it in one of the hands
The non lifting hand should be used to take hold of something steady such as an incline bench press
Lean towards the lifting arm and away from the hand that is gripping the incline bench as this will allow you to keep the balance
Stand with a straight torso and have the dumbbell by the side at arm's length with the palm of the hand facing you
As maintaining the torso stationary , lift the dumbbell to the side with a slight bend on the elbow and the hand slightly tilted forward as if pouring water in a glass
Lower the dumbbell back down slowly to the start as you inhale

exercises.name: One Arm Supinated Dumbbell Triceps Extension
instructions: Lie flat on a bench as holding a dumbbell at arms length
Position the non lifting hand on the bicep for support

exercises.name: One armed push-ups
instructions: Carry out push-ups with one hand, alternating the sides

exercises.name: One Half Locust
instructions: Set the left hand under the left hipbone to pad the hip and pubic bone
Bend the right knee so you can hold the foot in the right hand
Lift the foot in the air and simultaneously lift the shoulders off the floor

exercises.name: One Handed Hang
instructions: Take hold of onto a chinup bar with one hand, using a pronated grip
Keep the feet on the floor or a step

exercises.name: one-handed kettlebell curls
instructions: Standing with the kettlebell in one hand and bent at the elbow, start from a fully extended position until the hand reaches shoulder height
To carry out the movement correctly, try not to push with the back or body

exercises.name: One Knee To Chest
instructions: Extend one leg straight and pull the other knee to the chest

exercises.name: One Leg Barbell Squat
instructions: Start by standing about 2 to 3 feet in front of a flat bench with the back facing the bench
Bend the knees and use a pronated grip with the hands being wider than shoulder width apart from each other to lift the barbell up until you can rest it on the chest
Lift the barbell over the head and rest it on the base of the neck
Move one foot back so that the toe is resting on the flat bench
Keep the head up at all times as looking down will get you off balance and also maintain a straight back
At this point, the knee should be over the toes

exercises.name: One-Legged Cable Kickback
instructions: As keeping the knees and hips bent slightly and the abs tight, contract the glutes to slowly "kick" the working leg back in a semicircular arc as high as it will comfortably go as you breathe out
At full extension, squeeze the glutes for a second in order to achieve a peak contraction
Slowly bring the working leg forward, resisting the pull of the cable until you reach the start

exercises.name: Open Book
instructions: Spinal segmentation as opening the shoulders and chest
Kneeling on the floor with the right side facing a wall
Lengthen the spine and align the head comfortably
Begin with the arms relaxed and open in front of the chest, palms
Exhale as you complete the rotation, guiding the left hand

exercises.name: Open Palm Kettlebell Clean
instructions: Position one kettlebell between the feet
Clean the kettlebell by extending through the legs and hips as you raise the kettlebell towards the shoulders
Release the kettlebell as it comes up, and let it flip so that the ball of the kettlebell lands in the palms of the hands

exercises.name: Otis-Up
instructions: Initiate the movement by flexing the hips and spine to raise the torso up from the ground

exercises.name: Overhead Barbell Press
instructions: Brace the core and push the bar straight up until the arms lock out

exercises.name: Overhead Cable Curl
instructions: Adjust the height of the pulleys on each side and confirm that they are positioned at a height higher than that of the shoulders
Stand in the middle of both sides and use an underhand grip to take hold of each handle
As exhaling, slowly squeeze the biceps on each side until the forearms and biceps touch
As inhaling, move the forearms back to the start

exercises.name: Overhead Cable Tricep Extension
instructions: Straighten the arms until they are filly extended and reverse the motion resisting on the negative

exercises.name: Overhead Lat
instructions: Sit upright on the floor with the partner behind you
Raise one arm straight up, and flex the elbow, attempting to touch the hand to the back
The parner should hold the tricep and wrist
Attempt to pull the upper arm to the side as the partner prevents you from doing actually doing so
After 10-20 seconds, relax the arm and allow the partner to further stretch the lat by applying gentle pressure to the tricep

exercises.name: Overhead Slam
instructions: Hold a medine ball with both hands and stand with the feet at shoulder width
Initiate the countermovement by raising the ball above the head and fully extending the body

exercises.name: Overhead Squat
instructions: Bend the knees and use a pronated grip to take hold of the barbell
Once you are positioned, lift the barbell up until you can rest it on the chest
Move the barbell over and slightly behind the head and confirm the arms are fully extended
Keep the head up at all times and also maintain a straight back

exercises.name: Overhead Stretch
instructions: Standing straight up, lace the fingers together and open the palms to the ceiling
Keep the shoulders down as you extend the arms up

exercises.name: Overhead Triceps
instructions: Sit upright on the floor with the partner behind you
Raise one arm straight up, and flex the elbow, attempting to touch the hand to the back
The parner should hold the elbow and wrist
Attempt to extend the arm straight into the air as the partner prevents you from doing actually doing so
After 10-20 seconds, relax the arm and allow the partner to further stretch the tricep by applying gentle pressure to the wrist

exercises.name: Overhead Triceps Extension
instructions: The overhead position emphasizes the long head of the triceps , the exercise does engage all three triceps heads to some degree during extension
Sit on a bench and hold an EZ bar with a narrow, overhand
And elbows close to the head
Extend the arms back up to the start, squeezing the triceps at the top

exercises.name: Pallof Press
instructions: With the feet positioned hip-width apart and knees slightly bent, hold the cable to the middle of the chest
Press the cable away from the chest, fully extending both arms

exercises.name: Pallof Press With Rotation
instructions: With the feet positioned hip-width apart, pull the cable into the chest and take hold of the handle with the other hand
Facing forward, press the cable away from the chest
Keeping the hips straight, twist the torso away from the pulley until you get a full quarter rotation
Maintain the rigid stance and straight arms
The arms should be extended in front of you

exercises.name: Palms-Down Dumbbell Wrist Curl Over A Bench
instructions: Kneel down on both of the knees so that the body is facing the flat bench
Use the arms to take hold of both of the dumbbells with a pronated grip and bring them up so that the forearms are resting against the flat bench
The wrists should be hanging over the edge
Start out by curling the wrist upwards and exhaling
Slowly lower the wrists back down to the start as inhaling

exercises.name: Palms-Down Wrist Curl Over A Bench
instructions: Kneel down on both of the knees so that the body is facing the flat bench
Use the arms to take hold of the barbell with a pronated grip and bring them up so that the forearms are resting against the flat bench
The wrists should be hanging over the edge
Start out by curling the wrist upwards and exhaling
Slowly lower the wrists back down to the start as inhaling

exercises.name: Palms-Up Barbell Wrist Curl Over A Bench
instructions: Kneel down on both of the knees so that the body is facing the flat bench
Use the arms to take hold of the barbell with a supinated grip and bring them up so that the forearms are resting against the flat bench
The wrists should be hanging over the edge
Start out by curling the wrist upwards and exhaling
Slowly lower the wrists back down to the start as inhaling

exercises.name: Palms-Up Dumbbell Wrist Curl Over A Bench
instructions: Kneel down on both of the knees so that the body is facing the flat bench
Use the arms to take hold of both of the dumbbells with a supinated grip and bring them up so that the forearms are resting against the flat bench
The wrists should be hanging over the edge
Start out by curling the wrist upwards and exhaling
Slowly lower the wrists back down to the start as inhaling

exercises.name: Parallel Bar Dip
instructions: Position a hand on each bar, and then take a small jump to help you get into the start with the arms locked out
Begin by flexing the elbow, lowering the body until the arms break 90 degrees

exercises.name: Parallel Bar Hold
instructions: Position the hands, knuckles outwards, on the bars
Push down on the hands to lift yourself off the floor
Hold yourself in this position with the arms straight for the required time

exercises.name: Pause Bench
instructions: Lower the bar to the chest and pause there

exercises.name: Pelvic Tilt Into Bridge
instructions: Lie down with the feet on the floor, heels directly under the knees
Lift only the tailbone to the ceiling to stretch the lower back
Pull in the stomach

exercises.name: Pendulum Squat
instructions: Position the feet in the middle of the plate at about shoulder width
Keep the neck relaxed

exercises.name: Peroneals-SMR
instructions: Raise the hips off of the ground and begin to roll from below the knee to above the ankle on the side of the leg, pausing at points of tension

exercises.name: Perpendicular Unilateral Landmine Row
instructions: Raise the barbell to chest height, with the upper arm parallel to the floor at the top

exercises.name: Physioball Hip Bridge
instructions: Begin by extending the hips using the glutes and hamstrings, raising the hips upward as you bridge

exercises.name: Pike Hold (Floor)
instructions: Position the hands and feet securely on the floor, then raise the hips
Keep the elbows straight and actively push the floor away through the shoulders

exercises.name: Pin Bench Press BB
instructions: Lower the bar, rest on the pins for 1s as holding tension

exercises.name: Pin Presses
instructions: Begin by lying on the bench, with the bar directly above the contact point during the regular bench
Use the feet to drive the traps into the bench

exercises.name: Piriformis-SMR
instructions: Sit with the buttocks on top of a foam roll
Bend the knees, and then cross one leg so that the ankle is over the knee

exercises.name: Pistol Squat
instructions: Extend the leg straight out
Brace the core and look straight ahead
Keep the leg and arms extended for the whole duration

exercises.name: Plank
instructions: Set the body in a straight line and brace the trunk.
Hold the position without letting the line break.

exercises.name: Plank Shoulder Taps
instructions: In the correct plank position, position the feet slightly wider than shoulder-width apart

exercises.name: Plate-Loaded Lat Pulldown
instructions: Sit at a plate-loaded lat pulldown machine with the thighs secured under the pads
Pull the handles down toward the upper chest by driving the elbows down and back, squeezing the lats at the bottom

exercises.name: Plate Pinch
instructions: Take hold of two wide-rimmed plates and set them together with the smooth sides facing outward
Squeeze the plate with the fingers and thumb

exercises.name: Plate Pinch Hold
instructions: Hold the plates with the arm straight down by the side or extended slightly in front of you
Maintain the hold for as long as you can, keeping the shoulders relaxed and the grip firm

exercises.name: Plate Twist
instructions: Lie down on the floor or an exercise mat with the legs fully extended and the upper body upright
Take hold of the plate by its sides with both hands out in front of the abdominals with the arms slightly bent
Slowly cross the legs near the ankles and lift them up off the ground
Move the upper body back slightly to help keep you balanced turning this exercise
Come back to the start as you breathe in and then

exercises.name: Platform Hamstring Slides
instructions: Begin the movement by flexing the knee, keeping the other leg straight

exercises.name: Plie Dumbbell Squat
instructions: Move the legs so that they are wider than shoulder width apart from each other with the knees slightly bent
Slowly bend the knees and lower the legs until the thighs are parallel to the floor
Press mainly with the heel of the foot to bring the body back to the start as exhaling

exercises.name: Plyo Kettlebell Pushups
instructions: Position a kettlebell on the floor
Position yourself in a pushup position, on the toes with one hand on the ground and one hand holding the kettlebell, with the elbows extended
Begin by lowering yourself as low as you can, keeping the back straight

exercises.name: Plyo Push-up
instructions: Keep the body straight throughout the movement
Descend by flexing at the elbow, lowering the chest towards the ground
Attempt to push the upper body up until the hands leave the ground

exercises.name: Posterior Pelvic Tilt
instructions: Lie on the back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor
Flatten the lower back against the floor by tilting the pelvis posteriorly, engaging the abs and glutes

exercises.name: Power Clean
instructions: Stand with the feet slightly wider than shoulder width apart and toes pointing out slightly
Position the bar about 1 inch in front of the shins and over the balls of the feet
Keep the head in a neutral position with the eyes focused straight ahead

exercises.name: Power Clean from Blocks
instructions: Begin the first pull by driving through the heels, extending the knees
At peak extension, pull yourself under the bar far enough that it can be racked onto the shoulders, rotating the elbows under the bar as you do so

exercises.name: Power Jerk
instructions: Drive through the heels create as much speed and force as possible, and be sure to move the head out of the way as the bar leaves the shoulders

exercises.name: Power Partials
instructions: Stand up with the torso upright and a dumbbell on each hand being held at arms length

exercises.name: Power Snatch
instructions: As you move the feet into the receiving position, a slightly wider position, pull yourself below the bar as you elevate the bar overhead

exercises.name: Power Snatch from Blocks
instructions: As you move the feet into the receiving position, forcefully pull yourself below the bar as you elevate the bar overhead

exercises.name: Preacher Curl
instructions: To carry out this movement you will need a preacher bench and an E-Z bar
Take hold of the E-Z curl bar at the close inner handle
As you breathe in, slowly lower the bar until the upper arm is extended and the biceps is fully stretched

exercises.name: Preacher Hammer Dumbbell Curl
instructions: As you breathe in, slowly lower the dumbbells until the upper arm is extended and the biceps is fully stretched

exercises.name: Press Sit-Up
instructions: To begin, lie down on a bench with a barbell resting on the chest
Position the legs so they are secure on the extension of the abdominal bench
As inhaling, tighten the abdominals and glutes
Simultaneously curl the torso as you do when performing a sit-up and press the barbell to an overhead position as exhaling
Lower the upper body back down to the start as bringing the barbell back down to the torso
Remember to breathe in as lowering the body

exercises.name: Prisoner Squat
instructions: Stand upright with the chest slightly raised, the feet hip-width apart and the toes pointing straight ahead
Bring the hands to the back of the head with the fingers slightly interlaced and the elbows pointing to the side
Push the hips back and bend the knees, keeping the upper body as upright as possible
Push the knees outwards, they must never point towards each other
If the upper body moves slightly forward, confirm that it does not bend
Always keep the elbows level with the ears by tensing the muscles between the shoulder blades

exercises.name: Prone Manual Hamstring
instructions: The assistant will position their hand on the heel
To begin, flex the knee to curl the leg up
Pause at the top, returning the leg to the start as the partner provides resistance going the other direction

exercises.name: Prone Scapular Retraction - Arms at Side
instructions: Slowly lift the arms, pulling the shoulderblades together, hold

exercises.name: Prowler Sprint
instructions: Position the hands on the handles with the arms extended, leaning into the implement

exercises.name: Pull Through
instructions: Begin the movement by reaching through the legs as far as possible, bending at the hips
Keep the knees slightly bent
Keeping the arms straight, extend through the hip to stand straight up

exercises.name: Pull-ups
instructions: Take hold of the pull up bar with a wide grip, the body is hanging freely
Keep the chest out and pull yourself up till the chin reaches the bar or it touches the neck, if you want to pull behind you

exercises.name: Pull-Ups (Neutral Grip)
instructions: Drive the elbows down and back, pulling the chest toward the hands
Keep the shoulders depressed and retracted
Focus on squeezing the lats and upper back at the top
Chin should clear or reach the level of the hands
Pause briefly and contract the lats hard

exercises.name: Pull-Ups (Wide Grip)
instructions: Drive the elbows down and slightly back, pulling the chest toward the bar
Focus on leading with the chest, not the chin
Keep the shoulders depressed
Pause for a brief squeeze in the lats

exercises.name: Pullups
instructions: Take the bar with an overhand grip.
Choose a wide, medium, or close hand spacing relative to shoulder width.
Draw the shoulders and upper arms down and back to raise the torso until the bar reaches the upper chest.
Breathe out through this part of the movement.
Squeeze the back at the top, then return under control.

exercises.name: Push OHP
instructions: Bend knees as keeping upper body straight

exercises.name: Push Press - Behind the Neck
instructions: Return to the start, using the legs to absorb the impact

exercises.name: Push Press
instructions: Clean the dumbbells onto the shoulders, palms facing in
Take a breath and brace the core
Dip at the knees and use the legs to help press the dumbbells overhead
Lower under control with a slow tempo to the shoulders

exercises.name: Push-Up
instructions: Start in a plank with the hands a little wider than the shoulders, feet together, and a straight line from head to heels.
Brace the core and bend the elbows to lower the body.
Keep the elbows close to the body or slightly flared, and maintain a neutral spine until the chest is near the floor.
Press through the palms and straighten the arms to return to the start.

exercises.name: Push Up to Side Plank
instructions: Get into pushup position on the toes with the hands just outside of shoulder width
Carry out a pushup by allowing the elbows to flex
As you descend, keep the body straight

exercises.name: Push-Up Wide
instructions: The elbows should be extended and the body straight
To begin, allow the elbows to flex, lowering the chest to the floor as you inhale
Using the pectoral muscles, press the upper body back up to the start by extending the elbows
Exhale as you carry out this step

exercises.name: Push-Ups - Close Triceps Position
instructions: Lie on the floor face down and position the hands closer than shoulder width for a close hand position
Confirm that you are holding the torso up at arms' length
Lower yourself until the chest almost touches the floor as you inhale
Breathe out as you carry out this step

exercises.name: Push-Ups | Decline
instructions: To carry out a decline push-up, elevate the feet on an elevated surface, such as a bench, chair, or step, as placing the hands on the ground in a push-up position
Lower the body towards the ground as maintaining a straight line from the shoulders to the ankles, and then push back up to the start
The decline push-up can be a great way to challenge the upper body strength and improve the ability to carry out other push-up variations

exercises.name: Push-Ups | Incline
instructions: Inclined push-ups primarily target the chest muscles , but also work the triceps, shoulders, and core to a lesser extent

exercises.name: Push-Ups | Parallettes
instructions: To carry out a parallettes push-up, assume a push-up position with the hands on the parallettes and the feet on the ground
Lower the body towards the ground as keeping the elbows close to the sides, and then push back up to the start

exercises.name: Push-Ups With Feet Elevated
instructions: Lie on the floor face down and position the hands about 36 inches apart from each other holding the torso up at arms length
Position the toes on top of a flat bench
Lower yourself until the chest almost touches the floor as you inhale
Using the pectoral muscles, press the upper body back up to the start and squeeze the chest
Breathe out as you carry out this step

exercises.name: Push-Ups With Feet On An Exercise Ball
instructions: Lie on the floor face down and position the hands about 36 inches apart from each other holding the torso up at arms length
Position the toes on top of an exercise ball
Lower yourself until the chest almost touches the floor as you inhale
Using the pectoral muscles, press the upper body back up to the start and squeeze the chest
Breathe out as you carry out this step

exercises.name: Pushups
instructions: Lie on the floor face down and position the hands about 36 inches apart as holding the torso up at arms length
Next, lower yourself downward until the chest almost touches the floor as you inhale
Breathe out and press the upper body back up to the start as squeezing the chest

exercises.name: Pushups (Close and Wide Hand Positions)
instructions: Lie on the floor face down and body straight with the toes on the floor and the hands wider than shoulder width for a wide hand position and closer than shoulder width for a close hand position
Confirm you are holding the torso up at arms length
Lower yourself until the chest almost touches the floor as you inhale
Using the pectoral muscles, press the upper body back up to the start and squeeze the chest
Breathe out as you carry out this step

exercises.name: Pyramid
instructions: Start off by rolling the torso forward onto the ball so the hips rest on top of the ball and become the highest point of the body

exercises.name: Quad Sets
instructions: Sit or lie down with the legs straight
Tighten the quadriceps muscles as keeping the leg straight
Carry out the exercise on a flat surface, like a bed or couch, with a towel or pillow under the heel for comfort

exercises.name: Quad Stretch
instructions: Flex the knee and extend the hip, attempting to touch the glutes with the foot, and holding the belt with the hands

exercises.name: Quadriceps-SMR
instructions: Position a foam roll underneath one leg on the quadriceps, and keep the foot off of the ground
Confirm to relax the leg as much as possible

exercises.name: Quadriceps Stretch
instructions: Confirm the knees stay close together and that you push the pelvis slightly forward

Release the muscle

exercises.name: Quadruped Hip Abduction

exercises.name: Quadruped thoracic rotation left
instructions: Position the left hand behind the head as keeping the right hand outstretched and touching the floor
On inhale, move the left elbow toward the right hand, keeping the left hand behind the head
On exhale, move the left elbow to point up toward the ceiling

exercises.name: Quadruped thoracic rotation right
instructions: Position the right hand behind the head as keeping the left hand outstretched and touching the floor
On inhale, move the right elbow toward the left hand, keeping the right hand behind the head
On exhale, move the right elbow to point up toward the ceiling

exercises.name: Quick Leap
instructions: By utilizing the hips, hop onto the box, landing on both legs
Confirm that you land with the legs bent and the feet flat
Immediately upon landing, fully extend through the entire body and swing the arms overhead to explode off of the box

exercises.name: Rack Delivery
instructions: Use a hook grip, with the fingers wrapped over the thumbs

exercises.name: Rack Pull with Bands
instructions: Be sure to pull the shoulders back as you complete the movement

exercises.name: Rack Pulls

exercises.name: Radio Taiso
instructions: Inhale as raising arms laterally overhead, exhale as you lower them
Swing arms side-to-side to turn the spine and loosen the core

exercises.name: Reach ups
instructions: To carry out this exercise, lie on the back with the arms extended overhead
Then, contract the abdominals and lift the torso off the floor as reaching the arms toward the ceiling to "reach" as high as possible
Slowly return to the start, controlling the movement

exercises.name: Rear Leg Raises
instructions: Position yourself on the hands knees on an exercise mat
The head should be looking forward and the bend of the knees should create a 90-degree angle between the hamstrings and the calves

exercises.name: Recumbent Bike
instructions: To begin, seat yourself on the bike and adjust the seat to the height

exercises.name: Renegade Row
instructions: Carry out one pushup, then drive the left elbo up, bringing the dumbell up to the body

exercises.name: Retro Treadmill Walking
instructions: Begin around 30 minutes at a controlled speed and about 2 to 3 percent incline if tolerated

exercises.name: Return Push from Stance
instructions: At the signal, move into a position to receive the pass from the partner
Catch the medicine ball with both hands and immediately throw it back to the partner

exercises.name: Reverse Band Bench Press
instructions: Lie on the bench, tuck the feet underneath you and arch the back
Use the feet to drive the traps into the bench
Lower the bar to the lower chest or upper stomach

exercises.name: Reverse Band Box Squat
instructions: Squeeze the shoulder blades together and turn the elbows forward, attempting to bend the bar across the shoulders
Keep the head facing forward

exercises.name: Reverse Band Deadlift
instructions: Bend at the hip to grip the bar at shoulder width, allowing the shoulder blades to protract

exercises.name: Reverse Band Power Squat
instructions: Squeeze the shoulder blades together and turn the elbows forward, attempting to bend the bar across the shoulders
Keep the head facing forward

exercises.name: Reverse Band Sumo Deadlift
instructions: Relax the shoulders, which in effect lengthens the arms

exercises.name: Reverse Bar Curl
instructions: Hold bar with reverse grip, palms facing the floor

exercises.name: Reverse Barbell Curl
instructions: Stand up with the torso upright as holding a barbell at shoulder width with the elbows close to the torso
Slowly begin to bring the bar back to start as the breathe in

exercises.name: Reverse Barbell Preacher Curls
instructions: Take hold of an EZ-bar using a shoulder width and palms down grip
As you breathe in, slowly lower the barbell until the upper arms are extended and the biceps is fully stretched

exercises.name: Reverse Cable Curl
instructions: Stand up with the torso upright as holding a bar attachment that is attached to a low pulley using a pronated and shoulder width grip
Confirm also that you keep the elbows close to the torso
Slowly begin to bring the bar back to start as the breathe in

exercises.name: Reverse Cable Flye
instructions: Take hold of the left on with the right hand and vice-versa

exercises.name: Reverse Clamshell
instructions: Lie on the side with the hips and knees bent, keeping the knees stacked on top of each other
Keep the feet together at first, then keep the knees touching as lifting the top foot upward
Move only through the hip and avoid rolling the pelvis backward

exercises.name: Reverse Crunch
instructions: Lie down on the floor with the legs fully extended and arms to the side of the torso with the palms on the floor
Move the legs up so that the thighs are perpendicular to the floor and feet are together and parallel to the floor
As inhaling, move the legs towards the torso as you roll the pelvis backwards and you raise the hips off the floor
Hold the contraction for a second and move the legs back to the start as exhaling

exercises.name: Reverse Flyes
instructions: Try to squeeze the shoulder blades together to get the best results from this exercise

exercises.name: Reverse Flyes With External Rotation
