exercises.name: Reverse Grip Barbell Curls
instructions: Hold the barbell with an overhand grip about shoulder-width apart
Curl the barbell upwards towards the chest in a controlled motion, keeping the elbows close to the body
Slowly lower the barbell back to the start with a controlled movement, fully extending the arms

exercises.name: Reverse Grip Bent-Over Rows
instructions: Stand erect as holding a barbell with a supinated grip
Bend the knees slightly and bring the torso forward, by bending at the waist, as keeping the back straight until it is almost parallel to the floor
Confirm that you keep the head up
The barbell should hang directly in front of you as the arms hang perpendicular to the floor and the torso

exercises.name: Reverse-grip pull-ups
instructions: Pull-ups on the bar with the thumbs pointing outward

exercises.name: Reverse Grip Triceps Pushdown
instructions: Start by setting a bar attachment on a high pulley machine
Facing the bar attachment, take hold of it with the palms facing up at shoulder width
Lower the bar by using the lats until the arms are fully extended by the sides
Slowly elevate the bar attachment up as you inhale so it is aligned with the chest
Only the forearms should move and the elbows/upper arms should be stationary by the side at all times
Begin to lower the cable bar back down to the original staring position as exhaling and contracting the triceps hard

exercises.name: Reverse Hyperextension
instructions: Lie face-down on a bench with the legs hanging off the edge
Bend the hips so the thighs are vertical, bending the knees at the same time so the shins stay horizontal
Straighten out the legs so they are not bent and the toes are pointing backwards horizontally

exercises.name: Reverse Machine Flyes
instructions: In a semicircular motion, pull the hands out to the side and back, contracting the rear delts
Keep the arms slightly bent throughout the movement, with all of the motion occurring at the shoulder joint

exercises.name: Reverse Plate Curls
instructions: Use a pronated grip and confirm the fingers take hold of the rough side of the plate as the thumb grabs the smooth side
For the best results, take hold of the weighted plate at an 11:00 and 1:00 o'clock position
Slowly lift the plate up as keeping the elbows in and the upper arms stationary until the biceps and forearms touch as exhaling

exercises.name: Reverse Snow Angel
instructions: Lift both the arms and move them to the side slowly

exercises.name: Reverse Triceps Bench Press
instructions: Using a close, supinated grip , lift the bar from the rack and hold it straight over you with the arms locked extended in front of you and perpendicular to the floor
As you breathe in, come down slowly until you feel the bar on the middle chest
After a second pause, bring the bar back to the start as you breathe out and push the bar using the triceps muscles
Lock the arms in the contracted position, hold for a second and then start coming down slowly again
When you are done, position the bar back in the rack

exercises.name: Reverse V-Squat
instructions: Step into the V-squat machine facing the pad, the opposite way from the regular V-squat, so that the chest rests against the pad and the shoulders sit under the shoulder pads
Position the feet on the platform about shoulder width apart and release the safety
Brace the core and lower yourself by bending the knees and pushing the hips back until the thighs are roughly parallel to the platform

exercises.name: Reverse Wood Chops
instructions: Start with the hands at the side of the hips, knees bent
Turn the hips as moving the hands towards over the top of the opposite shoulder

exercises.name: Rhomboids-SMR
instructions: Position a foam roll underneath the upper back, and cross the arms in front of you, protracting the shoulders

exercises.name: Rickshaw Carry
instructions: Standing in the center of the frame, begin by gripping the handles and driving through the heels to lift the frame
Keep the chest up and head forward, and confirm you continue breathing

exercises.name: Rickshaw Deadlift
instructions: Bend at the hips to grip the handles, allowing the shoulder blades to protract

exercises.name: Ring Dips
instructions: Grip a ring in each hand, and then take a small jump to help you get into the start with the arms locked out
Begin by flexing the elbow, lowering the body until the arms break 90 degrees

exercises.name: Rocket Jump
instructions: Begin in a relaxed stance with the feet shoulder width apart and hold the arms close to the body
Fully extend the entire body, reaching overhead as far as possible

exercises.name: Rocking Standing Calf Raise
instructions: Hold on to the bar using both arms at each side and lift it off the rack by first pushing with the legs and at the same time straightening the torso
Step away from the rack and position the legs using a shoulder width medium stance with the toes slightly pointed out
Keep the head up at all times as looking down will get you off balance

exercises.name: Rocking Triceps Pushdown
instructions: Push down the rope and lean the entire body back onto the rear foot as you push down to get the hands behind the body
Don't forget to bring the chest to the front during the pushdown
As you release the rope slowly, lean the body back onto the front foot

exercises.name: Rocky Pull-Ups/Pulldowns
instructions: Take hold of the pull-up bar with the palms facing forward using a wide grip
Pull the torso up until the bar touches the upper chest by drawing the shoulders and the upper arms down and back
Exhale as you carry out this portion of the movement
Use the head to lean forward slightly as it will help you properly carry out this portion of the exercise

exercises.name: Roll Down
instructions: Stand with the feet hip-width apart and slowly roll the upper body forward, one vertebra at a time, until the hands touch the ground or as far as you can comfortably go
Roll back up to the start in the same controlled manner

exercises.name: Roman Chair Crunch
instructions: Keep the torso straight, abs tight, and don't come up all the way vertical or lie flat to keep constant tension on the abs

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Set a barbell in front of you on the ground and take hold of it using a pronated grip that a little wider than shoulder width
Keeping the back and arms completely straight at all times, use the hips to lift the bar as you exhale
Take a deep breath at the start of the movement and keep the chest up
Hold the breath as you lower and exhale as you complete the movement

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift from Deficit
instructions: Begin standing as holding a bar at arm's length in front of you
Begin by flexing the knees slightly, and then flex at the hip, moving the butt back as far as possible, lowering the torso as far as flexibility allows

exercises.name: Rope Climb
instructions: Take hold of the rope with both hands above the head
Reach up as high as possible with the arms, gripping the rope tightly
Release the rope from the feet as you pull yourself up with the arms, bringing the knees towards the chest
To lower yourself, loosen the grip of the feet on the rope as you slide down using a hand over hand motion

exercises.name: Rope Crunch
instructions: To begin, flex at the spine, attempting to bring the rib cage to the legs as you pull the cable down

exercises.name: Rope Jumping
instructions: Raise the arms up and turn the rope over the head bringing it down in front of you
Rope jumping is exciting, challenges the coordination, and requires a lot of energy

exercises.name: Rope Straight-Arm Pulldown
instructions: Stand a couple feet back from the pulley with the feet staggered and take the rope with both hands
Lean forward from the hip, keeping the back straight, with the arms extended up in front of you
Keeping the arms straight, extend the shoulder to pull the rope down to the thighs
Pause at the bottom of the motion, squeezing the lats

exercises.name: Round The World Shoulder Stretch
instructions: Stand up straight with the legs together, holding a bodybar or broomstick
Hold the pole behind the hips with a wider than shoulder width grip
Slowly lift the arms up behind the head

exercises.name: Row
instructions: In strength training, rowing is an exercise where the purpose is to strengthen the muscles that draw the rower's arms toward the body as well as those that retract the scapulae and those that support the spine

exercises.name: Rowing Machine
instructions: Sit on a rowing machine with the back straight

exercises.name: Rowing, Stationary
instructions: The upper body is leaning slightly forward as still maintaining good posture
Next, push against the foot pedals and extend the legs as bringing the hands to the upper abdominal area, squeezing the shoulders back as you do so

exercises.name: Rowing, T-bar
instructions: Take hold of the barbell with a wide grip and lean forward
Pull now the barbell with a fast movement towards the belly button, not further up
Don't swing with the body and keep the arms next to the body

exercises.name: Runner's Stretch
instructions: Position the hands on either side of the front leg

exercises.name: Running, Treadmill
instructions: Maintain proper posture as you run, and only hold onto the handles when necessary, such as when dismounting or checking the heart rate

exercises.name: Russian Push Ups
instructions: Start in a standard push-up position with the hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart
Lower the chest toward the floor, then shift the body forward as keeping the chest close to the ground
Extend the arms to return to the start, then reverse the movement smoothly
Keep the core tight and maintain controlled movement throughout the exercise

exercises.name: Russian Twist
instructions: Sit on the floor and fix the feet under something stable or have a partner hold them.
Lift the upper body until the torso and thighs form a V shape.
Breathe out and turn the torso to the right until the arms are parallel to the floor.
Pause briefly, then return to the centre.
Repeat the turn on the left side with the same technique.

exercises.name: Russian Twist
instructions: For an extra challenge, lift the feet off the floor
Turn the arms to one side to the same level as the chest, touch the floor for a little extra challenge, and then do the same to the other side

exercises.name: Sandbag Load
instructions: Move as quickly as possible to the platform, and load it, extending through the hips, knees, and ankles to get it as high as possible
Position it onto the platform, ensuring it doesn't fall off
Return to the start to retrieve the next sandbag

exercises.name: Scapular Pull-Up
instructions: From a hanging position, raise yourself a few inches without using the arms
Do this by depressing the shoulder girdle in a reverse shrugging motion

exercises.name: Scapular Pushups
instructions: Start in a straight-arm plank with the hands under the shoulders
Keep the elbows locked and move only the shoulder blades: let the chest sink slightly, then push the floor away to spread the shoulder blades

exercises.name: Scissor Kick
instructions: To begin, lie down with the back pressed against the floor or on an exercise mat
With a slight bend at the knees, lift the legs up so that the heels are about 6 inches off the ground
Lift the left leg up to about a 45 degree angle as the right leg is lowered until the heel is about 2-3 inches from the ground
Switch movements by raising the right leg up and lowering the left leg
Remember to breathe as performing this exercise

exercises.name: Scissors Jump
instructions: Extending through both legs, jump as high as possible, swinging the arms to gain lift
As you jump as high as you can, switch the position of the legs, moving the front leg to the back and the rear leg to the front

exercises.name: Scorpion Kick
instructions: Get into the push-up position with the shoulders directly above the hands and the feet hip-width apart
Pull the right knee towards the chest
As keeping the knee bent, lift the right leg as high as possible with the lower right leg pointing straight up
Turn the hips so that the right foot swings over the left leg
Continue to turn and move the right foot towards the floor until you are forced to roll onto the outside of the left standing foot

exercises.name: Seated Back Extension Machine
instructions: Adjust the seat and the back pad so that the pad sits at the height of the shoulder blades or mid-back
Sit in the machine with the hips and lower back against the seat and backrest and the feet on the platform
Cross the arms over the chest or hold the handles
Exhale and push the pad backwards using the lower back muscles until the spine is in line with the hips

exercises.name: Seated Band Hamstring Curl
instructions: Secure a band close to the ground and position a bench a couple feet away from it
Flex the knees, bringing the feet towards the bench
You may need to lean back slightly to keep the feet from striking the floor

exercises.name: Seated Band Row
instructions: Sit on the floor with the legs straight out in front of you and the back tall
Pull the band toward the lower ribs by driving the elbows straight back and squeezing the shoulder blades together
Keep the chest up and the torso still rather than rocking backward to move the band

exercises.name: Seated Barbell Military Press
instructions: Sit on a Military Press Bench with a bar behind the head and either have a spotter give you the bar or pick it up yourself carefully with a pronated grip
The grip should be wider than shoulder width and it should create a 90-degree angle between the forearm and the upper arm as the barbell goes down
Hold at about shoulder level and slightly in front of the head
Lift the bar back up to the start as you exhale

exercises.name: Seated Barbell Twist
instructions: Start out by sitting at the end of a flat bench with a barbell placed on top of the thighs
Grip the bar with the palms facing down and confirm the hands are wider than shoulder width apart from each other
Begin to lift the barbell up over the head until the arms are fully extended
Lower the barbell behind the head until it is resting along the base of the neck
As keeping the feet and head stationary, move the waist from side to side so that the oblique muscles feel the contraction
Remember to breathe out as twisting the body to the side and in when moving back to the start

exercises.name: Seated Bench Press
instructions: Take hold of a handle in each hand, stick the chest out, and keep the head against the headrest
Breathe deeply and slowly push the handles forward until the arms are almost fully extended

exercises.name: Seated Bent-Over One-Arm Dumbbell Triceps Extension
instructions: Bend the knees slightly and bring the torso forward, by bending at the waist, as keeping the back straight until it is almost parallel to the floor
Confirm that you keep the head up

exercises.name: Seated Bent-Over Rear Delt Raise
instructions: Position a couple of dumbbells looking forward in front of a flat bench
Sit on the end of the bench with the legs together and the dumbbells behind the calves
Bend at the waist as keeping the back straight in order to pick up the dumbbells
Keeping the torso forward and stationary, and the arms slightly bent at the elbows, lift the dumbbells straight to the side until both arms are parallel to the floor

exercises.name: Seated Bent-Over Two-Arm Dumbbell Triceps Extension
instructions: Bend the knees slightly and bring the torso forward, by bending at the waist, as keeping the back straight until it is almost parallel to the floor
Confirm that you keep the head up

exercises.name: Seated Biceps
instructions: Sit on the floor with the knees bent and the partner standing behind you
Extend the arms straight behind you with the palms facing each other
The partner will hold the wrists for you
Attempt to flex the elbows, as the partner prevents any actual movement
After 10-20 seconds, relax the arms as the partner gently pulls the wrists up to stretch the biceps

exercises.name: Seated Cable chest fly
instructions: Position a bench between two cable pulleys and adjust the pulleys so they are at chest/shoulder height when you are seated
Take hold of the handles with a neutral grip and lean against the upright backrest
Keep the elbows slightly bent throughout the movement
Slowly lower the arms back to the start as maintaining control of the movement

exercises.name: Seated Cable Rows
instructions: Take a seat on the machine and set the feet on the front platform or crossbar with the knees slightly bent.
Keep the back naturally aligned, hinge forward slightly, and take the V-bar handles.
With the arms extended, draw the torso back until it is about ninety degrees to the legs.
Hold the torso still, pull the handles toward the abdomen with the arms close to the body, and breathe out.
Pause at the contraction, then return to the start while breathing in.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Shoulder Press
instructions: Begin by extending through the elbow, pressing the handles together above the head
Confirm that you maintain tension on the cables
You can also carry out this movement with the back off the pad and alternate hands

exercises.name: Seated Calf Raise
instructions: Sit on the machine and position the toes on the lower portion of the platform provided with the heels extending off
Choose the toe positioning of the choice as per the beginning of this chapter
Position the lower thighs under the lever pad, which will need to be adjusted according to the height of the thighs
Position the hands on top of the lever pad in order to prevent it from slipping forward
Lift the lever slightly by pushing the heels up and release the safety bar

exercises.name: Seated Calf Stretch
instructions: Bend one knee and set that foot on the floor to stabilize the torso
Straighten the other leg and flex the ankle

exercises.name: Seated Close-Grip Concentration Barbell Curl
instructions: Sit down on a flat bench with a barbell or E-Z Bar in front of you in between the legs
The legs should be spread with the knees bent and the feet on the floor
A supinated grip closer than shoulder width is needed to carry out this exercise
The arm should be extended at arms length and the barbell should be above the floor

exercises.name: Seated Corkscrew
instructions: And bring the knees in and across, really trying to contract the obliques
Extend the legs back out to start
Position to start and something to improve upon

exercises.name: Seated Dumbbell Curl
instructions: Turn the palms of the hands so that they are facing the torso
Confirm that you contract the biceps as you breathe out and confirm that only the forearms move
Slowly begin to bring the dumbbells back to the start as the breathe in and as you turn the wrists back to a neutral grip

exercises.name: Seated Dumbbell Inner Biceps Curl
instructions: Turn the palms of the hands so that they are facing inward in a neutral position
As holding the upper arms stationary, curl the dumbbells out and up, turning the palms out as you lift and keeping the forearms in line with the outer deltoids
Remember to turn the arms as you lower the dumbbells so that you can switch back to a neutral grip

exercises.name: Seated Dumbbell Palms-Down Wrist Curl
instructions: Sit down on the edge of the flat bench with the legs at about shoulder width apart
Confirm to keep the feet on the floor
Use the arms to take hold of both of the dumbbells and bring them up so that the forearms are resting against the thighs with the palms of the hands facing down
The wrists should be hanging over the edge of the thighs

exercises.name: Seated Dumbbell Palms-Up Wrist Curl
instructions: Sit down on the edge of the flat bench with the legs at about shoulder width apart
Confirm to keep the feet on the floor
Use the arms to take hold of both of the dumbbells and bring them up so that the forearms are resting against the thighs with the palms of the hands facing up
The wrists should be hanging over the edge of the thighs

exercises.name: Seated Dumbbell Press
instructions: Take hold of a couple of dumbbells and sit on a military press bench or a utility bench that has a back support on it as you position the dumbbells upright on top of the thighs
Clean the dumbbells up one at a time by using the thighs to bring the dumbbells up to shoulder height at each side
Turn the wrists so that the palms of the hands are facing forward
After a second pause, slowly come down back to the start as you inhale

exercises.name: seated figure four
instructions: Position the left ankle over the right knee
Gently push the left knee down

exercises.name: Seated Flat Bench Leg Pull-In
instructions: Sit on a bench with the legs stretched out in front of you slightly below parallel and the arms holding on to the sides of the bench
The torso should be leaning backwards around a 45-degree angle from the bench
Bring the knees in toward you as you move the torso closer to them at the same time
Breathe out as you carry out this movement
After a second pause, go back to the start as you inhale

exercises.name: Seated Floor Hamstring Stretch
instructions: Sit on a mat with the right leg extended in front of you and the left leg bent with the foot against the right inner thigh
Lean forward from the hips and reach for the ankle until you feel a stretch in the hamstring

exercises.name: Seated Front Deltoid
instructions: Sit upright on the floor with the legs bent, the partner standing behind you
Attempt to move them as far behind you as possible, as the assistant holds the wrists
Keeping the elbows straight, attempt to move the arms to the front, with the partner gently restraining you to prevent any actual movement
Now, relax the muscles and allow the partner to gently increase the stretch on the shoulders and chest

exercises.name: Seated Glute
instructions: In a seated position with the knees bent, cross one ankle over the opposite knee
The partner will stand behind you
Now, lean forward as the partner braces the shoulders with their hands
Attempt to push the torso back , as the partner prevents any actual movement of the torso
Relax the muscles as the partner increases the stretch by gently pushing the torso forward

exercises.name: Seated Good Mornings
instructions: Begin by stepping under the bar and placing it across the back of the shoulders, not on top of the traps
Squeeze the shoulder blades together and turn the elbows forward, attempting to bend the bar across the shoulders
Keep the head facing forward
Sit back with the hips until you are seated on the box
Pause just above the pins and reverse the motion until the torso it upright

exercises.name: Seated Hamstring
instructions: In a seated position with the legs extended, have the partner stand behind you
Now, lean forward as the partner braces the shoulders with their hands
Attempt to push the torso back , as the partner prevents any actual movement of the torso
Relax the muscles as the partner increases the stretch by gently pushing the torso forward

exercises.name: Seated Hamstring and Calf Stretch
instructions: Leaning forward slightly, pull on the belt to draw the toes of the foot back
Hold this position and then

exercises.name: Seated Head Harness Neck Resistance
instructions: Position a neck strap on the floor at the end of a flat bench
The toes should be pointed out
Slowly move the torso forward until it is almost parallel with the floor
Using both hands, securely position the neck strap around the head
Position both hands on top of the knees
As exhaling, bring the neck back to the start

exercises.name: Seated Hip Abduction
instructions: Adjust the seat height so that the knees are aligned with the pivot point of the machine
Sit with the back flat against the backrest, maintaining good posture
Position the outside of the thighs against the machine's padded levers
Position the feet flat on the footrests or platform of the machine
Exhale as you slowly push the legs outward against the resistance pads
Hold the fully abducted position briefly to maximize muscle engagement

exercises.name: Seated Hip Adduction
instructions: Sit on the machine with the knees inward and against the pads
Take hold of the handles on the sides.b

exercises.name: Seated Knee Extension with Overpressure
instructions: Position both hands on the thigh just above the kneecap

exercises.name: Seated Knee Tuck
instructions: Position arms slightly behind you
Extend the legs and pull them back

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl
instructions: Adjust the machine lever to fit the height and sit on the machine with the back against the back support pad
Position the back of lower leg on top of padded lever and secure the lap pad against the thighs, just above the knees
As you exhale, pull the machine lever as far as possible to the back of the thighs by flexing at the knees
Keep the torso stationary at all times
Slowly return to the start as you breathe in

exercises.name: Seated Leg Tucks
instructions: Sit on a bench with the legs stretched out in front of you slightly below parallel and the arms holding on to the sides of the bench
The torso should be leaning backwards around a 45-degree angle from the bench
Bring the knees in toward you as you move the torso closer to them at the same time
Breathe out as you carry out this movement
After a second pause, go back to the start as you inhale

exercises.name: Seated One-arm Cable Pulley Rows
instructions: To get into the start, first sit down on the machine and position the feet on the front platform or crossbar provided making sure that the knees are slightly bent and not locked
Lean over as you keep the natural alignment of the back and take hold of the single handle attachment with the left arm using a palms-down grip
With the arm extended pull back until the torso is at a 90-degree angle from the legs
Keeping the torso stationary, pull the handles back towards the torso as keeping the arms close to it as you turn the wrist
Breathe out as you carry out that movement
Remember to turn the wrist as you go back to the start so that the palms are facing down again

exercises.name: Seated One-Arm Dumbbell Palms-Down Wrist Curl
instructions: Sit on a flat bench with a dumbbell in the right hand
Position the feet flat on the floor, at a distance that is slightly wider than shoulder width apart
Lean forward and position the right forearm on top of the upper right thigh with the palm down
Inhale as you carry out this movement

exercises.name: Seated One-Arm Dumbbell Palms-Up Wrist Curl
instructions: Sit on a flat bench with a dumbbell in the right hand
Position the feet flat on the floor, at a distance that is slightly wider than shoulder width apart
Lean forward and position the right forearm on top of the upper right thigh with the palm up
Inhale as you carry out this movement

exercises.name: Seated Overhead Stretch
instructions: Position one hand on the floor beside you and the other hand behind the head
Lift the elbow to the ceiling as you incline the torso to the other side

exercises.name: Seated Palm-Up Barbell Wrist Curl
instructions: Hold a barbell with both hands and the palms facing up
Position the feet flat on the floor, at a distance that is slightly wider than shoulder width apart
Lean forward and position the forearms on top of the upper thighs with the palms up
Lower the bar as far as possible as inhaling and keeping a tight grip
Curl bar up as high as possible as flexing the forearms and exhaling

exercises.name: Seated Palms-Down Barbell Wrist Curl
instructions: Hold a barbell with both hands and the palms facing down
Position the feet flat on the floor, at a distance that is slightly wider than shoulder width apart
Lean forward and position the forearms on top of the upper thighs with the palms down
Lower the bar as far as possible as inhaling and keeping a tight grip
Curl bar up as high as possible as flexing the forearms and exhaling

exercises.name: Seated Pancake Good Morning
instructions: Sit with the legs completely straight , spread wide in a straddle position
Position the hands on the back of the neck
Hinge the torso and head towards the floor

exercises.name: Seated Row (Machine)
instructions: Keep the chest up and squeeze the shoulder blades at the end

exercises.name: Seated Shoulder Extension Stretch
instructions: Sit with the hands behind you, shoulder width apart
Lock the elbows

exercises.name: Seated Side Lateral Raise
instructions: Hold the dumbbells with the palms facing in and the arms straight down at the sides at arms' length
As maintaining the torso stationary , lift the dumbbells to the side with a slight bend on the elbow and the hands slightly tilted forward as if pouring water in a glass
Exhale as you carry out this movement and pause for a second at the top
Lower the dumbbells back down slowly to the start as you inhale

exercises.name: Seated Triceps Press
instructions: Keeping the upper arms close to the head and perpendicular to the floor, lower the resistance in a semi-circular motion behind the head until the forearms touch the biceps
Breathe in as you carry out this step
Go back to the start by using the triceps to raise the dumbbell
Breathe out as you carry out this step

exercises.name: Seated Triceps Press
instructions: Take a dumbbell firmly with both hands and hold it with extended arms over the head

exercises.name: Seated Two-Arm Palms-Up Low-Pulley Wrist Curl
instructions: Set a bench in front of a low pulley machine that has a barbell or EZ Curl attachment on it
Step back and sit on the bench with the feet about shoulder width apart, firmly on the floor
Lean forward and position the forearms on the thighs with the back of the wrists over the knees
Lower the bar as far as possible, as inhaling and keeping a tight grip

exercises.name: See-Saw Press (Alternating Side Press)
instructions: Take hold of a dumbbell with each hand and stand up erect
Clean the dumbbells to the chest/shoulder level and then turn the wrists so that the palms are facing towards you as if you were getting ready to carry out an Arnold Press
Start extending the left arm overhead as you turn the wrist so that the palm of the hand faces forward as you go up
If you carry out the exercise correctly, is should look as if you are trying to reach for something overhead on the right hand side of the body, but with the left arm
Breathe out as you carry out this movement

exercises.name: Serratus Wall Slide Stretch
instructions: Position the forearms vertically against the wall so the elbows and wrists are both touching it
Point the arms slightly outwards from "straight up"
Protract the shoulders had, then slide the forearms up the wall until the elbows are about level with the chin
Slide the forearms back down the wall

exercises.name: Shinbox IR Stretch
instructions: Position one leg in front of you and the other leg out
Keeping the hips square, hinge the torso forward or tilt it laterally

exercises.name: Shotgun Row
instructions: The arm should be extended and the shoulder forward
Carry out the movement by retracting the shoulder and flexing the elbow

exercises.name: Shoulder Circles
instructions: With shoulders relaxed and arms resting loosely at the sides , gently roll the shoulders forward, up, back, and down

exercises.name: Shoulder dislocates
instructions: Stand up with the back straight and a resistance band, towel, or broomstick handle in hand
Keeping the arms outstretched, turn at the shoulders to bring the arms overhead and then down toward the glutes
Turn at the shoulders in the opposite direction — overhead and then toward the groin

exercises.name: Shoulder Dumbbell Pendular Exercise
instructions: Lean forward to rest the hand on a chair or other object, holding a dumbbell in the other hand

exercises.name: Shoulder External Rotation (Cable)
instructions: Keep elbow fixed at the side and turn forearm outward smoothly

exercises.name: Shoulder External Rotation with Dumbbell
instructions: Lie on the side holding a dumbbell in the upper hand
Turn the shoulder so the hand raises up

exercises.name: Shoulder Internal Rotation (Cable)
instructions: Keep the elbow tucked to the side like it's superglued there
Don’t turn the torso — only the forearm should move

exercises.name: Shoulder Press - With Bands
instructions: Turn the wrists so that the palms of the hands are facing forward
As you exhale, lift the handles up until the arms are fully extended overhead

exercises.name: Shoulder Raise
instructions: Relax the arms to the sides and raise the shoulders up toward the ears, then back down

exercises.name: Shoulder Raise Side and Front DB
instructions: Stand as holding dumbbells beside body
Without momentum raise dumbbells to the side of the body until shoulder height, palms facing down
Immediately raise dumbbells in front of the body until shoulder height, palms facing down

exercises.name: Shoulder Shrug
instructions: The lifter stands erect, hands about shoulder width apart, and raises the shoulders as high as possible, and then lowers them, as not bending the elbows, or moving the body at all

exercises.name: Shoulder Stretch
instructions: Reach the left arm across the body and hold it straight

exercises.name: Shoulder width three-point push-up
instructions: Get into a push-up position with the shoulders directly above the hands and the feet hip-width apart
Draw the belly button in towards the spine and tighten the abdominal muscles
Lift the left foot about five centimetres off the floor
Point the toes straight down
Do not move the hips
Bend the elbows, lower the chest to the floor and push yourself back up

exercises.name: Side Crunch
instructions: Pull upo to upright position using the obliquus

exercises.name: Side Hop-Sprint
instructions: Begin this drill by hopping sideways over the obstacle, rebounding out of the landing to hop back to where you started

exercises.name: Side Lateral Raise
instructions: As maintaining the torso in a stationary position , lift the dumbbells to the side with a slight bend on the elbow and the hands slightly tilted forward as if pouring water in a glass
Exhale as you carry out this movement and pause for a second at the top
Lower the dumbbells back down slowly to the start as you inhale

exercises.name: Side Lateral Raise (Cable)
instructions: Lift with the elbows leading, not the hands
Don’t shrug the shoulders

exercises.name: Side Laterals to Front Raise
instructions: In a standing position, hold a pair of dumbbells at the side

exercises.name: Side Leg Raises
instructions: Keeping the leg straight, raise it as far out to the side as possible, and swing it back down, allowing it to cross the opposite leg

exercises.name: Side-lying External Rotation
instructions: Keep the knees slightly bent
Hold the elbow against the side, and extend the upper arm straight ahead of you
As continuing to hold the elbow against the side, turn the upper arm 90 degrees upwards
It is helpful to position a towel under the armpit to help with the form on this exercise
Placing a support under the head for the duration of the exercise is also a good idea

exercises.name: Side-Lying Floor Stretch
instructions: Lie on the left side, bending the left knee in front of you to stabilize the torso
Straighten the right leg and rest the right foot on the floor behind the left
Straighten the right arm over the head and gently pull on the right wrist to stretch the entire right side of the body

exercises.name: Side Lying Groin Stretch
instructions: Start off by lying on the right side and bend the right knee in front of you to stabilize the torso
Lift the left leg upward and hold it by the back of the knee or the foot
Pull the left knee in toward the left shoulder and simultaneously press the foot or knee down to the floor
To intensify this stretch, straighten the left leg

exercises.name: Side Lying Hip Abduction
instructions: Begin by lying down on the side with the top leg straight and the bottom leg bent for support
Lift the top leg off the ground

exercises.name: Side Neck Stretch
instructions: Start with the shoulders relaxed, gently tilt the head towards the shoulder

exercises.name: Side Plank
instructions: Lie on the side and support the body between the forearm and knee to the feet

exercises.name: Side Slides + Squats
instructions: After three slides, turn the body for 180 degree on the guiding leg and do a squat

exercises.name: Side Standing Long Jump
instructions: Begin standing with the feet hip width apart in an athletic stance
Leaning to the right, extend through the hips, knees, and ankles to jump into the air
Land facing the same direction with the feet hip width apart, absorbing the impact through the lower body

exercises.name: Side Straight-Arm Pulldown (Cable)
instructions: Keep the torso still, pulling the handle down along the side using the outer lat

exercises.name: Side to Side Box Shuffle
instructions: Stand to one side of the box with the left foot resting on the middle of it
To begin, jump up and over to the other side of the box, landing with the right foot on top of the box and the left foot on the floor
Swing the arms to aid the movement

exercises.name: Side To Side Chins
instructions: Take hold of the pull-up bar with the palms facing forward using a wide grip
Pull the torso up as leaning to the left hand side until the bar almost touches the upper chest by drawing the shoulders and the upper arms down and back
Exhale as you carry out this portion of the movement
Now, pull the torso up as leaning to the right hand side until the bar almost touches the upper chest by drawing the shoulders and the upper arms down and back

exercises.name: Side Wrist Pull
instructions: Cross the left arm over the midline of the body and hold the left wrist in the right hand down at the level of the hips

exercises.name: Single-Arm Cable Crossover
instructions: Step forward in front of both pulleys with the arms extended in front of you, bringing the hands together
Keeping the left arm in position, allow the right arm to extend out to the side, maintaining a slight bend at the elbow
Return the arm back to the start by pulling the hand back to the midline of the body

exercises.name: Single-arm cable pushdown
instructions: Stand facing the cable machine with the feet shoulder-width apart
Take hold of the handle with one hand using an overhand grip , with the elbow bent at about 90° and tucked close to the body
Keep the core braced and the back straight
Push the handle downward in a controlled motion by extending the elbow until the arm is fully extended
Hold the contraction at the bottom, then slowly return to the start

exercises.name: Single-Arm Cable Row /w Rotation (floor)
instructions: Turn the upper torso to get into the start and bend the upper torso a little bit sidewise
Position the unused hand on the knee
Pull the cable as rotating the upper torso

exercises.name: Single-arm dumbbell shoulder press
instructions: Press the dumbbell vertically overhead in a controlled motion until the arm is fully extended, without locking the elbow
Slowly lower the dumbbell back to the start at shoulder height

exercises.name: Single-Arm Lat Pulldown
instructions: Sit at the lat pulldown machine and take hold of the single handle with a neutral grip
Keep the torso stable, the chest lifted, and the shoulder blades slightly retracted
Start with the arm fully extended overhead, then pull the handle down toward the upper chest following a controlled, slightly diagonal path
Focus on engaging the latissimus dorsi as keeping the shoulder depressed and avoiding any torso rotation
Slowly return to the start, maintaining full control throughout the movement

exercises.name: Single-Arm Linear Jammer
instructions: Raise the bar from the floor, taking it to the shoulders with one or both hands

exercises.name: Single-arm Preacher Curl
instructions: Sit on the preacher curl bench and carry out a bicep curl with a dumbbell in one hand

exercises.name: Single-Arm Push-Up
instructions: The legs should be extended, and for this movement you may need a wider base, placing the feet further apart than in a normal push-up
Maintain good posture, and position the free hand behind the back

exercises.name: Single-Cone Sprint Drill
instructions: Circle the cone, keep the knees up, with violent foot action

exercises.name: Single Dumbbell Raise
instructions: The arms should be extended and hanging at the waist

exercises.name: Single-Leg Balance with Eyes Closed
instructions: Stand on one leg with the knee slightly bent and the other foot lifted clear of the floor, then close the eyes and hold the position

exercises.name: Single-leg BOSU balance
instructions: Standing on one leg challenges the stability
## How to carry out the Single-Leg BOSU Balance Exercise
Keep the opposite leg lifted and the core engaged
Catch or toss a ball as balancing to further engage the core and coordination

exercises.name: Single Leg Butt Kick
instructions: This will be the start position
Immediately flex the knee and attempt to touch the butt with the heel of the jumping leg

exercises.name: Single-Leg Deadlift with Dumbbell
instructions: Stand upright with a slight bend in the knees, holding a dumbbell in one or both hands
Keeping the back flat and core engaged, hinge at the hips, pushing the glutes backward
As the torso lowers, extend the non-supporting leg straight back behind you for balance, keeping the hips square to the floor
The dumbbell should lower toward the ground along the line of the supporting leg
Continue lowering the torso until it is nearly parallel to the floor, or you feel an intense stretch in the supporting hamstring, ensuring the back remains neutral throughout the movement
The non-supporting leg should return in line with the supporting one

exercises.name: Single Leg Glute Bridge
instructions: Raise one leg off of the ground, pulling the knee to the chest
Carry out the movement by driving through the heel, extending the hip upward and raising the glutes off of the ground

exercises.name: Single Leg Hamstring Stretch
instructions: Reach forward with both hands, trying to touch the toes of the straight leg

exercises.name: Single-Leg High Box Squat
instructions: Standing in front of it, step onto the box to a full standing position, letting the other leg remain unsupported

exercises.name: Single-Leg Hop Progression
instructions: Raise the knee of the opposite leg

exercises.name: Single-Leg Lateral Hop
instructions: To get into the start position, stand on one leg with the knee slightly bent
To begin, carry out a counterjump to hop sideways over the cone
Land on the jumping leg, and immediately rebound out of it by jumping back to the start position

exercises.name: Single-Leg Leg Extension
instructions: Adjust the seat so that the pivot point is in line with the knee

exercises.name: Single-Leg Lunge with Kettlebell:
instructions: Stand with the feet together
Hold the kettlebell with both hands by the handle, keeping it close to the chest, or hold it with one hand
Take a large step forward with one leg, lowering the hips until both knees form a 90-degree angle
Push off with the front leg to return to the start

exercises.name: Single Leg Push-off
instructions: Push off with the foot on top of the box, trying to gain as much height as possible by extending through the hip and knee
Land with the same foot on top of the box, returning the other foot back to the start position

exercises.name: Single Leg RDL
instructions: Brace the core and lift one leg off the ground
Keep the back straight, hinge at the hips as lowering the torso forward, ensuring you don’t turn the hips
Lower until you feel a stretch in the standing leg's hamstring, then return to standing position

exercises.name: Single-leg side glute press
instructions: Sit in the leg press machine, turn the body to one hip, placing one foot high on the platform at about a 45-degree angle with toes pointed slightly out/forward
Keep the hip, knee, and ankle aligned, and confirm the lower back stays on the pad

exercises.name: Single-Leg Soft-Landing Holds
instructions: ## How to carry out Single-Leg Soft-Landing Holds

exercises.name: Single-Leg Stride Jump
instructions: Stand to the side of a box with the inside foot on top of it, close to the edge
Land in the same position that you started, using the inside leg to decelerate the impact

exercises.name: Sit & Reach
instructions: Sit on the ground with the legs extended straight in front of you
Reach both hands forward, trying to reach past the toes or as far as you can go

exercises.name: Sit Squats
instructions: Stand with the feet shoulder width apart
Begin the movement by flexing the knees and hips, sitting back with the hips

exercises.name: Sit-Up
instructions: Lie down on the floor placing the feet either under something that will not move or by having a partner hold them
Position the hands behind the head and lock them together by clasping the fingers
Elevate the upper body so that it creates an imaginary V-shape with the thighs

exercises.name: Sit-ups
instructions: Sit on a mat, the calves are resting on a bench, the knees make a right angle
Hold the hands behind the neck
At the highest point, contract the abs as much as you can and hold there for 2 sec

exercises.name: Sitting Calf Raises
instructions: Pull the calves up, going as far as you can

exercises.name: Ski Machine
instructions: Start standing on the platform with the feet hip-width apart
Reach overhead to grip the handles with the palms facing in
Next, bring the arms back overhead as thrusting the hips forward until you're standing with the arms fully extended

exercises.name: Skullcrusher Dumbbells
instructions: Hold the dumbbells and lay down on a flat bench in such a way that around 1/4 of the head is over the edge

exercises.name: Skullcrusher SZ-bar
instructions: Hold the SZ-bar and lay down on a flat bench in such a way that around 1/4 of the head is over the edge

exercises.name: Skydiver with arms in T-position
instructions: Lie on the stomach with the legs more than shoulder-width apart and the feet up
Raise the upper body, arms and legs as high as you can as keeping the body under tension
Turn the thumbs towards the ceiling and pull the shoulder blades together
As keeping the upper body and all limbs in the air, bring the legs together and then spread them again, keeping them constantly in the air

exercises.name: Sled Overhead Backward Walk
instructions: Hold the hands directly above the head with the elbows extended
Walk backwards, keeping the arms raised above the head

exercises.name: Sled Overhead Triceps Extension
instructions: Raise the hands above the head, keeping them together, palms facing each other
The elbows should be pointed upward with the elbows flexed
You may keep the feet staggered for more stability

exercises.name: Sled Push
instructions: Take an athletic posture, leaning into the sled with the arms fully extended, grasping the handles

exercises.name: Sled Reverse Flye
instructions: Bend the knees slightly and keep the chest and head up
Return to the start, taking a couple steps back to take the slack out of the line

exercises.name: Sled Row
instructions: To initiate the movement, flex the elbow as you retract the shoulder blades, pulling the sled towards you

exercises.name: Sledgehammer Swings
instructions: As you bring the sledge up, the right hand slides toward the head
As you swing down, the right hand will slide down to join the left hand

exercises.name: Sleeper Stretch
instructions: Extend the arm to 90 degrees in front of you, resting on the floor/mat
Lift the hand with the elbow so that the fingers point to the ceiling and the palm points towards the feet
Keeping the elbow still, gently lower the palm toward the floor

exercises.name: Sliding Lateral Lunge
instructions: Stand upright with the feet hip-width apart, holding a kettlebell close to the chest in goblet position
Position one foot on a slider, gliding disc, or towel
Keep the chest tall and core engaged
Slowly slide the foot outward to the side as bending the opposite knee, lowering the hips into a lateral lunge
Push through the heel of the bent leg to return to the start as maintaining control of the kettlebell

exercises.name: Slow Squat
instructions: ​Stand: Return to the start at a normal pace

exercises.name: Smith Incline Shoulder Raise
instructions: Position an incline bench underneath the smith machine
Position the barbell at a height that you can reach when lying down and the arms are almost fully extended
As you breathe out, lift the bar up until the arms are fully extended
After a second pause, bring the bar back down to the start as you breathe in
When you are done, position the bar back in the rack

exercises.name: Smith Machine Behind the Back Shrug
instructions: You should be standing up straight with the head and chest up and the arms extended

exercises.name: Smith Machine Bench Press
instructions: Position a flat bench underneath the smith machine
Position the barbell at a height that you can reach when lying down and the arms are almost fully extended
Using a pronated grip that is wider than shoulder width, unlock the bar from the rack and hold it straight over you with the arms locked
As you breathe in, come down slowly until you feel the bar on the middle chest
After a second pause, bring the bar back to the start as you breathe out and push the bar using the chest muscles

exercises.name: Smith Machine Bent Over Row
instructions: Bend the knees slightly and bring the torso forward, by bending at the waist, as keeping the back straight until it is almost parallel to the floor
Confirm that you keep the head up
Let it hang directly in front of you as the arms hang extended perpendicular to the floor and the torso

exercises.name: Smith Machine Calf Raise
instructions: Turn the bar to unrack it
Raise the heels as high as possible by pushing off of the balls of the feet, flexing the calf at the top
The knees should remain extended
Return slowly to the start as you breathe in as lowering the heels

exercises.name: Smith Machine Close-Grip Bench Press
instructions: Position a flat bench underneath the smith machine
Position the barbell at a height that you can reach when lying down and the arms are almost fully extended
Using a close and pronated grip that is around shoulder width, unlock the bar from the rack and hold it straight over you with the arms locked
As you breathe in, come down slowly until you feel the bar on the middle chest
After a second pause, bring the bar back to the start as you breathe out and push the bar using the triceps muscles

exercises.name: Smith Machine Close-grip Bench Press
instructions: Carry out a standard bench press on the smith machine, but have the hands on the bar about shoulder width apart, and keep the elbows close to the body

exercises.name: Smith Machine Decline Press
instructions: Position a decline bench in the rack so that the bar will be above the chest
Turn the bar to unhook it from the rack and fully extend the arms

instructions: With the head looking forward and back arched, lift the yoke by driving through the heels

exercises.name: YWTs
instructions: The thumbs should be pointing up
Keeping the chest up, bend at the elbows to move from a Y position to a "W" position, with arms bent at the elbows and maintaining the upward tension

exercises.name: Zercher Squats
instructions: Lift the bar up so that it is resting on top of the forearms
If you are holding the bar properly, it should look as if you have the arms crossed but with a bar running across them
Step away from the rack and position the legs using a shoulder width medium stance with the toes slightly pointed out
Keep the head up at all times as looking down will get you off balance and also maintain a straight back

exercises.name: Zottman Curl
instructions: Stand up with the torso upright and a dumbbell in each hand being held at arms length
The wrist should turn so that you have a supinated grip
As the dumbbells close the thighs, start rotating the wrist so that you go back to a neutral grip

exercises.name: Zottman Preacher Curl
instructions: Take hold of a dumbbell in each hand and position the upper arms on top of the preacher bench or the incline bench
Hold the dumbbells with the palms of the hands facing down
As you breathe in, slowly lower the dumbbells keeping the palms down until the upper arm is extended and the biceps are fully stretched
Turn the wrists once you are at the bottom of the movement so that the palms of the hands are facing up
Squeeze the biceps hard for a second at the contracted position and turn the wrists so that the palms are facing down again
